title: Engineer - Agentic AI
description:
**Job Description:**

* Design and build agentic AI workflows & systems — multi-step, tool-using agents that plan, act, and self-correct to automate enterprise processes.
* Identify manual, repetitive, or complex business workflows and re-imagine them as reliable agentic solutions.
* Build and maintain agent orchestration and the tools, connectors, and integrations that let agents act on real enterprise systems.
* Build and own complete solutions end-to-end — front end, backend, and deployment — not just the AI/agent layer. Expect full-stack ownership.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines to ground agents in enterprise knowledge and data.
* Deploy and operate local / self-hosted LLMs, with a focus on fast, efficient inference at scale.
* Build and expose capabilities via MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool and context integration.
* Engineer human-in-the-loop review and approval flows for high-stakes automated actions.
* Ensure AI systems are scalable, reliable, observable, and safe in production — with guardrails, validation, retries, graceful failure handling, and cost/budget caps to prevent runaway spend.
* Follow solid SDLC practices end to end: version control, code review, CI/CD, testing, and deployment.

**Minimum Qualifications and Experience:**

* 3–5 years of professional software / AI engineering experience, with demonstrable hands-on work building Agentic AI systems — not just calling an LLM API but building agents that plan and act over multiple steps.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Python engineering skills.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration — e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar.
* Solid understanding of agentic harnesses / scaffolding — the execution loop, tool interfaces, context and memory management, and evaluation that make an LLM behave as a reliable agent.
* Proven experience building RAG systems — chunking, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, and grounding.
* Basic familiarity with local / self-hosted LLMs — faster inference, quantization techniques, and serving frameworks such as vLLM (a plus, not core).
* Hands-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool / context integration.
* Full-stack delivery experience — comfortable building a usable UI (React/Next.js or Streamlit) and a backend/API layer (FastAPI or Node.js) end-to-end.
* Strong grasp of core LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, tool / function calling, structured (JSON) output handling, context management, and evaluation.
* Comfort debugging non-deterministic systems and designing guardrails, validation, and fallbacks.
* Proficiency across traditional ML, NLP, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning fundamentals & techniques.
* A clear track record of deploying scalable AI solutions in production, not just building POCs.

We are seeking talented professionals to join our Agentic Automation Team at UBS Bank USA (BUSA), helping us modernize the day‑to‑day work of our service delivery teams across Banking US.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
Leverage your curiosity, technical aptitude, and engineering insight to help design, build, and integrate AI agents that change how our business works every day.
  
  
Embed, learn, and design
  
  

* Sit side‑by‑side with service delivery staff in your assigned business area to understand the work as the people doing it experience it
* Learn the workflows, pain points, controls, and downstream impacts of an end‑to‑end process
* Translate business problems into well‑scoped agent solutions that meet UBS standards for safety, control, and compliance

Build and integrate
  
  

* Design, build, and integrate agentic workflows, primarily using Microsoft Copilot Studio, that remove friction and create efficiencies in day‑to‑day business aligned processing.
* Embed agents directly into the day‑to‑day tools and routines of service delivery staff so adoption is natural and sustained
* Partner with senior leaders, technology teams, and risk and compliance stakeholders to deploy agents responsibly
* Maintain, monitor, and iterate on deployed agents based on user feedback and performance metrics
* Contribute to the team’s shared library of design patterns, prompts, and reusable components

Onboarding & training
  
  
Upon hiring, new joiners will go through structured side‑by‑side training with a senior leader to learn:
  
  

* The tools we use to develop agents (primarily Microsoft Copilot Studio)
* UBS guardrails, design principles, and compliance requirements for deploying AI safely
* How to scope, design, validate, and hand off agent use cases

**The team**
Your Team
  
  
The Agentic Automation Team is a dedicated group of approximately 10 builders focused on creating intelligent agents that streamline the day‑to‑day work of our business aligned functions. You will partner directly with Banking US staff to identify automation opportunities and embed agentic solutions where they have the greatest impact. UBS is committed to deploying AI safely and at scale, grounded in strong guardrails, robust control frameworks, and a business‑first mindset. As part of this buildout, we are looking to establish a follow‑the‑sun operating model.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience**
Your Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or equivalent work experience
* 2–10 years of experience in technology, automation, process engineering, operations, or a related field
* Hands‑on experience building solutions with low‑code/no‑code platforms (Microsoft Copilot Studio strongly preferred; Power Platform, Power Automate, or similar a plus)
* Familiarity with conversational AI, large language models, prompt engineering, or agent design patterns
* Comfort with structured problem decomposition and translating business workflows into automatable steps
* Working knowledge of data handling, basic integration patterns (APIs, connectors), and process modeling
* Awareness of AI safety, responsible AI principles, or financial‑services compliance considerations is a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Excel comfort for analysis
* Very strong English communication skills, with clear written documentation and concise verbal updates across time zones

You Are
  
  

* Willing to work EMEA hours and be onsite in Mumbai
* A curious learner who thrives on embedding with new business areas and absorbing how the work really gets done
* An empathetic builder who designs for the end user, not just the use case
* Pragmatic and outcomes‑driven, with a bias toward shipping useful, controlled solutions
* Highly attentive to detail and accuracy, with disciplined documentation and follow‑through
* A collaborative partner across business, technology, and risk stakeholders who communicates crisply and escalates effectively
* Comfortable operating in an emerging space where playbooks are still being written
* You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use.

**About Us**
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
  
  
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.
  
  
**Join us**
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

UBS Recruiting

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

What are our core values
  
  
Integrity
  
  
Determined
  
  
Innovative
  
  
Collaborative

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Senior**
As part of our EY GDS-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using ServiceNow platform. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Builds service request fulfilment workflow from customer requirements including requests, request items and tasks using workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc
* Uses scripting tools and Service Now functionality to automate rote tasks
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between Service-now and other systems as needed
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Authentication protocols such as Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Service Portal implementation experience
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications like Agentic AI, Gen AI, ITOM/HRSD/CSM/SPM/SecOps/IRM/ITSM, Flow designer, HAM, SAM, Integration, ITAM, Service Now Portal/UI Builder, SPM.
* Implementation experience on Performance Analytics.
* Knowledge of digital technologies like Machine learning, AI, IOT, Blockchain

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 4 to 6 years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification plus any CIS is mandatory
* ITIL foundations certification a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY ServiceNow practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Sr Data Architect
description:
embecta is a global medical device company with a 100-year legacy in insulin delivery and diabetes care. Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable production ETL/ELT pipelines across Azure, Databricks, and SAP source systems in accordance with enterprise architecture and engineering standards.
* Develop and optimize Databricks notebooks and jobs, Delta Lake tables, and Unity Catalog permissions to support BI reporting and AI/ML workloads.
* Integrate data from SAP S/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, and other enterprise applications into the lakehouse using Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent orchestration tools.
* Implement data-quality checks, monitoring, observability, and alerting so pipeline issues are identified and resolved before affecting downstream reporting or AI/ML consumers.
* Build and tune curated datasets and semantic models that support Power BI reporting, standard KPIs, and single-source-of-truth dashboards.
* Partner with data architects and senior engineers to define and implement enterprise data-integration patterns and reference architectures.
* Write clean, tested, and version-controlled code, and actively participate in code reviews and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
* Own pipeline reliability by troubleshooting production issues, participating in on-call or escalation rotations as needed, and documenting root causes and corrective actions.
* Collaborate within the Hub & Spoke model with analytics engineers and business teams to understand data needs and promote reusable data-product standards.
* Mentor junior data engineers on coding standards, pipeline design, troubleshooting, and platform conventions.
* Stay current on capabilities across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and the broader data-engineering landscape, and provide practical recommendations to the team.

**Experience & Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or a related data-platform engineering role.
* Hands-on experience building and operating pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks using Python, PySpark and/or Spark SQL, including Delta Lake table design.
* Experience designing and maintaining enterprise data pipelines in cloud environments, with attention to cost, performance, reliability, and scalability tradeoffs.
* Experience supporting both BI and AI/ML data needs, including curated datasets for Power BI and feature pipelines for model training.
* Preferred experience in manufacturing, supply chain, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* Willingness to work overlapping hours with US and other global stakeholders as needed for cross-time-zone collaboration.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Strong SQL and Python skills, supported by sound software-engineering practices in version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
* Working knowledge of Azure data services, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric or comparable cloud services.
* Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Datasphere data extraction is preferred.
* Knowledge of Databricks or modern lakehouse platforms, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog or similar access-control tooling.
* Experience with Power BI, enterprise analytics, semantic models, dimensional modeling, star schemas, and data-integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of data governance, data quality, monitoring, and observability practices.
* Clear, proactive verbal and written communication, including the ability to raise issues, document technical designs and decisions, and collaborate with architects, analysts, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to operate in a Hub & Spoke or federated data organization, following centrally established standards while adapting to domain-specific needs.
* Sound engineering judgment, a continuous-improvement mindset, and the ability to deliver reliable pipelines in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

* Strong presentation and documentation skills for creating architecture packs, RFP inputs, decision papers, solution options and executive-ready summaries.
* Structured delivery mindset with the ability to manage multiple workstreams across requirements, architecture, vendor assessment and implementation planning.
* Commercial awareness and ability to assess solution options through the lenses of time-to-value, total cost of ownership, implementation complexity and operational sustainability.
* **Team Leadership and Mentorship:**
* **Technical Guidance:**
  Lead and mentor engineers and architects, providing guidance on architecture decisions, integration design, coding standards, testing approach and delivery quality.
* **Delivery Enablement:**
  Support teams in converting architecture into executable backlogs, clarifying dependencies, resolving technical blockers and aligning implementation with target architecture.
* **Knowledge Sharing:**
  Build domain knowledge within the team on pricing processes, banking products, governance controls and integration patterns relevant to the Central Pricing Engine.
* Experience in Banking, Private Bank, Retail Banking, Wealth Management, product pricing, decisioning, rule engines or core banking transformation is strongly preferred.

title: Sr MLOps Engineer
description:
Senior MLOps Engineer

We are seeking an experienced Senior MLOps Engineer to build, deploy, and maintain secure,

scalable, and reliable machine learning infrastructure in production. In this role, you will work

closely with Data Science, Backend Engineering, and Product teams—as well as directly with

client stakeholders—to operationalize machine learning models and establish robust ML

engineering and deployment practices.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience across the end-to-end ML lifecycle,

with particular expertise in MLflow, model deployment, ML pipelines, CI/CD,

containerization, AWS infrastructure, model monitoring, and production reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• ML Model Deployment & Infrastructure: Design, deploy, containerize, and scale

machine learning models and inference services in production using Docker and AWS

services such as ECS, EKS, Lambda, and SageMaker.

• MLflow & Model Lifecycle Management: Build and maintain MLflow-based

workflows for experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, model

packaging, artifact management, and promotion of models across development,

staging, and production environments.

• ML Pipelines & Automation: Build and maintain automated ML pipelines covering

data preparation, model training, validation, experiment tracking, model registration,

deployment, and retraining.

• CI/CD & MLOps Automation: Develop CI/CD workflows that integrate MLflow with

model training and deployment pipelines. Implement automated testing, model

validation, artifact management, deployment strategies, and reliable rollback

mechanisms.

• Cloud Infrastructure: Design and manage production ML infrastructure on AWS,

including compute, networking, storage, IAM, monitoring, and other services required to

support machine learning workloads.

• Security & Access Control: Implement security best practices including least-privilege

IAM, secure secrets management, network isolation, encryption, role-based access

control, and appropriate controls for sensitive data and production ML systems.

• Model Monitoring & Observability: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging,

metrics, and alerting for production ML systems. Monitor model performance, inference

latency, resource utilization, data quality, data drift, model drift, and system reliability.

• Data & Model Reproducibility: Establish robust practices for tracking datasets,

MLflow experiments, model versions, parameters, metrics, configurations, dependencies,

and deployment artifacts to ensure reproducibility and traceability.

• Production Reliability: Ensure ML services meet production requirements for

availability, scalability, performance, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery.

MINDWISE TECHNOLOGIES PVT LTD

• Performance & Cost Optimization: Identify opportunities to optimize model inference,

compute resources, infrastructure architecture, and AWS costs while maintaining

production performance and reliability.

• Client Communication & Technical Ownership: Serve as a trusted technical voice

with clients, communicating infrastructure decisions, deployment architecture, security

practices, operational risks, and technical recommendations clearly and professionally.

Required Skills & Experience

• Experience: 4+ years of experience in MLOps, ML Engineering, DevOps, or a closely

related field, with hands-on experience deploying and operating machine learning

systems in production.

• MLflow: Strong hands-on experience with MLflow, including Experiment Tracking,

MLflow Projects, Model Registry, model versioning, artifact management, model

packaging, and deployment workflows. Candidates should have used MLflow as part

of a production or near-production MLOps environment.

• Machine Learning Lifecycle: Strong understanding of the end-to-end machine learning

lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, validation, experiment tracking,

model registration, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and model lifecycle management.

• Python & SQL: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building

production-grade services, automation scripts, and ML pipelines.

• Cloud Infrastructure (AWS): Deep hands-on experience with AWS services such as

IAM, VPC, S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, CloudWatch, and preferably SageMaker.

• Containerization & Orchestration: Strong experience with Docker and

Kubernetes/EKS for deploying and managing production ML workloads.

• CI/CD: Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins,

or equivalent, preferably with experience integrating MLflow into CI/CD workflows.

• ML Pipelines & Workflow Orchestration: Experience building automated ML

workflows using tools such as Airflow, Kubeflow, Prefect, or similar technologies.

• Model Monitoring & Observability: Experience implementing production monitoring,

logging, metrics, and alerting using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana,

Elasticsearch, or equivalent.

• Database & Data Systems: Good understanding of relational databases, data pipelines,

data storage, and infrastructure required to support production machine learning

workloads.

• Security: Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, network

security, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive data.

• Professional Standards: High sense of ownership, strong problem-solving ability,

security-first mindset, attention to reliability, and excellent client-facing communication

skills.

• Experience with AWS SageMaker or other managed ML platforms.

Good to Have

• Experience with Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, or similar ML/workflow orchestration

platforms.

• Experience with feature stores and model serving frameworks.

• Experience with data lake technologies such as S3, Glue, Athena, or Spark.

• Experience with GPU infrastructure and distributed model training/inference.

• Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.

• Familiarity with enterprise compliance standards such as SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR.

• Experience working directly with US or international enterprise clients.

• Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a

related field. Candidates from IITs, BITS, or other top-tier institutions would be

preferred.

description:

title: SAP Lead – Enterprise SAP Platform (S/4HANA RISE)
description:
Role purpose Mumbai (corporate office), with travel to project sites as needed The SAP Lead owns the company's enterprise SAP S/4HANA RISE landscape end to end: its stability, compliance, cost and evolution. The role is accountable for both Run (day-to-day operations and support) and Change (enhancements, new demand and projects). It moves the platform forward by cutting custom code, getting more from standard S/4HANA, and keeping the system clean for audit. The ideal candidate is a hands-on functional leader with deep PS, MM and FICO knowledge in a projectbased real estate business. They listen well, get to root causes, and keep both today's fixes and the longterm roadmap in view. They see SAP as a platform to transform the business, not just a system to maintain.Key responsibilities Accountability for Run and Change • Run: end-to-end accountability for keeping the SAP landscape stable, supported and compliant: incidents, service requests, problem management, month-end and year-end support, and partner SLAs. • Change / new demand: end-to-end accountability for enhancements, new business requirements and SAP projects: intake, solution design, estimation, prioritisation, delivery, testing and go-live. • Balance capacity and budget between Run and Change, and report status, risks and spend on both to the CTO/CIO.

1. Platform ownership and upkeep • Own availability, performance and stability of the S/4HANA RISE landscape (DEV / QA / PRD and any sandbox or pre-prod tiers). • Act as the company's single point of accountability with SAP and the RISE hyperscaler for service requests, incidents, system refreshes, upgrades and Feature Pack Stack (FPS) adoption. • Plan and govern release, upgrade and patch cycles, including regression testing of PS, MM and FICO processes and Z objects. • Drive transport management, change control (CAB), and environment hygiene. • Track RISE contractual SLAs and responsibilities (SAP vs. customer vs. partner) and escalate gaps.

2. Licence and FUE management • Actively manage Full Usage Equivalent (FUE) consumption against RISE contractual entitlements. • Run periodic user-type classification reviews (Advanced, Core, Self-Service) and align role design to the right licence category. • Reclaim inactive, duplicate and over-licensed users; prevent licence creep through role and provisioning controls. • Prepare for SAP licence audits and true-up negotiations with usage evidence; advise the CTO/CIO on renewal and FUE expansion decisions.

3. Custom code (Z landscape) rationalisation • Build and maintain an inventory of Z programs, reports, enhancements, user exits, BAdIs, forms and custom tables, with usage and business ownership. • Use tools such as ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), Custom Code Migration app, SCMON / usage procedure logging to identify unused, redundant and non-compliant code. • Define paths off Z wherever possible: replace with standard S/4HANA functionality, Fiori apps, CDS views, embedded analytics or clean-core extensibility (key-user, side-by-side on SAP BTP). • Set a clean-core governance policy: any new Z development needs a documented business case and architecture sign-off. • Track and report custom-code reduction against agreed targets.

4. Roles, authorisation, GRC and SoD • Review the current roles and authorisation landscape end to end; redesign toward a task-based, least-privilege, business-role model. • Own Segregation of Duties (SoD) rule sets, risk analysis and mitigation, using SAP GRC Access Control or equivalent (e.g. SAP Cloud IAG). • Run user-access reviews, firefighter / emergency access governance and periodic SoD recertification with business owners. • Link role design to FUE category so that access and licence cost stay aligned.

5. Audit and compliance • Spearhead internal, statutory and IT general controls (ITGC) audits for SAP: access, change management, interfaces, and IT-dependent business controls. • Coordinate evidence, close observations within agreed timelines, and prevent repeat findings. • Ensure SAP processes support Ind AS, GST, TDS, RERA-related project accounting and reporting needs, and data-protection obligations under India's DPDP Act.

6. Business engagement and process excellence • Be the trusted SAP partner for Finance, Costing & Budgeting, Contracting & Procurement and RA Billing teams, from the CFO and business leaders to the SAP operators who use the platform every day. • Stay close to SAP operators: run regular user forums, floor walks and feedback loops, and act on usability and training gaps. • Listen to business pain points, separate symptoms from root causes, and fix the process or the configuration, not just the ticket. • Run demand intake and prioritisation; balance tactical fixes against strategic roadmap items. • Drive adoption of standard functionality, Fiori, and analytics to reduce manual work and Excelbased workarounds.

7. Team and partner leadership • Lead, coach and grow 2–3 on-roll functional experts across PS, MM and FICO. • Manage 5–10 third-party AMS / partner resources: scope, SLAs, ticket quality, knowledge transfer and commercial performance. • Set ticket-handling standards, root-cause analysis (RCA) discipline and documentation practices. • Build succession and cross-skilling so that no module depends on a single person.

8. Strategy and roadmap • Own a 2–3 year SAP roadmap aligned with the company's digital and AI agenda: clean core, BTP extensions, integration, analytics and automation. • Evaluate SAP innovations (e.g. SAP Business AI / Joule, Signavio, Datasphere) and recommend what is worth adopting.• Work with enterprise architecture on integration with CRM, sales, construction / project management and data platforms.

Experience, qualifications and certifications

Must have • 10–20 years of SAP experience, with at least 5 years leading a team, an SAP Centre of Excellence, or a full landscape. • Deep hands-on expertise in at least one of PS, MM or FICO, and strong working command of the other two. • At least 2 end-to-end implementations or major rollouts, including at least one S/4HANA implementation or ECC-to-S/4HANA conversion. • Experience in real estate, construction, infrastructure or EPC companies, especially RA billing and project costing. • Proven ownership of roles, authorisation and SoD remediation, and of SAP audits (internal, statutory, ITGC). • Track record managing third-party AMS or SI partners against SLAs and commercial terms. Good to have • Experience running SAP on RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition. • Hands-on involvement in licence audits, FUE optimisation or contract renewals.• A custom-code reduction or clean-core programme with measurable results. • Exposure to SAP BTP, Fiori, embedded analytics, and SAP Business AI. Education

Graduate in engineering, commerce or finance. CA, ICWA / CMA or MBA (Finance / Operations) is a strong plus for the FICO and costing side. Certifications (current SAP versions or equivalent) •

Required: at least one SAP S/4HANA functional certification in Finance, Management Accounting, Sourcing & Procurement, or Project Systems / Portfolio & Project Management. • Preferred: SAP Activate Project Manager; SAP GRC Access Control or SAP S/4HANA security / authorisation certification; SAP BTP or clean-core extensibility. • Valued: ITIL 4 Foundation; PMP or PRINCE2; CISA (for audit-facing work).

title: GPU Infrastructure Engineer / HPC Engineer
description:
Build and operate large?scale GPU compute pods to deliver predictable, high?throughput, low?latency training and inference services across 10K GPU cluster.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Implementation

Stand up multi?pod GPU clusters (rack/power/cooling layouts; TOR/leaf connectivity; IB/Ethernet host configs).
  
  
Implement GPU partitioning (MIG/vGPU profiles) and quota policies for multi?tenant environments.
  
  
Integrate cluster schedulers (Slurm/Kubernetes) with GPU device plugins, node feature discovery, and accounting/quotas.
  
  

* Operations

Own day?2 operations across firmware/driver/DCGM/NVML lifecycles; execute change windows with zero/low downtime.
  
  
Capacity planning (GPU/CPU/Memory/NIC) and bin?packing strategies for heterogeneous GPU SKUs.
  
  

* Performance & Optimization

Tune NCCL/UCX, GPU clocks/persistence, GPU Direct Storage, NUMA/locality, and CUDA runtime parameters.
  
  
Drive benchmarking and acceptance (HPL, HPL?AI, MLPerf?like internal suites); track perf regressions with SLOs.
  
  

* Reliability & Incident

Lead P0/P1 incident response for GPU, CUDA, or scheduler issues; perform root?cause and preventative actions.
  
  
Act as the primary technical lead during production outages, coordinating cross-functional teams across Networking, GPU Operations, Platform Engineering, Storage, and Application teams to restore services within SLA targets.
  
  
Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for network, GPU, CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, and scheduler-related failures, identifying underlying causes and implementing preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Collaborate with platform and GPU engineering teams to resolve issues impacting CUDA jobs, Kubernetes scheduling, Slurm workload management, GPU resource allocation, and large-scale AI training environments.
  
  
Define golden images; implement node remediation (cordon/drain/reimage) and auto?healing workflows.
  
  

* Security & Compliance

Enforce GPU tenancy isolation (MIG, cgroup/device cgroup, mpsd), secure drivers/containers, SBOM and image scanning.
  
  

* Documentation & Enablement

Publish
**runbooks**
, performance baselines, and application tuning guides for LLM training and inference.
  
  
**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
NVIDIA Certified Professional (AI Infrastructure); Linux (RHCE/LPIC) preferred.
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 7–12 years building/operating HPC/AI GPU clusters at scale; deep CUDA/MIG/vGPU expertise.
* Proven with H100/B?series class GPUs, Slurm and/or Kubernetes device scheduling; NCCL/UCX performance tuning.

* CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT; 2. DCGM/NVML, nvidia-smi; 3. Slurm, K8s (device plugin, DaemonSets, NFD); 4. Helm/ArgoCD; 6. GPUDirect Storage; 7. Prometheus/Grafana; 8. ELK/Splunk.

* Serve as the organizational Smartsheet subject-matter expert, participating in vendor programs, user groups, roadmap reviews, and product previews.

Enablement & Adoption

* Improved stakeholder satisfaction with Smartsheet and PMO Operations services.

title: Lead Technical Onboarding Engineer
description:
**About Neo4j**
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.
  
  
Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.
  
  
**Our Vision**
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.
  
  
As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.
  
  
**About The Job**
You will play a critical, hands-on role in guiding enterprise customers through the foundational stages of their deployment journey. As a
**player-coach and technical anchor for a focused four-person onboarding team**
, you will split your time between directly delivering complex customer onboardings and serving as the day-to-day technical escalation point and mentor for three fellow engineers.
  
  
Sitting at the intersection of technical architecture and customer delivery, you will bridge the gap between a signed contract and a production-ready ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, steering customers through critical infrastructure milestones—including cloud provisioning, security hardening, networking, data modelling, and application integration.
  
  
For fully managed AuraDB cloud customers, you will leverage automation to optimise data modelling, enterprise connectivity, and application health. For self-managed environments, you will apply rigorous Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform engineering practices to deploy secure, resilient graph clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud architectures.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Hands-on Technical Onboarding (~70–80%)**

* Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to define success criteria, milestones, architecture patterns, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Guide the provisioning of Neo4j AuraDB environments and self-managed clusters across AWS, Azure, and GCP, establishing secure network architectures using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, and peering.
* Implement baseline system hardening, TLS/SSL termination, encryption-at-rest protocols, and enforce least-privileged access through enterprise SSO (OIDC/SAML) and RBAC configurations.
* Architect robust data ingestion pipelines (bulk imports, stream processing, Change Data Capture) and advise customer development teams on Neo4j driver optimisation, connection pooling, and retry logic.
* Assist customers in configuring enterprise observability tools (logs and metrics) and deliver best-practice guidance on Cypher query performance and backup/restore planning.
* Produce high-quality technical deliverables—including architecture diagrams, Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), and runbooks—to ensure smooth operational handoffs.

**Technical Mentorship & Team Escalation (~20–30%)**

* Serve as the senior technical point of escalation for the onboarding team, unblocking colleagues on complex customer architectures and troubleshooting edge-case issues.
* Pair with and mentor team members through design reviews, architecture discussions, and customer engagements to continuously elevate collective technical execution.
* Help balance day-to-day account coverage across the team to maintain consistent onboarding velocity and delivery quality.
* Synthesise field insights, lessons learned, and reusable blueprints to iterate and optimise our core onboarding methodologies, tooling, and onboarding automation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Onboarding Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Platform Engineering, or Technical Consulting), with informal or formal experience acting as a technical lead, mentor, or escalation point.
* Proven track record of operating in a hands-on "player-coach" capacity—comfortable rolling up your sleeves on implementation while guiding peers.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying production workloads in at least one major cloud ecosystem (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep technical proficiency in core enterprise networking (VPC/VNet architectures, routing protocols, peering, and PrivateLink/Private Endpoints).
* Demonstrated experience configuring Enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM), including SSO (OIDC/SAML) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform, alongside configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible).
* Experience with Linux administration, containerisation, and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed container services).
* Hands-on experience with graph databases (ideally Neo4j) and proficiency in query performance tuning (e.g., Cypher optimisation).
* Familiarity with modern observability stacks (Grafana/Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch, Splunk) and enterprise data integration/ETL/CDC tools.
* Exposure to cloud compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA) and multi-region/data residency deployment patterns.

title: RIS ServiceNow Solution Architect Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a seasoned ServiceNow Solution Architect to join our Digital Core ServiceNow Solutioning team. In this role, candidate will own end-to-end solutioning for complex ServiceNow engagements. Successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, delivery leads, and technical teams to architect scalable, platform-aligned solutions that drive measurable business value.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Lead solution design and architecture for ServiceNow implementations across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SecOps, and/or App Engine modules (not limited to these modules. The scope should cover entire ServiceNow platform)
  
  
Translate complex business requirements into scalable, best-practice ServiceNow architectures and technical blueprints.
  
  
Drive pre-sales and solutioning activities including RFP responses, effort estimation, solution proposals and client presentations.
  
  
Act as the technical authority in client workshops, ensuring alignment between business outcomes and platform capabilities.
  
  
Define integration patterns, data models and governance frameworks in collaboration with enterprise architects and delivery teams.
  
  
Conduct solution reviews and architecture assessments; identify risks, technical debt and optimization opportunities.
  
  
Participate in client orals and visits to showcase our capabilities & solutions

Stay current with ServiceNow platform roadmap, new product releases and emerging capabilities; bring proactive recommendations to clients.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
8–10 (Associate Manager) and 11-14 (Manager) years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 5 years in ServiceNow architecture, implementation and solutioning roles.
  
  
Demonstrated expertise in at least two ServiceNow product lines (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, GRC, SecOps, SPM, or Creator/App Engine).
  
  
Strong command of ServiceNow platform fundamentals: Flow Designer, Service Catalog, CMDB, Integrations (REST/SOAP/MID), ACLs, and Scripting (Server/Client).
  
  
Proven experience leading solution workshops, architecture reviews and stakeholder-facing technical discussions.
  
  
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow integrations using tools such as IntegrationHub, Dell Boomi, MuleSoft or similar middleware.
  
  
Active ServiceNow certifications — CIS in at least two modules; CTA or CSA designations preferred.
  
  
Familiarity with ITIL v4, Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF is a plus).

Prior consulting or advisory experience in a Big 4, SI or product-led organization.
  
  
Exposure to multi-instance or enterprise-scale ServiceNow environments with complex org structures.
  
  
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) in the context of ServiceNow deployments.
  
  
Soft Skills & Leadership Attributes
  
  
Executive presence with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and C-suite audiences.
  
  
Strong consultative mindset — ability to listen, understand business pain points and translate them into platform-led solutions.
  
  
Collaborative team player who can influence without authority across cross-functional delivery teams.
  
  
Structured problem-solver with a bias for action; comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-paced environments.
  
  
Ownership mentality — takes accountability for solution quality, delivery outcomes and client satisfaction.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; adept at creating solution documents, architecture decks, and executive summaries.
  
  
Intellectual curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, particularly around ServiceNow platform evolution and enterprise technology trends.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.

* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go-to-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go-to-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.

* ML Engineer: Build and maintain production-grade cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) infrastructure that supports the deployment of ML applications, including drift monitoring.
* AI Engineer: Experience with the latest techniques in LLMs & agentic systems, including vector databases, fine-tuning LLMs, AI guardrail systems, and deploying LLMs with tools such as HuggingFace, Langchain, and OpenAI
* Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience
* Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike
* Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through ML & AI
* [Preferred] 2+ years customer-facing experience in a pre-sales or post-sales role
* Can meet expectations for technical training and role-specific outcomes within 3 months of hire

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: Architect, SAP BTP & Integration
description:

From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. The
**SAP BTP Integration Architect**
owns the architecture, engineering standards, and technical governance for integrations across Pall's global SAP and non-SAP landscape. The role leads secure, scalable integration design on SAP Business Technology Platform, with particular focus on SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, business applications, external partners, and government e-invoicing platforms.
  
  
This position reports to the IT Director, Enterprise Applications and is part of the global Information Technology team. The role is based in India, and will operate in a onsite work model, subject to local site requirements.
  
  
**In this role you will have the opportunity to**

* Define and maintain the enterprise integration strategy and architecture, including standards, principles, reusable patterns, and governance using SAP Integration Suite and SAP best practices.
* Lead end-to-end integration architecture and solution design across SAP Integration Suite capabilities, selecting the appropriate API, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, batch, file, and B2B/EDI approaches based on business needs.
* Architect secure integrations across the SAP and enterprise technology landscape, including SAP S/4HANA, DRC, Ariba, BTP solutions, third-party applications, suppliers, customers, and government platforms.
* Establish integration, API, event, and security governance, including identity and access, authentication, authorization, encryption, versioning, lifecycle management, reuse, privacy, and segregation of duties.
* Enable AI-assisted and emerging technology solutions, including Joule and Joule Studio, by providing secure APIs, events, business context, appropriate controls, observability, and human oversight.
* Ensure integration reliability, compliance, and modernization, including monitoring, error handling, performance, service levels, clean-core alignment, regulatory requirements, global e-invoicing, and migration of legacy interfaces such as SAP PI/PO.
* Provide technical leadership and oversight, including architecture reviews, design documentation, technical risk assessments, partner deliverables, developer/consultant mentoring, complex issue resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of SAP architecture experience, including at least 5 years delivering solutions on SAP BTP, with hands-on experience with Joule.
* Demonstrated leadership of complex SAP transformation programs, including at least three end-to-end SAP BTP integration implementations or comparable enterprise initiatives.
* Deep expertise in SAP Integration Suite and BTP architecture, including Cloud Integration, API Management, event-driven integration, hybrid connectivity, identity services, environments and runtimes, monitoring, CI/CD, and secure operations.
* Strong SAP and enterprise integration expertise, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with SAP and non-SAP platforms using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, messaging technologies, XML, JSON, XSLT, and Groovy.
* Experience designing secure, reliable, and AI-enabled enterprise integrations, including Joule/AI agents, API and tool access, authorization, auditability, OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates, mutual TLS, exception handling, performance, availability, and responsible AI controls.
* Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to translate business, technical, security, and compliance requirements into architecture decisions and lead internal teams and external partners through design, build, testing, deployment, hyper care, and operational transition.

**Travel**

* Up to 20 percent travel, including international travel, based on project and deployment needs.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in**

* SAP Integration Advisor, Trading Partner Management, Advanced Event Mesh, SAP Cloud ALM, or comparable observability and service-management tooling.
* Current SAP certification in Integration Suite, BTP solution architecture, or a closely related discipline.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Staff Engineer - Platform
description:
**About SolarSquare :**

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

**About the role :**

As a Staff Engineer on Platform, you own the developer and infrastructure platform the entire engineering org builds on - cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that eliminates mundane, repeated work. You set the direction for how we run software at scale, and you stay hands-on doing it.

**What you'll own :**

- Design and operate a cloud-native platform (Kubernetes-based) and the paved-road tooling teams build on.

- Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and developer experience - automate the mundane so engineers focus on impact.

- Drive reliability and SRE practices : observability, incident response, and root-cause fixes that stick.

- Optimize for performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns across the platform.

- Build internal developer-platform capabilities and standards that make the right way the easy way; mentor across pods.

**Tech Stack :**
We run on AWS with Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Redis, and Kafka.

**What we're looking for :**

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, with deep distributed-systems fundamentals.

- Expertise in cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Strong observability and reliability practice across service boundaries; you measure, then improve.

- A track record building internal platforms or developer tooling that others adopt.

- Attention to performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns.

- Customer-obsessed and impact-led : you start from the customer's pain and judge yourself by the metric your work moves, not the tickets you close.

- High agency : you don't wait to be told - you spot problems, pick them up, and own the outcome through to production.

- Craft over shortcuts : you fix root causes rather than symptoms, clear tech debt as you go, and don't ship bugs.

- Bias for speed and simplicity : you build once for reuse, automate the mundane, and let AI draft the first pass so your judgment goes where it matters.

- Data-driven : you reach for evidence over assumptions and let results guide the next decision.

**Bonus points :**

- Experience with internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service infrastructure, or DevEx initiatives.

- Cost-optimization or large-scale reliability engineering experience.

- Comfort building automation and agents that remove operational toil.

**Why you'll love building here :**

- Direct ownership of high-impact initiatives with visible customer and business outcomes.

- An AI-native engineering culture with first-class tooling and internal agents.

- A high-agency, low-bureaucracy environment where you debate what's right and ship.

- A meritocracy where growth and recognition track impact, not tenure.

- Competitive compensation.

- A front-row seat to putting clean energy on millions of Indian rooftops.

title: Lead Quantitative Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
  
  
In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005), Hong Kong (2007), Shanghai (2012) and Singapore (2021). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are looking for multiple experienced Quantitative Engineers to lead our strategy technology teams in India, focused on building trading strategies for Indian markets and beyond.
  
  
In this role you will work closely with traders and researchers, driving the design and delivery of quantitative trading systems. These systems will be deployed across Indian exchanges (NSE, BSE, MCX) and other APAC exchanges traded by Optiver. You will work at the intersection of trading and technology, shaping the architecture of Optiver’s expansion into systematic strategies.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will be expected to lead by example. As a technical lead you will mentor and guide other members of the team.
  
  
You won’t be doing this in isolation - you’ll collaborate closely with established teams in Sydney, while contributing to Optiver’s broader strategy across APAC.
  
  
Our engineers own problems end-to-end - from understanding trading challenges to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions into live markets. Development is fast-paced and impactful, with features often reaching production within days.
  
  
**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Design and implement quantitative trading systems. This will include C++ auto-traders plus tooling for traders and researchers.
* Mentor a team of high-performance engineers.
* Partner with trading and research to improve trading systems.
* Drive a culture of engineers focused on the trading problem.
* Contribute to the strategy and vision for Optiver’s Asia Pacific systematic trading capability.
* Drive robustness and quality through strong engineering practices, including code reviews, testing, and production monitoring.
* Collaborate across global teams to share knowledge and influence broader system design.

**Who You Are**
We’re looking for an experienced quantitative engineer with a proven ability to successfully partner with traders and researchers on challenging trading problems. You should have:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of experience as a Quantitative Engineer working closely with traders and researchers.
* Experience making architectural decisions for quantitative trading systems.
* Proven ability to solve technically challenging problems, with a pragmatic and results-driven mindset.
* Experience applying machine learning techniques to trading.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with trading, research, and other business teams.
* Experience leading projects as a technical owner, driving delivery and influencing design decisions.

If you have any of these, we’re even more excited to hear from you:
  
  
  

* Experience working on systematic strategies for options products within a similar trading firm.
* Experience directly leading a team.

**What You'll Get**

* A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

Optiver is committed to
  
  
diversity and inclusion
  
  
  
  
We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via
  
  
careers@optiver.com.au

title: Staff Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Staff Compiler Performance Engineer**
to set the technical direction for Falcon performance. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: Falcon is mature and runs in production at large enterprises. You will decide where the next significant performance gains come from, lead the design of the optimizations that deliver them, and make sure the compiler architecture supports the product roadmap.

  

You will be the senior technical voice on a distributed team of compiler experts and a key partner for runtime, GC and product teams.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Define the performance strategy for Falcon: identify the largest opportunities across benchmarks and customer workloads and turn them into a technical roadmap
  
* Lead design of complex, cross cutting optimizations in the optimizer and code generator, and of the interfaces between the compiler, the runtime and the garbage collector
  
* Make architectural decisions on the Falcon optimization pipeline, compile time budget and tiering strategy
  
* Lead enablement of Falcon on new hardware platforms and new Azul products
  
* Mentor senior engineers, review critical designs and code, and set standards for performance methodology and validation
  
* Represent Azul in the LLVM community: drive upstream design discussions and contributions that benefit managed language compilers
  

  
**What You'll Bring (aka Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 8+ years of professional experience developing optimizing compilers or JIT compilers
  
* Track record of technical leadership: owning the design of major compiler components or optimization frameworks used in production
  
* Expert C++ skills and experience in large, long lived codebases
  
* Deep expertise in compiler optimization and code generation, with a clear view of the tradeoffs between peak performance, compile time, warmup and code size
  
* Expert performance analysis skills down to the microarchitecture level
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Recognized contributions to LLVM or another major compiler: code owner, maintainer or author of significant upstream work
  
* Deep experience with JIT compilers for managed languages: HotSpot C2, Graal, V8, .NET RyuJIT or similar
  
* Experience working closely with runtime and GC teams on speculation, deoptimization and barrier design

title: Agentic AI Builder
description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today, our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We are optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation.

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide from offices in many countries. Our AI and Data teams combine data science, generative AI, and engineering to take solutions from proof of concept to large-scale deployment.

Our Mumbai office launched in 2024. We are building the team with people who want to shape something from the ground up, combining the agility of a start-up with the backing and reach of a global brand. The AI Factory in Mumbai builds and delivers production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients across North America, Europe and the Middle East.

**Job Description**

Generative AI is moving from assistants that answer questions to agents that do work. The Agentic AI Builder designs, builds and industrialises AI agents and multi-agent workflows for Sia's enterprise clients, and helps users adopt them. You will turn real business processes into agents that perform reliably in production.
  
  
This is agent engineering, not prompt writing or chatbot configuration. You will work with Forward Deployed Engineers, architects, consultants, and client teams, and you are expected to reason about orchestration, state, tools, evaluation, security, and cost, and to show with tests and measurements that an agent works.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with consultants and business teams to identify agent use cases and translate business processes into clear agent requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Design agent architectures for business workflows, deciding when a single agent, a multi-agent pattern or a deterministic workflow with LLM steps is the right choice.
* Implement orchestration, tool calling and control flow in Python using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, the Claude Agent SDK or OpenAI SDK, or custom code where that is the better choice.
* Build tools and connectors to enterprise APIs and data sources, including MCP servers, with clear schemas, error handling and permissioning.
* Engineer context deliberately: retrieval over enterprise data, prompt and context design, and state and memory management across steps and sessions.
* Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approvals, escalation and exception handling.
* Create evaluation suites covering task success, tool-use correctness, regressions and adversarial cases, and use them to guide each release.
* Add observability, including traces, token and cost tracking and failure analytics, and optimise for reliability, latency and cost.
* Implement guardrails such as input and output validation, scoped credentials, prompt-injection defenses, and data-access controls.
* Work in agile, iterative cycles: estimate effort, flag risks and dependencies early, run solution demonstrations, and document agent behaviour and limits.
* Prepare agents for production with the FDE and architecture team, including deployment, monitoring, and operational handover.

**Internal Contributions**
  
As part of the AI Factory, you will also:

* Package reusable tools, connectors, and agent patterns that speed up later projects.
* Contribute to internal accelerators, demonstrations, and proposals.
* Share knowledge on agent design, evaluation, and guardrails with the wider engineering team.

**Qualifications**

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 to 6 years of software or AI engineering experience.
* At least one agent or LLM workflow delivered beyond proof of concept, with evidence of how it was tested and measured.
* Professional English, written and spoken.

**Technical skills (required)**

* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, typing and asynchronous programming.
* Hands-on experience building agents with tool calling and orchestration using at least one agent framework or SDK (LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI SDK or equivalent). Experience with every named framework is not expected.
* Understanding of agent state, memory and control flow, including retries, timeouts and failure recovery.
* Practical experience with RAG and vector search, and with context and prompt engineering as part of a larger system.
* Experience evaluating LLM and agent behaviour with test sets, automated checks or LLM-as-judge methods.
* Familiarity with LLM observability and tracing, and with tracking cost and latency.
* Experience integrating agents with enterprise APIs, databases or SaaS applications.
* Awareness of agent-specific risks, including prompt injection, excessive tool permissions and data leakage, and how guardrails address them.
* Cloud deployment fundamentals: containers, environment configuration and CI/CD.

**Consulting and collaboration**

* Ability to explain technical decisions and limits clearly to engineers, architects, and non-technical colleagues. Comfort running solution demonstrations and gathering feedback from business users.
* Ownership of the components you build and the ability to work with geographically distributed teams.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or hosting an MCP server.
* Experience with multi-agent patterns such as planner and executor, supervisor, or handoff designs.
* Experience with automation platforms such as n8n or Microsoft Copilot Studio alongside code-first approaches.
* Exposure to model routing, fine-tuning, or model selection trade-offs.
* FastAPI or other backend service experience; Kubernetes and infrastructure as code basics.Experience in a regulated sector or collaboration with international teams and clients.

**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on production AI for global enterprise clients, as part of a growing AI engineering capability.
* The chance to learn through real client implementations and to build reusable agent assets for the AI Factory.
* Access to Sia's leadership and training programmes as you grow.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary team working across varied projects and industries.

**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)
  
  
  
  
Equal Opportunity**
  
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Decisions on hiring, promotion, remuneration and discipline are made solely on performance, competence, conduct and business needs.
