title: Platform & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of our infrastructure, right from the bare-metal hardware and hypervisor layers up to container orchestration and application delivery.

In this role, you will act as the technical anchor for our architecture, automation, security, and day-to-day IT operations across virtualized and on-premise/bare-metal environments. You will be responsible for building a hardened, production-ready Kubernetes cluster from the ground up, implementing zero-trust network security, managing storage solutions, and driving automated CI/CD pipelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Systems & Virtualization Engineering:**

* Provision, tune, and manage bare-metal hosts and Linux-based virtual machines (VMs).
* Drive the shift from manual configurations to declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management.
* Perform L3 troubleshooting across physical servers, guest OS, and virtualized storage volumes.

**Network Security & Access Management:**

* Architect, scale, and maintain secure mesh overlay networks and point-to-point VPNs.
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, network micro-segmentation, and identity-aware routing across hosts, developer endpoints, and infrastructure tiers.
* Debug end-to-end network connectivity, routing partitions, MTU mismatches, and firewall/access control issues in hybrid setups.

**Production Kubernetes (K8s) Architecture & Hardening:**

* Design, bootstrap, secure, and operate high-availability (HA), production-grade Kubernetes clusters on self-managed infrastructure.
* Enforce strict InfoSec baselines: cluster RBAC, secret management/rotation, runtime security, admission controllers, and pod-to-pod network policies.
* Architect highly durable persistent storage solutions, integrate Container Storage Interface (CSI) drivers, and manage volume encryption, snapshots, and Disaster Recovery (DR).

**Observability, Monitoring & SRE:**

* Deploy and scale a comprehensive, full-stack observability platform for metrics, distributed tracing, and centralized log aggregation.
* Instrument proactive alerting, health checks, and dashboards across hosts, hypervisors, and container workloads to drastically reduce MTTR.

**CI/CD & DevSecOps Implementation:**

* Build, optimize, and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for seamless delivery of both application and infrastructure code.
* Integrate automated security checkpoints (Shift-Left security), including container image scanning, vulnerability assessments, and policy-as-code validations.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:**
  B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, IT, MCA, or related field.
* **Core Experience:**
  7+ years of hands-on, progressive experience in DevOps, Systems Engineering, SRE, or Platform Engineering.

**Required Skills**

* **Linux Mastery:**
  Deep internal knowledge of Linux OS, kernel tuning, networking primitives, block devices, and file systems.
* **Bare-Metal & Private Cloud:**
  Proven capability in deploying, securing, and maintaining self-managed hypervisors and virtualization ecosystems natively (without reliance on public cloud managed services).
* **Self-Hosted Kubernetes:**
  Extensive hands-on experience bootstrapping and troubleshooting production-grade bare-metal/on-prem K8s clusters (managing control planes, etcd quorums, CNI plugins, CSI drivers, and Ingress).
* **Networking & Security:**
  Strong grasp of encrypted overlay networks, modern VPN protocols, SDN, and advanced firewalling. Practical experience with zero-trust architectures, mTLS, credential management, and workload isolation.
* **Automation/IaC:**
  Expert-level proficiency in automating infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience setting up and managing GitOps-driven workflows for cluster and infrastructure lifecycle management.
* Hands-on expertise with configuring distributed, clustered, or networked storage backends for container ecosystems.

title: Head of Data Strategy and Platform
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Head of Data Strategy and Platform, SCB India is accountable for defining and executing the country's data strategy, data architecture roadmap, data governance framework, and enterprise data platform build-out. The role will lead the establishment of a modern, scalable, secure and compliant data ecosystem that supports regulatory reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI innovation, automation and sustainable business growth.
* The role is responsible for creating a unified country data architecture, supporting business and functional stakeholders in defining strategic data requirements, and working closely with Group Chief Data Office (CDO) and Technology teams to implement a future-ready enterprise data platform aligned to global standards and local regulatory obligations.
* In addition, the role will lead the central India NFRR reporting function to drive accuracy, efficiency, automation and control in regulatory reporting processes.
* The role will also serve as the designated Data Privacy Officer (DPO) for India, ensuring compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) and applicable Group data privacy requirements, whilst embedding privacy-by-design principles across business and technology initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Strategy and Transformation**

* Define and execute the India Data Strategy aligned to business objectives, Group Data Strategy and regulatory expectations.
* Establish a long-term roadmap for data architecture, governance, platform modernisation and data-driven innovation.
* Partner with business, functional and technology leaders to identify strategic data capabilities required to support growth, productivity and transformation.
* Champion data as a strategic asset and promote a data-driven culture across the organisation.

**Data Platform and Architecture**

* Lead the design and implementation of India's enterprise data platform and associated data ecosystem.
* Define target-state architecture, operating model and capability roadmap for structured and unstructured data management.
* Partner with Group CDO, Enterprise Architecture and Technology teams to deliver scalable, resilient and cloud-enabled data capabilities.
* Ensure platform designs meet requirements relating to availability, resilience, performance, security and regulatory compliance.
* Drive adoption of common data standards, data models, metadata management and data lineage capabilities.

**Data Governance and Data Quality**

* Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks for critical data elements, data ownership and stewardship.
* Support identification and management of data domains, critical data elements (CDEs), metadata repositories and lineage requirements.
* Define and implement data quality standards, controls, monitoring and remediation processes.
* Ensure effective governance of data life cycle management, retention and usage.

**Regulatory Reporting and NFRR Leadership**

* Lead the central India NFRR reporting team and oversee delivery of accurate, timely and complete regulatory reporting obligations.
* Drive automation and transformation of regulatory reporting processes through data and technology-enabled solutions.
* Strengthen controls, governance and audit readiness across reporting activities.
* Partner with Finance, Risk, Compliance and Technology teams to ensure continued regulatory compliance and reporting effectiveness.

**Data Privacy Officer (DPO) Responsibilities**

* Act as the designated Data Privacy Officer for India under applicable DPDPA requirements.
* Establish and oversee the country's privacy governance framework.
* Advise senior management on privacy obligations, compliance requirements and risk mitigation strategies.
* Monitor compliance with privacy laws, Group policies and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate privacy incident response activities and engagement with regulators where required.
* Promote privacy awareness, training and privacy-by-design principles across business and technology initiatives.

**Analytics, AI and Innovation Enablement**

* Enable advanced analytics, AI, machine learning and automation initiatives through robust enterprise data capabilities.
* Drive prioritisation of use cases that improve productivity, client experience, operational efficiency and risk management.
* Ensure data readiness and governance controls are embedded in AI and analytics programmes.
* Promote responsible data and AI practices aligned to regulatory and Group expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with country and cluster business heads to understand strategic priorities and define platform requirements.
* Act as the primary country interface for Group CDO and central data transformation programmes.
* Influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, risk and operational functions to deliver enterprise-wide outcomes.
* Represent India data priorities in regional and Group governance forums.

**Risk Management and Controls**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable internal policies, regulatory requirements and risk management frameworks.
* Maintain strong controls over data security, information management, cyber resilience and third-party data risks.
* Identify, assess and mitigate risks arising from data management, privacy and regulatory reporting processes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency and conduct consistent with the Bank's values.

**People Leadership**

* Team leadership: Set direction for the team, role‑modelling inclusive leadership and high standards of client focus, risk discipline and collaboration.
* Performance and conduct: Set clear expectations, remove obstacles to delivery, provide regular and constructive feedback, and reinforce expected conduct and standards.
* Coaching and development: Uplift the capability of the team by developing the skills, judgement, and experience required to perform effectively and progress in their careers over time.
* Thought Leadership and Market Positioning: Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients to strengthen strategic engagement and reinforce the Bank's market position. Partner with Industry, Product and Advisory teams to develop thought leadership content and client engagement initiatives.

**Our Ideal Candidate**
**Skills & Experience**

* 15+ years of relevant experience
* Extensive experience in building enterprise level data domain, data platforms and data querying solutions.
* Deep understanding of the data integrity, lineage, dictionary and data domain definition requirements.
* Strong understanding of banking domain, operational processes and controls including sensitive data management and access controls.
* Strong background in leading and managing a global workforce covering Operations and Technology domains within international firm/organisation
* Stays current in knowledge with a focus on the future of technology
* Self-motivated leader with a growth mindset
* Advanced level communicator, with ability to influence and manage stakeholders from various seniority and backgrounds, preferably with international exposure
* Highly innovative and current in application of human centred design principles
* Leads on 'agile' as a way of working and proven experience transforming tech organisations to agile
* Builds a culture and environment that attracts and retains top technology talent including driving hard on Diversity and Inclusion
* Extensive leadership experience in enterprise data strategy, data architecture and large-scale data platform transformation.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management and data lineage frameworks.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale cloud and modern data platform solutions.
* Deep understanding of regulatory reporting and control environments within financial services.
* Strong knowledge of data privacy regulations and governance requirements.
* Experience working across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills at executive level.
* Strong programme leadership and change management capabilities.
* Experience within global banking or financial services organisations.
* Exposure to AI, advanced analytics and data science enablement platforms.
* Experience implementing enterprise data governance and privacy operating models.

**Education**

* Relevant Degree qualification required
* Relevant certifications in data management, data architecture, privacy or cloud technologies.

Role Specific Competencies
  
  
**Priority Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Enterprise Data Strategy
* Enterprise Data Architecture
* Enterprise Data Platforms
* Data Governance and Management
* Data Analysis and Visualisation
* Data Privacy and DPDPA
* Regulatory / NFRR Reporting
* Data Risk, Controls and Compliance
* Technology & Data Transformation Leadership
* Agile Project Management
* Artificial Intelligence (AI)
* Emerging Technologies
* Regulatory Environment – Financial Services
* Senior Stakeholder Management

**Other Skills**

* Cloud Data Architecture
* Metadata and Data Lineage Tooling
* AI Governance
* Data Security and Cyber knowledge
* Data Lifecycle and Records Management
* Transformation & Change Management
* Vendor/ Product Management
* Commercial & Investment Management
* Agile / Product Operating Models
* Executive Communication

title: Principal Engineer - Trading Platform
description:
**Job Summary**
Our trading platform is the engine the fund runs on. We're looking for the engineer who will own it — the architecture, the code, and the team that builds it.
  
  
You will set the technical direction and make the hard architectural calls, and you will stay deep in the code, building the most critical and latency-sensitive parts yourself. You will lead a strong engineering team, and you will be accountable for everything the platform does in live markets: that it's fast from tick to trade, that it's correct, that it stays up while markets are open, and that it behaves safely with real capital.
  
  
This is a builder's leadership role. You own the outcomes across the whole platform — including its connectivity, colocation, resilience, security, and regulatory posture — and you will shape the infrastructure and the exchange, broker, and vendor relationships beneath it. What this is not is an IT-administration job: as we grow, dedicated infrastructure and operations support will carry the hands-on run-work so you stay focused on building and leading.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* The architecture and technical direction of the platform end to end — market data, signal, execution, and risk — and the calls that shape how it's built.
* The hardest code. You design and build the critical, latency-sensitive components yourself, and set the engineering standard the team builds to.
* The tick-to-trade path: finding and winning back latency across ingestion, decision, and order placement, and keeping it predictable under load.
* Risk and safety in the system — the pre-trade and at-trade controls that keep the platform from doing damage with real money. These are the controls that have to hold even when everything else is failing.
* Own the testing and staged-rollout discipline that makes changes safe to ship.
* The team — hiring, mentoring senior engineers, owning delivery, and raising the bar.
* Reliability in live markets: uptime through the session, fault tolerance that fails safe, monitoring of both the systems and what they produce (fills, PnL, slippage), incident response during market hours, and the hardening that follows.
* The platform's connection to the outside world — exchange and market-data feeds, the OMS, brokers — and accountability for the leased lines, colocation, physical infrastructure, redundancy, and failover beneath it, including getting new venues (NSE, BSE, MCX) certified and connected and coordinating the exchanges, brokers, and vendors behind them.
* Resilience and continuity — backup connectivity, disaster recovery, and business-continuity planning, tested with real drills.
* Security and governance — setting the security and governance policies, building access control, secrets, and auditability in, and keeping the platform ready for SEBI and exchange scrutiny.
* Scale — growing the platform with data, accounts, strategies, new markets, and AUM, and partnering with research and operations to turn what they need into systems that hold up.

**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**

* You know the platform cold, and the team ships through you without you being the bottleneck.
* Tick-to-trade latency and uptime are measured, understood, and trending the right way.
* The risk controls are something you'd trust with the firm's capital — because you've tested them.
* A new venue or market has gone live cleanly, or the path to it is genuinely de-risked.
* The platform's security and DR posture would survive a SEBI or exchange inspection without a scramble.

**Who You Are**

* A senior engineer who leads from the front — you want to own both the architecture and a team, and you're better at each because you do both.
* Someone who can personally solve the hardest problems in a real-time system, not route them to someone else.
* An owner by temperament — of decisions, of uptime during market hours when something breaks, and of the consequences.
* Calm under the particular pressure of live markets, where mistakes cost money and the clock doesn't stop.
* A clear communicator who can work across research, operations, and compliance, and hold their own with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.

**Required**

* 10+ years building and operating production backend systems, with real time spent leading engineers or owning a platform's technical direction.
* Expert Python and deep command of asyncio and concurrency — event loops, backpressure, race conditions — on an async-end-to-end platform (FastAPI/Starlette, heavy asyncio).
* A real track record with real-time, event-driven systems: live market-data and order-event streams over WebSockets, coordinated through a pub/sub backbone.
* Experience integrating with external trading infrastructure — exchange and market-data feeds, an OMS, and brokers — over socket and HTTP APIs, with the discipline order placement and state tracking demand.
* Strong judgement across a mixed data layer: an operational store such as MongoDB, Redis (with Sentinel for high availability), and a time-series or columnar store such as ClickHouse.
* Proven ability to design always-on services for reliability and observability, and to own uptime in production.
* Comfort owning a containerised, multi-service setup end to end — Docker, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
* Enough grounding in the Indian market-structure and regulatory context — exchange connectivity and colocation, OMSs such as XTS, Greeksoft, or ODIN, venues such as NSE, BSE, and MCX, and SEBI's IT, cyber, DR, and BCP expectations — to own these outcomes and work credibly with exchanges, brokers, and vendors.
* A record of making sound architectural decisions and leading a team to deliver against them.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building high-frequency or ultra-low-latency trading systems, where the hot path is measured in microseconds.
* Hands-on with kernel-bypass networking (Solarflare/Onload, DPDK), FPGA, or other hardware acceleration for market data and order entry.
* Experience with tick-by-tick (TBT) feeds and the colocation setups that make microsecond latency achievable.
* Low-level performance engineering: lock-free data structures, cache-aware and zero-allocation hot paths, and C/C++/Rust where Python can't go.

**Why Northstar**

* Full ownership of the platform the fund runs on, and the mandate to shape where it goes — new venues and markets, an in-house OMS and data-feed adapter, and the move toward lower-latency trading.
* A serious team and direct access to the people running the fund — short path from decision to shipped.
* Meaningful ownership in what you build.
* Health insurance for spouse and kids, a good working environment, and an annual company retreat.

description:
**Role Title:**
Platform Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. The software you build here decides how labs around the world adopt that wave.

**Role Summary:**
The DLX platform is a cloud-native, event-driven system of microservices that moves scientific data between instruments, lab applications, and enterprise systems, and increasingly runs AI agents over that data. It has a web UI, but most of the engineering is not web work: it is data processing, orchestration, integration, and backend connectivity in a distributed system. As a Platform Engineer you own features across that whole surface. One week that is a new orchestration capability in a NestJS service talking gRPC and Kafka; the next it is the React screens that expose it; the next it is an agent that acts on the data. You are a generalist by design, and you may bring a specialty on top of that.

**How Engineering Works Here:**
We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything: You deliver features, not tickets. You get a goal and the context behind it. You work out the plan, the design, the tests, and the rollout. Nobody hands you a task list. AI is part of the job. We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool. We are regulated. Our customers run validated GxP environments. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end. Thinkers and doers. The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Ship complete features into production: service, contract, data model, UI where needed, tests, documentation. Take a feature from a one-paragraph goal to a working plan and design without waiting for a task breakdown. Raise the quality of the services you touch: contracts, observability, test coverage, performance. Build or extend AI agent capabilities on the platform. Contribute to how the team uses agentic tooling: prompts, skills, review practices, automation. Senior / Lead: own the design of a platform capability end to end and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build platform features across NestJS/Node.js microservices, gRPC contracts, Kafka event flows, MongoDB data models, and React UI. Build and integrate AI and agentic capabilities into the platform. Write code that meets the platform's data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Troubleshoot production and integration issues across service boundaries. Senior / Lead: lead technical spikes and architecture decisions; mentor and raise engineering standards.

**Must-Have:**
Strong TypeScript/Node.js and working React. You have built something beyond request/response web APIs: event-driven services, message queues, background processing, distributed data flows. If all you have shipped is Express CRUD, this role will be a hard adjustment. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering features you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging, reading unfamiliar code. Git and CI/CD in a team setting.

**Good-to-Have:**
Our stack specifically: NestJS, gRPC, CQRS, Kafka, MongoDB, Keycloak, AWS. This is a large plus. Building AI agents, working with MCP servers, or integrating LLMs into products. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Lab informatics or scientific software: LIMS, ELN, CDS, instrument data. Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native operations.

**Success Indicators:**
Features reach production without needing the plan written for you. The services you touch are better than you found them. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, and the connectors team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: platform decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room.

**Why Join Scitara?**
Build the system that moves scientific data for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: features, designs, and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture. A global team of engineers, scientists, and customers.

title: Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)
description:
**Role Title:**
Connectors Engineer (Mid / Senior / Lead)

**Department:**
Product Engineering

**Location:**
Mumbai / Pune (Onsite)

**Reports To:**
Engineering Manager

**Experience:**
5+ years, hiring across levels. Level is set by what you can own end to end, not by years on a resume.

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Scitara:**
Scitara is a global leader in digital transformation for scientific laboratories, enabling connectivity, automation, and data integrity across instruments, applications, and enterprise systems. Our cloud-based DLX platform is used by the world's top pharma, biotech, life sciences, and industrial R&D labs to modernize workflows and accelerate scientific outcomes. Lab informatics is growing 50 to 70% over the next five years, at the exact moment AI is being layered onto scientific data workflows. None of that works until the data gets off the instrument. That is what connectors do.

**Role Summary:**
Connectors are how DLX reaches into the lab: chromatography systems, balances, plate readers, LIMS, ELNs, and vendor applications that were never designed to talk to anything. They are C#/.NET Windows services running on lab PCs, with no web stack. Each one is its own small project with its own surprises: a vendor SDK, a COM or OLE interface, a serial protocol, a file drop, a database nobody documented. Because there are dozens of these projects and each one is different, this role is for a generalist who is comfortable being handed an unfamiliar system and working out how to make it reliable. A specialty in one integration style is welcome on top of that, but it will be useful on one project in fifty, so it cannot be the whole story.

**How Engineering Works Here:**

We are a small team with a large product. That shapes everything:

**You deliver features, not tickets**
. You get a target system and a goal. You work out how to talk to it, what the data looks like, how to make it reliable, and how to prove it. Nobody hands you a task list.

**AI is part of the job.**
We use agentic coding tools every day to design, generate, test, and document. You are expected to work this way and to be a sharp reviewer of what the tools produce. You own the result, not the tool.

**We are regulated.**
Connectors run inside validated GxP labs. Data integrity, traceability, and auditability are design constraints, not a checklist at the end.

**Thinkers and doers.**
The people who do well here notice problems, propose fixes, get them wrong sometimes, and get them right the next time. They bring ideas back to the team instead of waiting to be told.

**Key Outcomes (First 6 to 12 Months):**
Deliver complete connectors into customer labs: discovery, design, implementation, tests, validation evidence, documentation. Take a target system from "here is the vendor" to a working plan without waiting for a task breakdown. Improve the shared connector framework and tooling so the next connector is faster than the last. Use AI tooling to cut the time from vendor documentation (or its absence) to working code. Senior / Lead: own the connector architecture and set the bar for the engineers around you.

**Responsibilities:**
Responsibilities Design and build connectors as C#/.NET Windows services that integrate instruments and lab systems with the DLX platform. Work with whatever the target exposes: REST, vendor SDKs, COM/OLE, file systems, databases, serial and network protocols. Build for environments you do not control: locked-down lab PCs, restricted networks, machines you cannot restart at will. Write code that meets data integrity and validation requirements. Use agentic development tools as the default way of working, and review their output critically. Troubleshoot integration issues in customer environments using structured problem-solving. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies as a contributor, not an attendee. Senior / Lead: lead spikes on new integration approaches; mentor and raise engineering standards.

**Must-Have:**
Strong C# and .NET, including long-running services (Windows Services or equivalent), not just web applications. You have integrated with systems you did not build and could not change, and made those integrations reliable. Comfortable starting from incomplete or missing documentation and working out how a system behaves. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgement to know when they are wrong. A track record of delivering work you were given as goals, not as task lists. Solid engineering fundamentals: design, testing, debugging. Git and CI/CD in a team setting.

**Good-to-Have:**
COM/OLE, Windows API, instrument protocols (serial, GPIB, TCP/IP), or file-based integrations. Lab informatics or scientific instruments: LIMS, ELN, CDS, chromatography, analytical instruments. Regulated software: GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity. Messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and distributed or event-driven design. Exposure to the platform side: Node.js/TypeScript, cloud services, AWS. Building AI agents or working with MCP servers.

**Success Indicators:**
Connectors reach customer labs without needing the plan written for you. Each connector you deliver makes the next one easier. Your use of AI tooling makes you faster and your work more thorough, and your peers pick up what you learn. Colleagues in product, quality, services, and the platform team trust your judgement. Senior / Lead: connector decisions get made well when the architect is not in the room.

**Why Join Scitara?**
Get real instruments talking to real science for the labs developing the next generation of therapies. Variety: every connector is a new system and a new problem. Work in an engineering culture where AI-native development is the default, not an experiment. Real ownership: designs and decisions are yours. Clear paths into technical leadership and architecture.

title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role**
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Software Development & Solution Architecture
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.
* Lead end-to-end solution design from requirements gathering through architecture, development, testing, and production deployment.
* Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.
* Data Engineering & Analytics Platforms
* Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
* Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
* Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
* Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), following best practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
* Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
* Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management
* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
* Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
* Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
* Agile Delivery & Project Management
* Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
* Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
* Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement
* Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.

**Required Technical Skills**

* The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
* Full Stack Development
* Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
* Python
* Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
* Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
* Microsoft Databricks & Data verse
* Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
* Azure Deployment
* Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
* Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
* GCP & DevOps
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
* Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
* Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
* Agile Project Management — Scrum Master
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
* Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
* Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
* Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
* Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
* Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.

**Why Join Us**

* This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
* Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. The company is known for investing in its people through training, mentoring and opportunities to take on larger responsibilities over time.
* In this role you will have room to experiment with modern cloud tools, AI and automation, while staying grounded in the day to day needs of engineers and designers. For the right person, this is a chance to grow into a trusted partner for project leaders and a key voice in how digital work evolves in the OGC practice.

**Reporting Relationships**

* The Technology Solutions Specialist reports directly to the Technology and Innovation Manager. The role also maintains strong functional working relationships with the GP Manager, Engineering Manager, Department Managers and other Design Application Specialists. Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.

**Future Roadmap**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a technology leader within our organization. In the first year, you will focus on mastering our existing systems and delivering key software projects. Following that, you will have the opportunity to lead new initiatives, mentor junior team members and specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture. We are committed to your professional development and will provide you with the resources and support needed to stay at the forefront of technology and advance your career.

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

**Job Title: Specialist - AIML Software Development**

Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
AI/ML Strategy & Architecture
  
  

* Define and own end-to-end AI/ML architectures for business-critical products and platforms.
* Lead technical evaluations and design decisions for machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI initiatives.
* Establish engineering standards, model development practices, and deployment frameworks for AI systems.
* Drive architecture reviews and provide technical guidance on model selection, feature engineering, infrastructure, and deployment strategies.
* Produce technical design documents, architecture decision records (ADRs), and solution blueprints for AI initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to business problems.

Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling
  
  

* Architect and oversee production machine learning systems across classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, and anomaly detection use cases.
* Lead advanced feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization, and model evaluation initiatives.
* Design robust experimentation frameworks for evaluating model performance and business impact.
* Establish standards for training, validation, testing, and deployment of machine learning models.

* Drive adoption of best practices in statistical modeling and predictive analytics.

Deep Learning & Applied AI
  
  

* Design and productionize deep learning solutions using CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers, and modern neural architectures.
* Lead initiatives involving transfer learning, representation learning, self-supervised learning, and multimodal AI systems.
* Optimize model performance through pruning, quantization, distillation, and inference acceleration techniques.
* Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art research advancements into production AI systems.
* Build scalable training and inference pipelines for large-scale deep learning workloads.

Generative AI & Large Language Models
  
  

* Design and implement production-ready LLM-powered solutions including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
* Develop robust embedding, retrieval, ranking, and knowledge-grounding strategies.
* Lead model evaluation efforts focused on factuality, safety, latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

MLOps, Infrastructure & Production Engineering

title: Forward Deployed Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure
description:
**Job Title**
: Forward Deployed Engineer – Cloud & AI Infrastructure

**Company**
: Host360

**Location**
: Onsite (Mumbai - Andheri East)

**Employment Type**
: Full Time

**Experience**
: 2–4 Years

**Function**
: Platform Engineering | AI Infrastructure

**Focus**
: Cloud Infrastructure | AI Platform Deployment | Software Engineering | Customer Engineering

**CTC**
– As per Industry Standards

**About Host360**

At Host360, we are building a next-generation cloud and AI infrastructure platform that enables enterprises to modernize their infrastructure, deploy AI workloads, and run mission-critical applications at scale.

Our offerings span public cloud, private cloud, GPU infrastructure, AI platforms, Kubernetes, bare-metal infrastructure, and managed cloud services. We help organizations build secure, scalable, and high-performance environments for modern applications and AI-driven workloads.

We are looking for a
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)**
who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and AI. You will work directly with customers to understand complex technical challenges, design and implement solutions, and take them from initial discovery to reliable production deployments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real-world problems, building systems that work in production, and turning customer requirements into reusable engineering solutions.

**The Role**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Host360, you will work closely with customer engineering teams to deploy AI workloads, modernize infrastructure, and build production-ready cloud-native solutions.

You will operate across software, infrastructure, and AI platforms, combining deep technical execution with customer collaboration. You will be expected to move beyond architecture discussions and prototypes to build, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimize working systems in real enterprise environments.

You will own outcomes such as deployment speed, system reliability, performance, resource utilization, and customer adoption. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working across multiple layers of the technology stack and can independently take a problem from ambiguity to a working production solution.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development**

* Work directly with customer engineering and platform teams to understand technical requirements, infrastructure challenges, and business objectives.
* Translate ambiguous problems into clear technical solutions, implementation plans, and measurable success criteria.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture discussions, proof-of-concepts, and hands-on implementation workshops.
* Build and deploy solutions within customer environments, adapting to their existing infrastructure, applications, and operational constraints.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and take ownership until the solution is stable and operational.

**2. Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering**

* Design, deploy, and optimize cloud infrastructure across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, and bare-metal environments.
* Implement infrastructure solutions involving compute, storage, networking, security, and virtualization.
* Work with containerized applications, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.
* Build and maintain infrastructure automation using Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Support application migration, infrastructure modernization, workload optimization, and platform integration.
* Diagnose infrastructure bottlenecks involving networking, storage, compute, resource allocation, and application performance.

**3. AI Infrastructure & Platform Deployment**

* Help customers deploy and operationalize AI and Generative AI workloads on cloud and GPU infrastructure.
* Set up environments for LLM inference, model serving, AI applications, and agent-based workflows.
* Work with GPU-enabled infrastructure, containerized AI workloads, model runtimes, and inference-serving frameworks.
* Integrate AI applications with APIs, databases, storage systems, and enterprise platforms.
* Assist in building reliable AI deployment pipelines with appropriate monitoring, resource management, and scaling mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot AI workload issues involving GPU utilization, memory consumption, latency, throughput, model serving, and infrastructure performance.

**4. Software Engineering & Automation**

* Build production-grade tools, scripts, APIs, integrations, and automation workflows that solve customer engineering problems.
* Use Python and, where appropriate, Go, TypeScript, or JavaScript to develop practical engineering solutions.
* Develop integrations across cloud platforms, infrastructure management systems, observability tools, and AI services.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks, deployment workflows, infrastructure provisioning, and troubleshooting processes.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to accelerate engineering workflows.
* Build reusable components, deployment templates, and automation frameworks that can be applied across multiple customer environments.

**5. Production Reliability & Optimization**

* Take ownership of deployed solutions beyond the initial implementation, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and continuous improvement.
* Implement monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting to maintain production reliability.
* Investigate incidents, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Evaluate performance, scalability, security, resource utilization, and cost efficiency.
* Establish safe deployment practices, rollback mechanisms, and operational runbooks.
* Measure the impact of deployed solutions through meaningful technical and business outcomes.

**6. Product Feedback & Reusable Engineering**

* Collaborate with Host360’s Platform Engineering, Product, and AI Infrastructure teams to address challenges encountered during customer deployments.
* Convert recurring customer requirements into reusable tools, platform capabilities, and product improvements.
* Document architecture decisions, deployment procedures, troubleshooting guides, and implementation patterns.
* Develop reusable reference architectures, automation scripts, and technical playbooks.
* Share real-world feedback to improve Host360’s cloud platform, AI infrastructure, and developer experience.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to independently investigate problems, design solutions, write code, and deliver working systems.
* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical role.
* Strong programming experience in Python, Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, or another relevant language, with the ability to build practical engineering tools and integrations.
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, private cloud, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience working with Linux systems, networking fundamentals, APIs, distributed systems, and production troubleshooting.
* Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, containerized applications, or cloud-native deployment environments.
* Experience with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, or Infrastructure as Code.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into technical architectures and working implementations.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application, infrastructure, and platform layers.
* Ability to take ownership of a problem from discovery and implementation through deployment, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with customer engineers and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting AI, Generative AI, LLM, or machine learning workloads in production.
* Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA fundamentals, GPU scheduling, or GPU resource utilization.
* Experience with model serving and inference frameworks such as vLLM, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with open-source AI models, model runtimes, inference optimization, and AI application frameworks.
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps, or Kubernetes operators.
* Exposure to private cloud and virtualization technologies such as OpenStack, VMware, Nutanix, or Proxmox.
* Experience with observability platforms, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or distributed tracing.
* Familiarity with databases, object storage, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to build, debug, test, and maintain production software.
* Previous experience in customer engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or embedded engineering roles.

**What We’re Looking For**

We value demonstrated engineering ability, practical problem-solving, and ownership over a particular combination of degrees, certifications, or technology keywords.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Enjoy getting hands-on with unfamiliar systems and figuring out how they work.
* Can move from an unclear customer problem to a working implementation without relying entirely on predefined instructions.
* Are comfortable switching between application code, cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, and AI workloads.
* Prefer building and debugging real systems over producing architecture documents alone.
* Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take responsibility for production outcomes rather than considering a deployment complete when the initial setup is finished.
* Enjoy learning new technologies and sharing what you learn with the wider engineering team.

**At Host360, we are looking for engineers who don’t just recommend solutions — they build them, deploy them, and make them work in production.**

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite
* Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions
* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Vice President, Corporate Technology
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
Ares is seeking a
**Corporate Technology India Lead, Engineering (Vice President)**
to join Corporate Technology in Mumbai, reporting to the global
**Head of Corporate Technology**
. This is a high-impact role serving as the senior Corporate Technology leader in India and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team alongside the global Product and Engineering heads. The leader will provide local direction and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based employees supporting Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services Technology - including colleagues aligned through dotted-line reporting - and support oversight of a comparable contractor workforce of approximately 15. While retaining direct accountability for engineering delivery and operational excellence, this individual will help create a cohesive local technology community of approximately 30 internal and external professionals.
  
  
This is a build-and-scale opportunity for a leader who wants to shape how the India Corporate Technology organization engineers, operates, and adopts AI. The role has meaningful influence over engineering culture, talent strategy, delivery practices, process maturity, knowledge management, and the evolution of business-critical platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineering leader and credible technologist who combines deep technical judgment with strong people and organizational leadership. This person will operate as a player-coach: contributing directly to architecture, design, code reviews, prototypes, critical development, and production problem solving, while building a high-performing team. They will bring an AI-centric mindset and a practical record of using AI and automation to improve software delivery, business workflows, decision support, and team productivity within appropriate governance and control frameworks.
  
  
Success requires exceptional written and verbal communication, strong executive presence, and the ability to create clarity across cultures, time zones, and matrixed reporting lines. The leader must be a trusted bridge-builder across Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Information Security, Infrastructure, Service Management, and business-facing technology teams. They must be equally effective with engineers, product managers, senior business stakeholders, and enterprise technology partners, translating complex topics into crisp decisions, shared priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Success in this role will be reflected in the strength, cohesion, and engagement of the India technology community; clear direction across direct and dotted-line teams; predictable, high-quality delivery; improved platform reliability and engineering productivity; responsible adoption of AI; and durable processes and knowledge assets that reduce key-person dependency and allow the organization to scale.
  
  
**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities**

* Serve as the Corporate Technology site leader in Mumbai and a member of the Corporate Technology leadership team; contribute to technology strategy, portfolio priorities, workforce planning, operating model, and culture.
* Provide visible, day-to-day direction, prioritization, and connective leadership for up to 15 Mumbai-based Product and Engineering colleagues across Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, and Corporate Services, including individuals whose formal reporting lines sit with global leaders; align objectives, capacity, ways of working, development, and the local team experience in partnership with their direct managers.
* Lead through influence in a matrixed global model with exceptional communication and follow-through; build trust, establish clear accountabilities, surface risks early, explain tradeoffs, facilitate difficult conversations, resolve cross-team friction, and maintain strong alignment across Mumbai, New York, and Los Angeles.
* Own engineering delivery and operational health across assigned Corporate Technology solutions, ensuring applications and platforms are scalable, resilient, secure, maintainable, and audit-ready.
* Remain hands-on as a full-stack engineer: contribute to solution architecture and design, build prototypes and critical components, review code, troubleshoot complex issues, and support high-severity production incidents.
* Partner with Product leaders and business stakeholders to translate roadmaps and business needs into clear technical requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, tradeoffs, and measurable outcomes.
* Define and execute an AI and automation agenda for Corporate Technology in Mumbai, in partnership with global Product, Engineering, Data, Architecture, Information Security, and relevant control functions; prioritize use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, and adoption.
* Drive practical, responsible adoption of AI across the software delivery lifecycle and corporate workflows, including assisted development, testing, documentation, knowledge discovery, incident analysis, workflow automation, summarization, and decision support, with appropriate data protection, human oversight, evaluation, auditability, and monitoring.
* Establish disciplined operating rhythms and a strong process and knowledge-management culture, including architecture decision records, engineering standards, reusable patterns, design reviews, runbooks, playbooks, onboarding materials, communities of practice, retrospectives, and measurable continuous-improvement actions; use AI-enabled tools to make knowledge current, discoverable, and reusable.
* Own end-to-end solution delivery: discovery, architecture/design, build/configuration, data and integration work, testing/UAT, release, adoption, and production support, aligned with SDLC, change management, and operational readiness expectations.
* Establish and reinforce common engineering standards across the portfolio, including code quality, peer review, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, observability, documentation, and release governance.
* Guide the design of modern applications, services, APIs, workflows, and data flows; make pragmatic decisions that balance strategic modernization, reuse, time to value, platform constraints, control requirements, and total cost of ownership.
* Act as a bridge across Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Data/Analytics, Infrastructure/Cloud, Service Management, and adjacent application teams; clarify ownership, resolve seams, manage dependencies, and ensure alignment with cybersecurity, identity/access, data governance, privacy, records retention, resiliency, and responsible AI standards.
* Drive operational excellence through proactive monitoring, capacity and performance management, incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, technical debt reduction, runbooks, service metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Build, coach, and retain strong engineering talent in Mumbai; provide local coaching, performance input, and development direction for direct and dotted-line colleagues in partnership with their formal managers; contribute to hiring, succession planning, technical mentorship, and targeted development opportunities while fostering a culture of ownership, inclusion, transparency, high standards, and continuous learning.
* Support oversight of a contractor and delivery-partner population of comparable scale (approximately 15), including capacity planning, onboarding, work allocation, delivery performance, quality, cost discipline, documentation, knowledge transfer, and vendor escalation; ensure external professionals operate as integrated members of the team while maintaining clear accountability and Ares standards.
* Provide concise, transparent, executive-ready reporting and written decision materials on delivery, platform health, engineering quality, AI adoption, talent, risks, issues, dependencies, and remediation plans.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive technology experience, including significant hands-on full-stack software engineering and enterprise application delivery.
* 5+ years of people and organizational leadership experience, with a proven record leading senior engineers and multidisciplinary teams through a combination of direct, dotted-line, and influence-based leadership; experience providing direction to organizations of comparable scale is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a player-coach, balancing direct technical contribution with portfolio delivery, team leadership, and executive engagement.
* Experience serving as a local engineering or site leader, with accountability for talent, culture, delivery coordination, process maturity, senior escalation management, and the effective integration of employees, contractors, and globally aligned teams.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI and automation to engineering practices and/or enterprise business workflows, with the judgment to move from experimentation to secure, governed, measurable adoption.
* Experience in complex, regulated financial services; alternative asset management experience strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are essential, including the ability to synthesize complex information, write crisp executive materials, influence senior stakeholders, build durable relationships, resolve conflict constructively, and create alignment across regions, cultures, and technology functions.

**Experience Required**

* Deep full-stack engineering expertise and recent hands-on delivery experience, including:

+ Proficiency in at least one modern backend stack (e.g., Java/Spring, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or comparable)
+ Proficiency in at least one modern web framework (e.g., React, Angular, or comparable), with a strong understanding of user experience, performance, and secure development
+ Strong SQL, relational data modeling, data analysis/troubleshooting, and comfort navigating complex process and data flows
+ Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, services, event/messaging patterns, and batch integrations
+ Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, cloud or modern enterprise hosting, containers where applicable, and application observability

* Practical fluency with enterprise AI solution patterns and AI-assisted engineering, with demonstrated ability to move valuable use cases into governed production adoption; familiarity with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, observability, and secure data grounding is strongly valued.
* Proven ability to establish scalable engineering processes and knowledge-management disciplines that improve quality, onboarding, reuse, supportability, and organizational resilience.
* Strong software architecture fundamentals, including modular design, scalability, resiliency, security, maintainability, integration, data, and control considerations.
* Demonstrated success delivering and operating business-critical enterprise applications through the full SDLC, including testing, release/change management, adoption, production support, incident/problem management, and root-cause analysis.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and platforms while managing operational risk, controls, business continuity, and stakeholder change.
* Proven success leading multiple teams or a portfolio across different business domains, including directing work across direct and dotted-line employees and external partners; able to prioritize and sequence work in partnership with Product leaders.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, including hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, succession planning, and building inclusive, high-performing engineering cultures.
* Demonstrated ability to build bridges across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Infrastructure, Service Management, and adjacent technology functions, creating clarity, trust, shared accountability, and momentum across global time zones and organizational boundaries.
* Experience managing vendors, systems integrators, or external engineering partners at meaningful scale, including capacity planning, performance management, documentation, knowledge transfer, cost control, and operational readiness.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Corporate Technology domains such as Human Resources, Legal & Compliance, Corporate Finance, procurement/expense, workplace, or other Corporate Services.
* Experience with one or more core ERP or finance ecosystems (e.g., Oracle, Workday, or comparable), including integrations, master/reference data, controls, close/reporting dependencies, and multi-entity or multi-currency operations.
* Experience supporting a public company or similarly controlled environment, with familiarity with SOX/internal controls, audit, financial reporting, segregation of duties, evidence retention, and enterprise risk management expectations.
* Prior involvement in ERP modernization, finance transformation, enterprise platform rationalization, or other large-scale process and technology transformation programs.
* Experience building or scaling an engineering organization or capability center in Mumbai while integrating it into a global Product and Engineering model.
* Experience with cloud migration, application modernization, enterprise workflow and low-code platforms, automation, data platforms, and engineering productivity initiatives.
* Familiarity with engineering, AI adoption, knowledge-management, and operational metrics used to improve delivery predictability, quality, reliability, developer experience, and business outcomes.

**General Requirements**

* Strong ownership mindset with disciplined, outcomes-focused execution; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and translating evolving business needs into durable technical solutions, clear decisions, and actionable team direction.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and service-oriented approach; a natural connector who can build credibility with engineers, Product partners, business stakeholders, control functions, and peer technology leaders, and who proactively connects teams, resolves friction, and advances shared outcomes.
* High standards, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous-learning mindset, with a commitment to remaining technically engaged while operating effectively at Vice President and leadership-team level.
* Willingness to flex hours as needed to support global leadership forums, stakeholders, critical releases, and production needs across India and U.S. time zones.

**Reporting Relationships**
Head of Business Operations Systems
  
  
*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

description:
