Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Tableau Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world.
  
  
In addition The Director — Tableau Next is an execution-focused technical leader responsible for designing and delivering migrations from legacy Business Intelligence and reporting platforms (Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, legacy Tableau Server) to Tableau Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Tableau Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will be owning the analytics platform architecture, legacy BI content migration strategy, data source re-architecture, governance model design and Tableau Next feature adoption roadmap.
  
  
You will combine deep Tableau expertise with strong data engineering and cloud data platform knowledge to ensure that dashboards, data sources, calculated fields, permissions and governance structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance and accelerated time-to-insight for the client's business users. This role is of people leader and 50% billable role, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Analytics migration projects, contributing hands-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as the Technical Lead for Tableau Next migration workstreams, architecting the end-to-end transition from legacy BI platforms to Tableau Next — including dashboard migration, data source re-architecture, semantic layer design and governance model.
* Design the legacy BI content migration strategy — inventorying, assessing and prioritising all legacy reports, dashboards, datasets and calculated fields for migration, retirement or rebuild in Tableau Next.
* Architect the Tableau Next data source framework — designing live connections, published data sources, virtual connections, data policies and extract schedules optimised for performance and governance.
* Design the Tableau Next site and governance model — including project hierarchy, permission groups, content certification workflow, data quality warnings and usage analytics configuration.
* Own the cloud data platform integration architecture — designing connections between Tableau Next and Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse and Salesforce Data Cloud as analytical data sources.
* Lead the semantic layer and data model migration — translating legacy BI semantic models, universe layers (Business Objects) and subject areas (Cognos) into Tableau Next published data source designs and calculations.
* Define end-to-end data lineage for all analytics objects — mapping source data fields through transformation layers to Tableau Next calculated fields, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved or improved.
* Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client business intelligence, data engineering and business analytics teams to assess legacy report complexity, data source dependencies and user adoption patterns.
* Manage the functional depth of Source vs. Target systems — maintaining deep understanding of how legacy BI platform features (Cognos report types, Business Objects universes, Power BI DAX measures) translate to Tableau Next capabilities.
* Serve as a Trusted Advisor to the client, driving conversations with CDOs, Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, data governance strategy and self-service analytics vision.
* Establish best-in-class standards for the Tableau Next migration practice — building reusable dashboard migration templates, data source connection templates, naming convention standards and governance configuration playbooks as factory accelerators.
* Lead performance optimisation — profiling legacy dashboard performance baselines, designing Tableau Next data extracts and published data sources to meet or exceed baseline performance, and establishing performance monitoring.
* Lead cutover planning and execution — including legacy BI platform deprecation scheduling, user access migration, Tableau Next URL/bookmark migration for key dashboards and post-go-live self-service training.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks proactively — data source credential migration, calculated field logic parity gaps, row-level security re-implementation, extract refresh SLA continuity and legacy report complexity underestimation.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory by building reusable Tableau Next migration playbooks, dashboard assessment tools, data source templates and performance benchmarking scripts to reduce wave delivery time.

**Experience Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling as individual contributors.
* 8+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating large BI content estates (500+ reports/dashboards) from legacy platforms to Tableau.

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Tableau Certified Architect (Preferred)
* Tableau Certified Data Analyst (Required)
* Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Preferred)
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced (Preferred)
* Databricks Certified Associate Developer (Preferred)
* dbt Analytics Engineering Certification (Preferred)

**Cross Cutting Qualifications**

* Proven expertise in executing complex data migrations — multiple end-to-end migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce or vice versa.
* Integration Architecture (Must Have): Understanding of how data flows between systems and the mechanisms for high-volume data transport.
* Data Architecture & Management (Must Have): Expertise in ERD design, data cleansing, managing high volumes of data and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies.
* Platform Security (Must Have): Knowledge of data encryption, field-level security, Shield and compliance-aligned data movement during migration windows.
* Identity & Access Management (Must Have): Understanding of user migration, permission set mapping, SSO and visibility model design.
* Sharing & Visibility (Must Have): How migrated data will be secured and accessed post-deployment.
* Platform Development (Must Have): Proficiency in Apex, Async Design, Governor limit, LWC components and Salesforce Flows.
* Excellent communication skills — ability to articulate complex migration strategies to both technical teams and C-suite business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a factory delivery model — reusing and contributing to shared accelerators, playbooks and templates across concurrent wave teams.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, and outcomes

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on 

Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 

and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s 

AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization. 

 

As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

 

**The Role**

The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.

 

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

 

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

 

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
  1. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  2. Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  3. Embedding generation and optimization
  4. Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  1. Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  2. Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  1. Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  2. Relevance and precision/recall
  3. Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  4. Cost tracking and efficiency

WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.
  
  
The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

* Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance
* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP) and BIM Execution Plans (BEP) in strict compliance with ISO 19650 standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the Common Data Environment (CDE) using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.
* GIS & Digital Twin Integration
* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS) with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational Digital Twin environments (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future IoT sensor data metadata placeholders within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.
* CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows
* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.
* 3D Visualization & Reality Capture
* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within Autodesk InfraWorks, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of Reality Capture datasets (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.
* AI Tools, Scripting & Automations
* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit, Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement AI-driven design tools and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

+ Roads & Highways
+ Rail & Transit
+ Bridges and Structures
+ Utilities
+ Aviation
+ Smart Infrastructure Projects

* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

title: SW Applications Engineer
description:
****Who We Are****
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
****What We Offer****
Location:
  
  
Mumbai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**SW Applications Engineer:**
This position is within the process diagnostics and control (PDC) group, which deals with advanced imaging together with cutting edge image processing & AI algorithms and electronic design data to detect, measure and classify nanometer size defects and pattern variations from semiconductor fabrication process steps. As PDC to multi-source data products and AI-based solutions, this engineer plays a central role in both shaping those products and driving their success in the field.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****
*Product Performance & Application*

* Maximize the performance of Data Products through deep understanding of customer use-cases and close technical collaboration with R&D, Algorithms, and Product teams
* Extend applicative expertise across multiple data sources (CAD, design, process, inspection) and beyond LINK to the full PDC product portfolio
* Ensure applicative value and readiness of SW and algorithmic solutions prior to and during field deployment

*Field Execution & Customer Success*

* Drive adoption and integrated deployment of Data Product solutions at leading semiconductor fabs worldwide
* Serve as the technical escalation point for complex field issues, providing rapid resolution and root cause analysis
* Develop utilities and scripts (Python) for debugging, workflow automation, and issue isolation

*Innovation & Roadmap Contribution*

* Conceptualize and prototype technical flows that convert multi-source data into new applications and insights
* Translate Voice of Customer (VoC) and field learnings into concrete product requirements and roadmap inputs
* Explore and validate AI/ML-based approaches that advance PDC's data product capabilities

****What We Offer****

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technology and products.
* Direct collaboration with customers and global R&D teams
* A role with real product influence — your field learnings shape the roadmap
* Dual career track: technical specialist or engineering leadership
* A culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

****What You Bring****

* Master’s / Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands-on knowledge of CAD and design-based inspection concepts
* Proficiency in Python; experience building scripts, tools, or analytical workflows
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and practical experience applying them to data analysis or product development
* Comfort with GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
* Willingness to travel ~50% to leading fabs globally
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication skills — equally effective with customers, field teams, and R&D engineers

****Additional Information****
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 50% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

**Candidate Expectations & Responsibilities**
This pivotal role will act as a Subject Matter Expert for our Telecom vertical and lead all presales and solution pursuits, both reactive and proactive, as lead architect. This role is for an experienced solution leader who can bring practical telecom contact center experience, commercial knowledge, and a deep understanding of the telecom customer service landscape across wireless, broadband, fiber, cable, digital care, billing, technical support, and retention operations. They will work closely with Sales, Operations, Technology, Revenue, and Delivery teams to provide solutions for telecom clients across clusters. They should understand a client’s current operating model, identify opportunities for change, and build a clear solution that balances customer experience, operational efficiency, regulatory risk, network and service complexity, and ROI. The candidate should be capable of leading conversations with senior stakeholders, translating business problems into solution constructs, and supporting growth through proactive propositions and RFP/RFQ responses.
  
  
**Qualification**
15+ years of experience in telecom, BPO, customer operations, digital care, technical support, or consulting, including at least 10 years in contact center or customer experience operations.
  
  
Strong exposure to telecom customer service across wireless, broadband, fiber, cable, billing, technical support, retention, digital channels, and service assurance journeys; omni-channel telecom experience is essential.
  
  
Hands-on experience in solutioning, presales, proposals, client presentations, deal shaping, operating model design and business case development.
  
  
Preferred certifications or formal learning in telecom, CX, contact center operations, CRM, OSS/BSS, service design, Lean Six Sigma, digital transformation, cloud, automation, or AI-led customer operations.
  
  
**The Responsibilities & Duties**
Lead solution design, strategy, and deal approach for proactive and reactive telecom opportunities across customer care, technical support, billing, collections, retention, digital care, and omni-channel operations.
  
  
Work with Account teams to qualify opportunities, design the win strategy, define scope and create a client-specific value proposition.
  
  
Understand telecom customer journeys such as new connection, plan changes, billing disputes, payment support, network outages, service assurance, device support, roaming, upgrades, churn prevention, complaints, and field service coordination, and convert these into service designs.
  
  
Bring working knowledge of CRM, agent desktop, knowledge management, IVR, chatbot, live chat, email management, social care, workforce management, OSS/BSS, order management, trouble ticketing, and service assurance platforms used in telecom operations.
  
  
Create proposals, presentations, solutions, effort models and commercial inputs that explain the operating model, process approach, staffing details, service levels and transformation roadmap.
  
  
Lead and review RFP/RFQ responses, support internal solution approvals, leadership reviews and confidently propose the solution in client discussions.
  
  
Assess as-is processes, identify opportunities and recommend improvements across channel mix, automation, self-service, quality, training, knowledge and customer experience.
  
  
Evaluate compliance and risk considerations across data privacy, customer authentication, payment handling, regulatory communications, complaint management, vulnerable customers, service continuity, and telecom-specific controls.
  
  
Develop financial models covering productivity, cost-to-serve, automation benefits, transformation investments, pricing assumptions and expected return on investment.
  
  
Keep track of competitor capabilities, market trends, telecom service innovations, regulatory developments, OSS/BSS modernization, digital care models, automation trends, and potential partnerships that can strengthen the pursuit or proposition.
  
  
Support due diligence, discovery workshops and client site visits when required, including structured information gathering and validation of operational assumptions.
  
  
Conceptualize AI-enabled customer service solutions for telecom use cases such as billing explanation, outage updates, network troubleshooting, plan recommendations, churn-risk identification, proactive service notifications, order status, and field visit scheduling.
  
  
Promote responsible use of AI and digital tools in telecom operations, with clear attention to explainability, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, service reliability, governance, and customer trust.

**Mandatory**
: CX solutions, Telecom Solutions, CX Solutions architect, solutioning, presales, RFI, RFQ, RFX, Telecom, CX Solutioning
  
  
**Good to have**
: Lean Six Sigma, CX related Certifications.

description:
Job Description: AI/ML Architect Position Details
  
  

* Resource Type: Full-Time / Contract
* Location: Mumbai Lower Parel, BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex), Malad, Kalina-Santacruz
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience: 10 18 Years
* Salary/Rate: Open for Discussion
* Work Mode: Onsite 5 Days a Week
* Must-Have Skills: AI Architecture, LLM, Python

**Job Summary**
We are seeking experienced
**AI/ML Architects**
to join the AI Engineering service line. The role involves leading the technical delivery of enterprise AI/ML and Agentic AI projects from solution handover through design, development, deployment, and optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring production-grade quality, scalability, security, and compliance while translating architectural blueprints into robust, enterprise-ready AI solutions. The role requires strong hands-on engineering expertise, architectural leadership, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and customers across industries such as BFSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS), Manufacturing, CMT, Retail, and Energy.
  
  
Key Responsibilities 1. Architecture & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Own end-to-end technical architecture and solution integrity throughout project delivery.
* Translate solution blueprints into detailed technical designs, implementation backlogs, and integration plans.
* Lead design reviews and ensure adherence to AI platform, MLOps, LLMOps, and Agentic AI best practices.
* Select appropriate frameworks, APIs, libraries, and cloud-native services for implementation.

2. Project Execution & Delivery
  
  

* Act as the technical anchor for enterprise AI/ML and Agentic AI projects.
* Guide engineering teams in developing modular, secure, scalable, and reusable solutions.
* Review and validate code, infrastructure scripts, ML pipelines, and deployment workflows.
* Oversee data pipelines, model training, LLMOps, and model deployment activities.

3. Hands-on Engineering & Problem-Solving
  
  

* Provide hands-on technical expertise in LLM pipelines, vector databases, fine-tuning, and model evaluation.
* Resolve integration challenges involving APIs, knowledge stores, and orchestration layers.
* Implement or validate MLOps workflows using MLflow, Airflow, Argo, KServe, BentoML, and related tools.

4. Quality, Compliance & Observability
  
  

* Embed observability, AI safety, security, and compliance throughout the AI/ML lifecycle.
* Integrate AI governance platforms for model tracking, versioning, auditing, and risk management.
* Ensure alignment with relevant enterprise and regulatory frameworks, including NIST AI Risk Management Framework, EU AI Act, and responsible AI policies.

5. Collaboration & Customer Engagement
  
  

* Serve as the technical point of contact for client engineering and data science teams.
* Participate in sprint planning, project status reviews, and change control discussions.
* Support knowledge transfer, user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, and post-deployment handovers.

**Required Qualifications Education**

* B.Tech, M.Tech, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related discipline.

Technical Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering or architecture, including at least 5 years in applied AI/ML system delivery.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python development.
* Proven experience in productionizing AI/ML models and developing enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases such as Weaviate, Qdrant, and Pinecone.
* Proficiency in AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps tools such as MLflow, Argo, KServe, Feast, and Kubeflow.
* Knowledge of data pipeline engineering using Spark, Airflow, or Dataflow.
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or CrewAI.

Cloud & Infrastructure
  
  

* Hands-on experience with GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Document AI, and AI Gateway, and/or Azure services such as Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, and Synapse.
* Expertise in Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong architectural thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
* Proactive, structured, and detail-oriented approach with a strong execution focus.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience deploying Agentic AI systems or collaborative multi-agent architectures in production.
* Understanding of AI ethics, fairness, transparency, explainability, and bias mitigation.
* Familiarity with AI observability and governance platforms such as Arize, Fiddler, and TruEra.

Key Skills
  
  
**AI Architecture | Artificial Intelligence | Machine Learning | LLM | Python | RAG | Vector Databases | Agentic AI | LangChain | LangGraph | MLOps | LLMOps | GCP | Azure | Docker | Kubernetes**

description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*

*Computer*

**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
  
  
You’ll remain hands-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
  
  
Success in the role means consistently delivering high-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
  
  
What you’ll get to do:
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Write high-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.

What we think you’ll need:
  
  

* Proven success in a hands-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.

**Next steps**
If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
  
  
Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
  
  
**Our hybrid approach**
Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

title: MS - FDL - Senior Manager - AI Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – AI Architect**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and governance of enterprise AI solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines AI/ML architecture, technical leadership, and people management, translating business needs into secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. The ideal candidate will integrate predictive machine learning, generative AI, and appropriately controlled agentic workflows with enterprise applications and data to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own AI architecture quality and technology roadmaps across engagements, lead architects and technical specialists, and partner with data science, engineering, product, security, risk, and business teams to guide solutions from discovery through production adoption and measurable value realization.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**AI Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Define the AI architecture strategy and roadmap, aligning prioritized use cases with enterprise technology standards, data readiness, risk appetite, and business objectives.
* Lead discovery and feasibility assessments; determine when rules, analytics, traditional ML, or generative AI are appropriate, and validate options through measurable proofs of concept.
* Design end-to-end AI architectures spanning data ingestion, feature or embedding pipelines, model training or adaptation, retrieval, inference, orchestration, APIs, and enterprise integration.
* Evaluate model providers, open-weight models, cloud AI services, and build-versus-buy options; balance quality, latency, scalability, cost, licensing, data residency, and vendor dependency.
* Establish reference architectures and design standards for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model serving, and agentic workflows, including permission-aware retrieval, tool authorization, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve complex AI design challenges; guide model selection, prompting, fine-tuning where justified, evaluation design, and integration with production systems.

**AI Delivery, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across AI initiatives, defining acceptance criteria, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and stage gates from experimentation through production readiness.
* Partner with engineering and platform teams to establish MLOps and LLMOps practices, including versioned datasets, models and prompts, reproducible evaluation, deployment controls, and rollback.
* Define task-specific evaluation frameworks covering predictive performance, groundedness, retrieval quality, hallucination risk, robustness, fairness where relevant, latency, and cost; validate against representative test data and business baselines.
* Design production monitoring for data and model drift, output quality, reliability, usage, and inference spend; establish fallback behavior, incident response, and controlled model or provider updates.
* Embed responsible AI, privacy, security, and applicable compliance controls with risk and legal teams, including data provenance, audit trails, prompt-injection defenses, sensitive-data protection, and risk-based human oversight.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale an AI architecture team, coordinating data scientists, ML engineers, data engineers, and application specialists across engagements; develop architects and technical leads.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance AI practice focused on rigorous experimentation, responsible innovation, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource planning, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with AI delivery demand and evolving technology needs.
* Mentor architects and technical specialists on AI design, evaluation rigor, production readiness, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen peer reviews and communities of practice.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance transformation leaders, product owners, and clients to identify AI opportunities, clarify process constraints, and define measurable success criteria.
* Present AI solution options, limitations, investment needs, and risk trade-offs to decision-makers; align expectations on automation boundaries, human review, and business value.
* Lead AI architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and demonstrations, including solution narratives, prototypes, estimates, data requirements, and implementation assumptions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, evaluation results, residual risks, adoption readiness, and realized business impact clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable AI Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable AI reference designs, evaluation suites, retrieval components, model integration patterns, and governance templates to accelerate consistent delivery.
* Assess emerging AI capabilities through structured experiments and business cases; scale only where evidence supports performance, operational feasibility, and acceptable risk.
* Enable finance-focused capabilities such as document intelligence, knowledge assistants, forecasting, and anomaly detection, with traceable outputs and controls appropriate to each use case.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, data platforms, solution architecture, or AI/ML, including substantial experience architecting and deploying production AI/ML solutions.
* 5+ years of technical people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or engineering teams and delivering complex, cross-functional AI or data initiatives.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including managed AI services, deployment options, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, model evaluation, and applied statistics, with practical expertise in generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and model adaptation trade-offs.
* Strong Python and software architecture skills, with experience in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise application integration.
* Experience with MLOps and LLMOps, including experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation automation, CI/CD, model serving, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of AI security and responsible AI, including data leakage, prompt injection, model limitations, explainability, fairness assessment, access controls, and human-in-the-loop design.

**AI Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide AI solutions from use-case discovery and feasibility assessment through architecture, evaluation, production deployment, and operational transition.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, model and vendor evaluations, AI risk assessments, and production-readiness reviews across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, capacity planning, inference cost modeling, and total cost of ownership analysis, balancing model quality, latency, reliability, and business value.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise data and business processes; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) and associated control requirements is preferred.
* Experience applying AI/ML to finance transformation, ERP-connected workflows, document processing, forecasting, or enterprise analytics is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence data science, engineering, and business teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and the ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and risks without overstating results.
* Ability to balance AI strategy with pragmatic implementation, challenge assumptions using evidence, and make sound decisions amid rapidly evolving technology.
* High ownership mindset focused on responsible AI adoption, production reliability, solution quality, and measurable business outcomes.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Architect - Data Modeller
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Architect Data Modeler**
**Exp Range**
: 8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job Location**
: Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Modeler is responsible for the structural design of the platform's canonical and derived data assets. You will own the Common Data Model (CDM) at the schema level — the dimension, fact, bridge, and reference tables that hold normalized clinical, claims, and demographic data — and the source-to-target mappings (STTMs) that define how source-system data lands in CDM and how CDM data is reshaped into FHIR resources.
  
  
This role is hands-on. You will produce schema designs in collaboration with the architect, write STTM specifications that engineers implement against, and work with clinical informatics and source-system experts to ensure the model accurately reflects the data's clinical and operational meaning. Your output is the contract between source data and CDM, and between CDM and downstream consumers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the schema-level design of the Common Data Model — DIM (patient, person, encounter, provider, organization), FACT (observation, diagnosis, procedure, medication administration, claim line, encounter), BRIDGE (relationship-qualifier-aware), and REF (terminology and crosswalk) tables. Design columns, types, NULL semantics, hash key composition, SCD2 patterns, and partitioning strategies in coordination with the architect
* Develop and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs) for every source-system feed — EPIC HL7v2 ADT/ORU/ORM, Cerner HL7v2, ambulatory EHR feeds, state HIE CCDA, payer claims CSVs, FHIR ingestion. STTMs specify field-by-field source-path → CDM-column mapping with explicit transformation, NULL handling, and validation rules
* Develop and maintain STTMs for FHIR serialization — for each in-scope US Core 6.1 resource (Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Procedure, Practitioner, Organization, AllergyIntolerance), specify how every FHIR element derives from CDM columns, including cardinality, profile constraints, and terminology bindings
* Design data product schemas — the longitudinal patient mart, population analytics aggregations, risk adjustment marts, HEDIS measure pre-aggregations. Each data product has a defined grain, columns, and refresh semantics
* Author and maintain unit specs at the model level under the spec-driven development framework. Each table has a versioned spec; model changes go through the spec review process before implementation
* Collaborate with data engineers to translate model specs into dbt implementations. Review dbt model code for adherence to the spec, including column naming, hash key construction, SCD2 macro usage, and test coverage
* Participate in source-system data profiling — analyze sample data from each source to identify quality issues, edge cases, and modeling implications before specs are finalized. Profile findings drive STTM design
* Define and enforce reference data (REF) management practices — terminology crosswalks (LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-10, RxNorm, CPT), source-code-to-standard-code mappings, and the SCD2 patterns that govern reference data evolution
* Document data dictionaries, lineage, and the canonical model glossary. Engage with Atlan or equivalent governance tooling to publish model documentation for downstream consumers
* Work with clinical informaticists and source-system experts to validate that the model and STTMs accurately represent clinical reality. STTMs are the contract between engineering and clinical informatics; you own that contract

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of data modeling experience for large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or data platforms
* Demonstrated ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models — dimensional modeling (Kimball), data vault, or hybrid patterns. This project uses a Kimball-influenced canonical model with SCD2 dimensions and per-source row preservation
* Strong SQL proficiency. Experience reading and reviewing dbt SQL models is required; ability to author dbt models is a plus
* Experience modeling for analytical and operational data layers simultaneously — understanding how a normalized canonical model serves both downstream analytics and FHIR API consumers
* Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards — HL7v2 segment-level structure, CCDA document structure, and FHIR R4 resource models. Familiarity with US Core profiles and FHIR Bundle composition
* Experience producing source-to-target mappings (STTMs) at field-level granularity for multi-source data integration projects
* Experience modeling SCD2 patterns and the operational implications of late-arriving data, restatement, and version closure
* Experience with terminology systems used in healthcare — LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, RxNorm — and their crosswalk patterns
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform data services (Cloud Storage, BigLake, Dataproc) and open table formats. Direct Iceberg experience is a plus

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :**
8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job location :**
Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high-volume
  
  
capacity claims.
  
  
This role is technical-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the four-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within-layer composition), contract (cross-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end-to-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec-to-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR-Repository interceptor work, end-to-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured-but-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel-run validation framework — for the 30-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR-Repository egress interceptor captures every client-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no-match/multi-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end-to-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8+ years of QA experience with at least 3-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt-expectations or dbt-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open-table-format-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec-driven or contract-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

title: Research Engineer — Agent Architectures (Coding & Autonomous Systems)
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building 
****aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems****

. While that is the vision, the mission to build safety aware autonomous system in the extreme near term. Our research work spans around areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI, Eurips etc. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai & remote), Paris, & London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Most of the variance in agent performance comes from the system around the model, not the model itself. This role researches that system. The coding agent is the primary testbed: it takes an objective, works on a repository, verifies its own changes, and produces a record of what it did. It runs inside a customer's network, usually with no internet egress, against codebases that are large, old, thinly tested and load-bearing. Small models under real latency and cost budgets are a target, not a fallback.

Three areas:

****Harness.****

Action space and tool surface design, context construction policy, where deterministic program analysis should replace model inference, control topology (single loop versus decomposition), verification design, and allocation of inference-time compute.

****Memory.****

Schemas for execution state held outside the context window, compaction policy and what it destroys, retrieval under closed-world constraints, and whether an agent measurably improves on a repository over time.

****Evals.****

Task construction from real repository history with executable verification, scoring partially-checkable long-horizon work, variance and contamination control, and failure taxonomies that attribute a failure to a component.

The work is controlled experiments on architecture, not prompt tuning: isolate a failure from eval traces, form a hypothesis about the responsible component, change it, ablate it, and establish whether the gain holds across repositories and model sizes. Outputs are papers, benchmarks and released tooling where we can publish, and shipped architecture where we cannot.

You will work directly with our alignment and interpretability researchers on post-training, behavioral evaluation, and reading what an agent actually did rather than what its trace claims.

What We Are Looking For

Research judgment with systems depth. You should be able to isolate a failure, design the experiment that tests your explanation of it, build what the experiment needs, and tell the difference between a real gain and an artifact of your setup.

****Agentic systems.****

Two or more years building agents that ran against real workloads, not demos. Working knowledge of the current landscape (ReAct-style agents, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, the current generation of coding agents) and a specific account of where each stops working. Experience with tool-use protocols and orchestration under partial failure, retries, timeouts and non-idempotent actions.

****Evaluation.****

You have built an eval dataset or harness that other people then used. Comfortable with SWE-bench-class benchmarks and their construction, containerised task execution at scale, statistical treatment of noisy multi-run results, and pass@k, best-of-N and majority-vote scoring and their failure cases.

****Code intelligence and program analysis.****

ASTs and tree-sitter, static and dataflow analysis, symbol indexing and code search, call graph and dependency resolution, codemods and automated migration tooling. You should be able to build a repository-scale index and defend its design.

****Backend and infrastructure.****

Advanced Python. Sandboxing and containerisation (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker or equivalent), distributed execution of thousands of parallel trials, artifact and dependency management, and on-premise or air-gapped deployment. Experiments that cannot be run at volume are not useful here.

****Observability.****

Distributed tracing, structured logging, OpenTelemetry, and the replay and inspection tooling that makes a non-deterministic system debuggable end to end.

****Model side.****

You do not need to be a training specialist, but you should be fluent in post-training methods (SFT, DPO, RL for agents), distillation, inference-time scaling, and quantisation and serving trade-offs at small parameter counts. You should have a view on where architecture ends and the model begins.

You treat performance, reliability, cost, safety and interpretability as one connected set of constraints, and you make reasonable calls when the problem is loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.

Qualifications

* Five or more years in research engineering, systems, or ML infrastructure, with at least two on agentic or LLM-based systems. A PhD in ML, PL, systems or a related field counts toward this, as does equivalent industrial research work.
* A public record we can read: first-author publications at ML or systems venues, a maintained open-source project, a benchmark, or a substantial technical writeup. We weigh a well-argued repository as heavily as a paper.
* Demonstrated ownership of a system from design through production behavior.
  
  

Useful but not required: developer tooling or IDE internals, language servers and LSP, refactoring engines, compiler work, large monorepo or legacy modernisation programs, RL infrastructure, and alignment, interpretability or safety tooling in production.

We publish. We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
**AI Solution Architect - Azure & Agentic AI**

**Job Description**

You will partner with IT Director and internal client teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable, production-grade architectures — spanning pro-code Azure solutions, low-code Power Platform experiences, and emerging agentic AI frameworks. This role is the keystone that unblocks a high-performing development team by owning end-to-end solution design: from initial client discovery and MVP scoping through to architecture governance, observability strategy, and developer guidance. You will modernize existing AI workloads — including LangChain/LangGraph pipelines and RAG systems — while establishing a forward-looking architecture practice built on the latest AI, integration, and cloud-native patterns.

**The Role**

* Client engagement & discovery — Work directly with internal clients to deeply understand their use cases, identify the core problem and success criteria, and translate requirements into a clearly scoped MVP. Act as the technical voice in stakeholder conversations, bridging business need to technical possibility.
* Solution architecture ownership — Design and own end-to-end architectures for AI solutions across the full delivery spectrum: pro-code applications on Azure, low-code solutions on Power Platform & Copilot Studio, and third-party platforms such as Lyzr or Moveworks. Produce architecture artefacts (HLD, LLD, ADRs) that guide delivery teams.
* AI & agentic framework design — Lead the architecture of advanced AI capabilities: multi-agent systems, agentic workflows, advanced RAG (contextual retrieval, hybrid search, re-ranking), MCP integration, and next-generation AI orchestration patterns using Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, and adjacent frameworks.
* Modernization of existing AI workloads — Assess and evolve current LangChain/LangGraph and OpenAI-based pipelines and Google Cloud AI assets. Define a roadmap to advance these toward production-grade, observable, and maintainable architectures aligned with enterprise standards.
* Backend & integration architecture — Design scalable APIs, event-driven integrations, and enterprise connectors that underpin AI solutions. Ensure AI capabilities integrate cleanly with enterprise systems (M365, ServiceNow, ERP, HR platforms, etc.).
* Observability & operational excellence — Embed observability-first thinking into every architecture: define logging, tracing, evaluation, and monitoring frameworks for AI systems using tools such as Azure Monitor, Promptflow evals, LangSmith, or equivalent. Ensure AI solutions are auditable and trustworthy at scale.
* Developer enablement & technical governance — Work hands-on with the engineering team as a trusted design partner. Conduct architecture reviews, provide hands-on guidance during delivery, establish reusable patterns and reference architectures, and reduce technical debt through principled design decisions.
* Technology radar & innovation — Maintain an active awareness of the AI tooling landscape. Evaluate and recommend emerging platforms, frameworks, and patterns that could improve delivery speed, capability, or cost-efficiency for the team.

**The Requirements**

***Cloud & Infrastructure architecture***

* 7+ years of solution or cloud architecture experience; strong preference for Azure (AKS, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Factory). Equivalent GCP or AWS considered.
* Demonstrated experience designing cloud-native, enterprise-scale applications.
* Familiarity with Well-Architected Framework principles (reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence).

***AI, ML & agentic systems***

* Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying production RAG systems. Deep knowledge of advanced RAG patterns: hybrid search, re-ranking, contextual chunking, graphRAG, and long-context strategies. Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an emerging integration pattern.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and agentic orchestration patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, multi-agent supervisor patterns).
* Experience working with LLM providers: Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-weight models via Azure AI Foundry model catalogue.
* Familiarity with AI safety, responsible AI principles, and enterprise guardrail patterns (content filtering, grounding checks). Experience designing AI evaluation frameworks (ragas, offline evals, online monitoring, LLM-as-judge).
* Nice to have: Experience designing or advising on predictive ML models (classification, forecasting) — not necessarily model training, but understanding the architecture around data pipelines, feature stores, and model serving in an enterprise context.

***Low-code, automation & platform tools***

* Architecture-level knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio (formerly PVA), and AI Builder.
* Exposure to enterprise third-party AI platforms such as Lyzr (agent builder), Moveworks (enterprise AI assistant), or comparable (ServiceNow AI, Glean, Workato). Ability to assess fit-for-purpose versus build vs. buy for AI automation scenarios.

***Backend, integration & software architecture***

* Hands-on experience designing backend services in Python and/or Node.js/.NET.
* Familiarity with enterprise application integration: M365 ecosystem (SharePoint, Teams), identity & security (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, managed identity), and data platforms (Azure Data Lake, Fabric, Purview) as AI data sources.

***Communication & ways of working***

* Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with experience guiding and mentoring engineering teams

**WTW is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
