description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**

Experience: 4-6 Years

**About the Company:**

Blue Machines (Apna) builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.

**What You'll Do**

● End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic.

● Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems.

● AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows.

● System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines.

● Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence.

● Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews.

**What We Look For**

● Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus).

● Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work.

● Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT).

● Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets.

● Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms.

● Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews.

**Nice to Have**

● Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona).

● Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Solution Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.

**:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication & Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical & Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.
* Organizational & Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences.

**Benefits**

* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential, free support for personal or work-related challenges—covering counseling, or financial guidance, and more—to help maintain well-being and performance.
* Term Life Insurance: Provides financial peace of mind for your loved ones with a fixed-coverage death benefit over a defined term. Affordable protection offered by your employer.

title: Lead Golang Engineer
description:
Lead Golang Platform Engineer

**Domain:**
Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

**Work Mode:**
To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Lead Golang Platform Engineer**
to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

Key Responsibilities

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

* Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet).
* Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions.
* Good experience in JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc.
* Core Skills:

+ SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
+ Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
+ Dataverse: Data modelling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
+ Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
+ PCF Controls: React, Python, TypeScript, PCF control framework

+ Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
+ Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
+ AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
+ Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
+ Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
+ Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
+ Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
+ Experience in consulting strongly preferred.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
+ Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
+ Interpersonal and communication skills.
+ Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
+ Work in collaborative and supportive manner.
+ Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI.
* Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP.
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Leadership - System Engineering
description:
We are looking for an experienced systems engineering leader to head our Systems Engineering function for UAV/UAS platform development. In this senior leadership role, you will build and lead a high-performing team of systems engineers, owning end-to-end system architecture, requirements management, and verification & validation across our unmanned aerial platforms — including hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing systems. You will be the technical authority bridging mechanical, electrical, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload sub-disciplines, ensuring the platform is engineered as a coherent, certifiable, and mission-ready system, while partnering closely with program management, manufacturing, quality, and customers to deliver robust, field-proven products.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Establish, lead, and continuously mature the Systems Engineering function — defining processes, tools, and governance for requirements management, system architecture, interface control, and verification & validation (V&V) across the UAV product portfolio.2
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of systems engineers across requirements, architecture, integration, and test disciplines, fostering technical depth, accountability, and career growth.
* Own system-level architecture and trade studies for hybrid VTOL/fixed-wing UAV platforms — balancing payload, endurance, propulsion, structural, and mission performance requirements.
* Drive requirements engineering and traceability from customer/stakeholder needs (GSQR/SRS) through system, subsystem, and component-level specifications, ensuring full bidirectional traceability.
* Lead integration and verification & validation planning across propulsion, avionics, GNC/flight controls, EMI/EMC, structures, and payload subsystems, ensuring compliance to applicable standards (MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, ARP4754A, STANAG, DO-160 where applicable).
* Own technical risk management at the system level — identifying, assessing, and tracking design and integration risks, and driving mitigation through design reviews and test campaigns.
* Chair and govern technical design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) and serve as the senior technical interface with program management, quality, certification bodies (CEMILAC/DGQA), and customers.
* Partner with PMO, manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement to ensure system designs are manufacturable, testable, and aligned with program schedules and cost targets.
* Drive root-cause analysis and design improvements from flight test, field deployment, and reliability/endurance data, closing the loop into the engineering baseline.
* Lead make-vs-buy and vendor technical evaluations for critical subsystems (propulsion, avionics, payload, navigation) and manage technical relationships with external partners and consultants.
* Drive systems engineering tooling and infrastructure investments (requirements management, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), configuration management, simulation platforms).

title: Senior AI Solution Architect
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
  
  
As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.
  
  
Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
  
  
This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader engineering organization.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience giving skills and communicating complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences across different functions
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5+ years of building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale experience
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Hands-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization

* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience (non-internship) in professional software development
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives, both business and technical
* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
* Experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Master's degree or above in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing

Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end-to-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real-time visibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Design the target-state architecture for global planning, defining the co-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End-to-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm & Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive-level decision-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.

Domain Expertise & Planning Principles
  
  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply & Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response & Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re-balancing during disruptions.

Technical Proficiency
  
  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply & Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.
* SAP APO: Deep legacy knowledge of DP and SNP; ability to extract business logic from APO to migrate to modern cloud platforms.
* Integration Technologies: Proficiency in integrating planning hubs with ERP backbones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA or ECC) using SAP CPI-DS, SDI, or flat-file interfaces.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in Supply Chain Planning IT, with at least 5 years as a Solution Architect.
* Implementation Track Record: Proven experience leading at least two global implementations involving the integration of Kinaxis or SAP IBP with a legacy SAP landscape.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or Information Technology.
* Certifications: Kinaxis Certified Author/Architect and/or SAP IBP Professional Certification.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex algorithmic logic (like Optimizer costs or Kinaxis heuristics) into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Analytical Problem Solving: A "systems-thinking" mindset to identify how a planning configuration in one node affects the global network.
* Change Leadership: Experience guiding planning teams through the mindset shift from "Batch Processing" (APO) to "Continuous/Concurrent Planning" (Kinaxis/IBP).

**Lloyd’s Register**
**Location: Mumbai, India**
**What We’re Looking For**
We are looking for a strategic GTM Architecture & Client Data professional who can bridge business, technology and data to deliver scalable, commercially effective solutions. Combining solid Salesforce experience, systems thinking and data governance capability, you will play a key role in shaping LR’s GTM architecture, improving client data quality and enabling more connected, efficient and insight-driven Marketing and Commercial operations. You will be comfortable translating business requirements into practical solutions, managing cross-functional stakeholders and implementing technology, automation and AI-enabled capabilities that support future growth.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
The opportunity to work for an organization that has a clear sense of purpose, is values-based and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programmes.
  
  
A full-time permanent role
  
  
**The role**

* Design and coordinate the evolution of LR’s marketing and go-to-market (GTM) architecture, creating scalable, secure and commercially effective technology solutions.
* Shape the target-state GTM environment across Salesforce, Account Engagement and connected platforms, including system dependencies, integration patterns, data flows and technical standards.
* Develop and manage the marketing technology roadmap, business requirements and prioritised delivery backlog, aligned to the strategic direction set by the Head of Marketing Operations.
* Improve the quality, structure, governance and usability of client, account, contact, lead, opportunity and campaign data.
* Establish data definitions, ownership, validation rules and governance processes, while enhancing account hierarchies, identity resolution, segmentation and data stewardship practices.
* Refine lead, contact, account, opportunity and campaign processes to improve alignment between Marketing and Commercial teams and support better commercial outcomes.
* Translate marketing and commercial requirements into clear solution designs, data specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate delivery with Aventra, CTIO and internal stakeholders, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, tested, documented and maintainable.
* Lead business acceptance testing (UAT), release planning and stakeholder adoption for significant system enhancements and changes.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, integrations and low-code technologies, and evaluate build, buy and partner options for new GTM capabilities.
* Establish the foundations for AI-enabled GTM workflows and decision-support capabilities, ensuring appropriate controls for data access, permissions, privacy, testing, monitoring and human oversight.
* Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Commercial Excellence, CTIO, Reporting & Insights teams and external partners to deliver technology and data solutions that improve decision-making and commercial performance.

**What You Bring**

* Solid experience in GTM architecture, Salesforce, Revenue Operations, Marketing Technology or business systems within a B2B environment.
* Practical knowledge of Salesforce data structures, objects, workflows, automation and security.
* Experience with Account Engagement (formerly Pardot) or a comparable marketing automation platform.
* Experience designing system architectures, data models, integrations or scalable technical solutions.
* Understanding of lead, contact, account, opportunity and campaign management processes.
* Experience improving data quality, governance, validation, identity resolution and stewardship.
* Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into solution designs and technical specifications.
* Experience managing delivery with technology teams, consultants or implementation partners.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, data flows, automation and event-driven concepts.
* Experience with UAT, release governance, documentation and technical acceptance.
* Knowledge of privacy, consent, permissions, access controls and security principles.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with AI-enabled workflows, Data Cloud, integration platforms or low-code technologies.

**You Are Someone Who**

* Is keen to take accountability and ownership for delivering customer needs
* Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards meeting goals
* Is effective at solving problems, trouble-shooting and making timely decisions
* Is motivated and willing to take initiative
* Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language
* Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment
* Responds positively to learning opportunities and is comfortable stepping out of own comfort zone

title: AI Architect & Builder
description:
**About BECO**
BECO is a revolutionary home care brand dedicated to sustainability and eco-friendliness. Our plant-based, bamboo-based products are highly effective and 100% chemical-free, offering environmentally conscious solutions without compromising on quality. As a direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand, we are on a mission to make the world a better place, one home at a time.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a high-agency individual who can design, build, and deploy autonomous AI systems that replace manual workflows across the organization.
  
  
This role is not about experimenting with AI tools — it’s about eliminating human dependency in repeatable processes by building production-grade agentic systems.
  
  
**You Will Own The Full Lifecycle**
problem → workflow design → AI system → deployment → optimization
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Workflow Deconstruction & Automation Strategy
* Analyze business functions (sales, ops, supply chain, finance, CX)
* Break down workflows into decision trees and automation opportunities
* Identify high-ROI automation use cases
* Redesign processes for AI-first execution (not human-first)
* Agentic System Design
* Design multi-step AI workflows (single agent + multi-agent systems)
* Define
* Inputs / outputs
* Memory structures
* Tool usage (APIs, DBs, SaaS tools)
* Decision logic
* Build systems that can:
* Think (LLMs)
* Act (tools, APIs)
* Learn (feedback loops)
* Build & Implementation
* Develop AI agents using:
* OpenAI / Claude / LLM APIs
* Agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.)
* Workflow tools (n8n, Zapier, Make, Retool)
* Integrate with internal systems:
* ERP (SAP / Tally)
* CRM
* Shopify / marketplaces
* Databases
* Communication tools (WhatsApp, email, Slack)
* Deploy production-ready systems (not prototypes)
* Automation Infrastructure
* Build reusable internal automation frameworks
* Create orchestration layers across multiple agents
* Implement monitoring, logging, and failure handling
* Design fallback systems for edge cases
* Optimization & Scaling
* Continuously improve system accuracy, speed, and cost
* Reduce human intervention over time
* Scale automations across departments
* Measure:
* Time saved
* Cost reduced
* Output improved

**Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like)**

* 50–80% reduction in manual operational work
* Fully automated workflows across key functions
* AI agents independently handling end-to-end tasks
* Minimal human oversight required for routine processes

**Required Skills**
**Technical**

* Strong experience with LLMs and prompt engineering
* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.)
* API integrations and system design
* Familiarity with automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make)
* Basic backend understanding (Python / JS preferred)

**Systems Thinking**

* Ability to convert messy real-world workflows into structured systems
* Strong understanding of business processes
* Optimization mindset (speed, cost, scalability)

**Execution**

* High ownership and bias for action
* Ability to ship fast and iterate
* Comfortable working with ambiguity
* Focus on outcomes, not just building tools

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with RPA tools
* Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Tally)
* Experience in FMCG / manufacturing / D2C environments
* Understanding of data pipelines / analytics

**What This Role Is NOT**

* Not a prompt engineer who just writes prompts
* Not a data scientist doing offline models
* Not a consultant making slides
* This is a builder role focused on real-world impact.

**Compensation & Structure**

* High ownership role with direct impact on company efficiency
* Performance-driven incentives tied to automation outcomes
* Opportunity to build and lead an internal AI automation function

**Who Should Apply**

* Builders who have already automated parts of their own workflow
* People who hate repetitive work and want to eliminate it permanently
* Individuals obsessed with leveraging AI for real-world execution

title: Principal Data Consultant
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Employment type:**
Permanent, full-time

**Team:**
Data Platform / Trading Technology

We are seeking a
**Principal Data Engineer**
to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

title: Senior Director - Cloud & AI Platform Engineering
description:
**What are we looking for**

*real solver?*

**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.**
We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

**Your Mission: The Role**

solving for better.

You own delivery for Cloud & AI Platform Engineering: cloud foundations and migration, data platforms, AI and MLOps foundations, private AI, and the agent runtime that sits on top of them. Every CAPE engagement you lead ends with something running in production, with a named owner, at a cost the client can defend.

Most firms split this work into a cloud team, a data team, an AI team and a FinOps function on the side. Agents ignore those boundaries, so the failures land in the gaps between them. You run CAPE as one system, and you hold it to one bar: evidence from production, not a plan someone approved.

If you have led platform delivery at enterprise scale, you are fluent in how agents actually fail, and you treat utilisation and inference cost as seriously as architecture, this is your seat.

**Your Responsibilities**

*what you will wake up to solve.*

**‣Make the estate agent-ready**

* **Own platform delivery end to end:**
  Lead every CAPE engagement across landing zones, migration, data platforms, MLOps and private or sovereign AI, with running production systems as the finish line rather than approved plans.
* **Build the agent runtime properly:**
  Deliver durable execution, multi-agent orchestration, tool interoperability and agent observability, so client agents survive mid-run failures, act safely across systems, and can be operated by whoever inherits them.
* **Engineer what models can see:**
  Treat retrieval, context engineering and decision instrumentation as first-class deliverables, judged by the business decisions they improve.

**‣Run delivery on evidence, not optimism**

* **Own the delivery economics:**
  Be accountable for billable utilisation, effort efficiency and deviation from SOW across the CAPE portfolio, and make sure we have the people before we promise the work.
* **Deliver cost as an outcome:**
  Make cloud and AI economics part of the engagement: cost allocation, commitment restructuring and lower cost per AI task without a drop in quality, proven by measurement.
* **Report performance honestly:**
  Keep partner-funded work visible separately, so margin and utilisation reflect what the business unit actually earns.

**‣Nothing ships unowned**

* **Launch with an owner:**
  Every platform goes live with someone accountable for running it and the telemetry they need from day one.
* **Escalate early:**
  Surface risks to the client-facing lead before the client has to raise them.
* **Plan the next step at launch:**
  Every go-live comes with a view of what to improve next, so delivery becomes a relationship, not a closing date.

**‣Build the bench by route, not by default**

* **Hold the credential bar:**
  Set and enforce the certification and hands-on standard for cloud, data, ML and FinOps crafts, requalified on real delivery evidence, with leaders held to the same bar as engineers.
* **Choose build or buy per capability:**
  Grow existing strengths through training, and hire where the market is moving faster than training can, such as agent platform engineering.
* **Turn delivery into differentiation:**
  Maintain working accelerators for landing zones, agent platforms and retrieval, publish on what the team has learned, and represent Searce with our cloud and AI partners.

**Welcome to Searce**

*The ‘process-first’, AI-native modern tech consultancy that's rewriting the rules.*

**We don’t do traditional.**

As an engineering-led consultancy, we are dedicated to relentlessly improving the real business outcomes. Our solvers co-innovate with clients to
**futurify**
operations and make processes smarter, faster & better. We build alongside our clients. Not for the vanity metrics. But for the transformation to embed lasting competitive advantage for our clients.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

* Lab & POC Execution — Ability to recreate customer issues in lab environments, validate configurations, and support customer demos and POCs.

* Documentation Excellence — Ability to create HLDs, LLDs, test plans, migration runbooks, and operational documentation for SD-WAN solutions.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or software as a service applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing software releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the system. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt applications accordingly is a key part of daily activities, ensuring seamless operation and continuous improvement of the software landscape.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end implementations of SAP Group Reporting across S/4HANA programs (On-Premises or Public Cloud)

Manage client workshops to define Group Reporting architecture, scope, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Own solution architecture for legal/Management consolidation, intercompany elimination, COI (Consolidation of Investments), currency translation, and data collection
  
  
Engage with senior finance stakeholders (CFO/Controllers) to capture requirements and provide advisory on consolidation process design and reporting

Manage integration of GR with S/4 Universal Journal (ACDOCA), GRDC, and external systems (via flat files or APIs)
  
  
Govern the ICMR (Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation) process and integrate it into Data Monitor
  
  
Deliver structured and ad-hoc reporting via Fiori apps, SAP Analysis for Office (AFO), and SAC
  
  
Drive project documentation (Blueprints, Functional Specs, Test Scripts) and ensure traceability through UAT and deployment
  
  
Lead project teams, mentor junior consultants (L10/L11), and ensure timely and quality delivery
  
  
Support pre-sales activities, including effort estimation, solutioning, and proposal building
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* 8 years of Finance/overall experience including at least 3+ years of hands-on SAP Group Reporting implementation

Strong functional understanding of legal & management consolidation, accounting principles, IC reconciliation, and financial close processes
  
  
Hands-on experience in:
  
  

* Data Monitor & Consolidation Monitor
* Legal consolidation processes i.e Data collection, Currency translation, Elimination, reclassification and other processes

* SAC integration for consolidated reporting

Experience in at least 3+ full lifecycle implementations of SAP Group Reporting (S/4 On-premise or Public Cloud)
  
  
Good exposure to SAP BPC and/or SAC Planning is an advantage
  
  
SAP certification in Group Reporting or S/4HANA for Finance preferred
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:

In this role we are looking for an experienced

+ SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
+ Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
+ Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.

title: Salesforce Application Architect
description:
SOVOS
  
  
Salesforce Application Architect
  
  
Accounting/Finance·Full-Time·India
  
  
Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process
  
  
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
  
  
1
  
  
Pre-Employment Assessment
  
  
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
  
  
2
  
  
Video Interview
  
  
A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
  
  
3
  
  
Meeting with a Recruiter
  
  
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
  
  
4
  
  
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
  
  
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
  
  
Life at Sovos
  
  
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
Company Background
  
  
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
  
  
Ready to make your move?
  
  
We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application
  
  
SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.

title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.
  
Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. The role is accountable for controlling technical risks, dependencies and delivery quality throughout each implementation.
  
  
 
  
**Key Accountabilities and Main Responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus
  

* Provide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities.
* Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features.
* Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management.
* Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership
* Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare.
* Own or guide solution architecture, configuration and technical design across Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence and, where in scope, Payroll, Talent Management and Workforce Compensation.
* Design and oversee integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP services, file-based interfaces and related middleware patterns.
* Lead reporting and analytics solutions using OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts and approved enterprise reporting platforms.
* Plan and oversee data conversion, reconciliation and migration activities, including mapping, cleansing, validation, cutover and post-load assurance.
* Act as a liaison between People Operations and Technology, partnering closely with functional SMEs, developers and vendors to ensure business processes, functional designs and technical components are coherent, supportable and fit for purpose.
* Provide estimates, delivery plans and technical work packages, and actively manage scope, milestones, resources, dependencies and issues.
* Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues.
* Coordinate environment management, quarterly Oracle updates, regression testing, deployment readiness and controlled production releases.
* Evaluate new Oracle HCM and Oracle Fusion AI capabilities through structured assessment, proof of concept and risk review before adoption.

  
Operational Management
  

* Act as a senior escalation point for complex Oracle HCM incidents, integrations, security, reporting and data issues.
* Ensure production support is timely and disciplined, with clear incident ownership, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
* Monitor interface health, scheduled processes, technical debt and recurring defects, and prioritise remediation based on business impact and risk.
* Maintain accurate business requirements, functional and technical specifications, configuration workbooks, solution diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, release records and support documentation.
* Define and support service transition to internal teams and vendors, including operating and support models, knowledge transfer, service documentation and measurable acceptance criteria.

  
  
People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership 
  
 
  
  

* Provide day-to-day technical direction, coaching and quality oversight to technical consultants, analysts and delivery partners.
* Build trusted relationships with People, Payroll, Technology, Security, Finance, Risk and external vendors.
* Communicate complex technical matters in clear business language and support informed decision-making without overstating certainty or benefits.
* Promote collaborative delivery, constructive challenge, accountability and continuous learning across project and operational teams.

  
Governance, Security and Risk
  

* Ensure solutions comply with approved architecture, privacy, security, access control, change management and data governance requirements.
* Design and review role-based security, data access and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with relevant control owners.
* Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance.
* Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
* Ensure third-party delivery is governed through defined outcomes, quality standards, documentation requirements and knowledge transfer.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not exhaustive and may change from time to time based on business needs.
  
  
 
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  

* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 10+ years of enterprise applications or IT consulting experience, including substantial hands-on experience delivering Oracle Cloud HCM implementations, enhancements and transformation programmes from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment and post-production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex Oracle HCM technical workstreams or end-to-end delivery in a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Strong technical and functional understanding of Oracle Cloud HCM, with depth across Core HR and experience in modules such as Recruiting, Time and Labour and Absence Management. Exposure to Payroll, Talent Management or Workforce Compensation is advantageous.
* Hands-on capability with Oracle Integration Cloud, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST and SOAP web services, BI Publisher and OTBI.
* Experience with business process analysis, functional consulting, solution architecture, integrations, data migration, reporting, security, environments, release management and production support.
* Demonstrated fluency in business processes, digital transformation and support models, with the ability to connect operating needs to practical technology outcomes.
* Understanding and experience with Oracle E-Business Suite is advantageous.
* Experience managing Oracle quarterly updates, regression impacts, deployment planning and post-production stabilisation.
* Ability to evaluate Oracle AI and automation capabilities pragmatically, with appropriate attention to data quality, privacy, security, control and human review.
* Oracle Cloud HCM certifications are highly regarded. Relevant certifications may include Global Human Resources, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, Integration or Oracle Fusion AI capabilities.
