title: Salesforce Application Architect
description:
Salesforce Application Architect – Sovos SOVOS
**Salesforce Application Architect**
Accounting/Finance· Full-Time
  
  

* India

Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're building the platform that makes tax compliance simple for thousands of global enterprises. As Salesforce Application Architect, you'll own the technical architecture and engineering of our Salesforce ecosystem, designing scalable solutions that power our go-to-market operations and integrate AI-powered automation directly into production. This is a senior technical leadership role where you'll balance deep platform engineering, CPQ expertise, and modern AI tooling to deliver reliable, maintainable systems at global scale. Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes - apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own the Salesforce technical architecture across Sales Cloud, CPQ, and Service Cloud, designing scalable, maintainable solutions that balance declarative and programmatic approaches with a strong focus on long-term platform health and org simplicity.
* Govern platform engineering standards for Apex, LWC, SFDX, and Flow automation, including coding standards, architecture and code reviews, bulkification patterns, metadata hygiene, and technical debt remediation to keep the platform performant as it scales.
* Design and maintain the Salesforce security model including org-wide defaults, role hierarchy, permission sets, permission set groups, field-level security, and sharing rules; conduct periodic security audits and enforce least-privilege access.
* Architect and engineer the Salesforce CPQ platform, including product catalogue, pricing rules, QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), Advanced Approvals, amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation; own end-to-end Quote-to-Cash process integrity and integrations with Zuora and NetSuite via middleware.
* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered features directly on the Salesforce platform using LLM APIs (Claude, Copilot), including agentic data-quality workflows, deal and quoting chatbots grounded in CPQ data, and AI-assisted development workflows; evaluate and govern Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce agents, Einstein Copilot, and Prompt Builder.
* Architect and govern Salesforce integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, named credentials, and External Services; set clear standards for declarative versus programmatic callout patterns and partner with data and integrations teams on middleware strategy.
* Lead Salesforce DevOps practices using Salesforce DX and CI/CD pipelines; govern platform health via Salesforce Health Check, Code Analyser in the CI pipeline, and org limits monitoring; enforce sandbox strategy, environment governance, and AppExchange package evaluation.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for the Salesforce team; conduct code and architecture reviews, mentor administrators and developers, and partner with Sales Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into sound technical design, communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Lead Salesforce workstreams for M&A due diligence and post-close integration; own platform controls aligned to SOX ITGC requirements including change management controls, access review evidence, and audit log configuration.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built deep platform expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, CPQ, Service Cloud, and integrations in a global SaaS environment, with solid architecture and engineering skills demonstrated over the course of your career.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect required; Certified Data Architect or Sharing and Visibility Architect strongly preferred; strong data architecture skills including large data volume (LDV) management (skinny tables, custom indexes, archiving), SOQL query optimisation, and data migration design.
* Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist required or equivalent experience; deep hands-on experience with QCP (JavaScript quoting processes), MDQ (multi-dimensional quoting), amendment and renewal logic, and ARR categorisation across upsell, cross-sell, churn, migration, and recontracting scenarios.
* Demonstrated experience building AI/LLM integrations directly on the Salesforce platform using Claude API, Gemini API, or equivalent, including agentic workflows and AI-powered automation in production CRM environments; familiarity with Salesforce-native AI capabilities including Agentforce, Einstein Copilot, Prompt Builder, and Einstein Trust Layer.
* Strong Apex, LWC, and Flow development expertise; ability to set and enforce coding standards, perform code reviews, design complex Flow automation (screen flows, Flow Orchestration), and govern the declarative automation layer at scale.
* Experience with Salesforce integration architecture including REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, External Services, and middleware platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft); Zuora and NetSuite integration experience a strong plus; proficiency with Salesforce DevOps (SFDX, CI/CD, Copado, Prodly, or Gearset) and platform governance.
* Comfort with AI-assisted development workflows and leveraging AI tools to improve platform architecture, engineering quality, and delivery speed; strong written and verbal English communication skills for cross-time-zone executive stakeholder engagement.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

The Process
  
  
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
  
  
1
  
  
Pre-Employment Assessment
  
  
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
  
  
2
  
  
Video Interview
  
  
A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
  
  
3
  
  
Meeting with a Recruiter
  
  
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
  
  
4
  
  
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
  
  
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
  
  
Life at Sovos
  
  
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
  
  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
  
  
**Company Background**
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
  
  
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
  
  
**Ready to make your move?**
We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

**Founding Engineer | IIT/BITS**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Role: Full time, Founding Team**

**Joining: November**

Looking for an engineer who is also an Entrepreneur, Builder and Mr. Figureoutable at heart to join our founding team.

**About Us:**

We are a D2C brand led by IITR alum. We are pre-launch and have raised pre-seed funding backed by founders of Souled Store, TIGC, partners from Investment banking, and strong startup operators.

We aim to become a 5000 Crore brand by 2030 and tech would be at the core of how we achieve this goal.

**But why hire in tech for a D2C brand?**

We're building what we hope will be
**one of India's first truly AI-native, tech-first D2C brands.**

* Not a D2C company that occasionally uses ChatGPT.
* A company where AI and technology are at the core of how we operate, make decisions, serve customers, and scale

Thus we are looking for a
**Founding Engineer cum AI builder**

to make this happen.

**Who are we looking for?**

* A strong full-stack engineer, AI enthusiast, problem solver, and someone with serious entrepreneurial energy.
* Has a high bias for action. You'd rather ship something in 3 days than discuss it for 3 weeks.
* Someone who can independently take products from idea to deployment.
* Can build for web and mobile (or is confident in figuring out what they don't know).
* Is genuinely excited about, stays highly updated and has built products using AI, LLMs, agents, and automation.

* Bonus: ex-founders, ex-founding engineer at funded startups

Pretty much everything tech.

* Build our website, mobile app, and customer-facing experiences.
* Build AI agents and automate workflows across marketing, operations, customer experience, and more.
* Experiment with new AI tools, ship quickly, break things, fix things.
* Own the entire tech stack, from writing code to deploying products.

description:

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Position Title:**
Sr. Manager – IT (Technical Lead – Retail Systems)

**Experience Required:**
6–10 years

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a
**hands-on technical IT generalist**
to handle end-to-end ownership of our retail IT systems. You will be the single point of contact for all technical initiatives, support, integrations, and new developments. You need to
**own systems**
like POS, CRM, P2P, Loyalty, MDM, and various integrations. You will work directly with functional teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. System Ownership**

* **POS Billing Application**
  – Support, bug fixes, Change requests.
* **CRM Application**
  – User support, data fixes, reports.
* **B2B (Vendor Management)**
  – Logic changes, integration fixes.
* **Attendance & HRMS.**
* **P2P (Procure to Pay)**
  – Finance-critical processes.
* **Digital Invoice, NPS, Loyalty Systems**
  .

**2. Integration Management**

* Monitor, debug, and fix broken integrations (POS ↔ ERP, CRM ↔ Loyalty, etc.)
* Document all integrations.
* Proactively identify brittle integrations.

**3. New Developments**

* Take requirements from functional team.
* Architect solutions.
* Build internal tools using .NET, SQL Server, MySQL, and frontend (HTML/CSS/JS).

**4. Team SPOC for Technical Initiatives**

* Work directly with Functional team.
* Decide technical approach, database design, API contracts.

**5. Support & Triage**

* Bugs come directly to you from functional team.
* You fix or get it fixed with supoodelegate
* You communicate timelines and root causes back to business

**Must-Have Skills (Non-negotiable)**

Area Requirement
**.**

**NET**
Can read, modify, and write small-to-medium apps (WinForms/ASP.NET/Core)

**SQL**
Advanced queries, stored procedures (SQL Server + MySQL)

**Frontend**
HTML, CSS, JavaScript – enough to build internal tools

**Integrations**
Has worked with REST APIs, JSON, XML, file-based (SFTP, CSV) integrations

**System Thinking**
Can look at a bug in POS and trace it to an integration or database issue

**Communication**
Can talk to functional people without getting frustrated

**Good-to-Have**

* Helpdesk or ticketing system exposure
* Loyalty system or retail domain experience
* Experience working in a small team without dedicated architects

You will focus 100% on
**applications, databases, and integrations**
.

**Behavioral Expectations (Critical)**

* **Self-sufficient**
  – You will not get daily handholding. You will explore logs, read code, ask functional team, and figure it out.
* **Calm under pressure**
  – POS down on Saturday evening? You own it.
* **Documenter**
  – You will document what you fix.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
  
  
You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end-to-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor-powered workflows (e.g., large-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product

You may be a fit if
  
  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end-to-end - if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

* As the Director of Engineering for Teradata's Autonomous Platform, you will lead and grow two engineering teams responsible for building and delivering core agentic AI-powered platform capabilities: Autonomous Data Platform (ADP) and Workload Management (WLM). **Organizational & People Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop multiple engineering teams spanning platform engineering, AI/ML, and distributed systems.
* Build and scale high-performing teams; attract, retain, and grow top technical talent in agentic AI, developer platforms, and cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
Join the EisnerAI team, a fast-growing organization within EisnerAmper that is redefining how professional services harness the power of Artificial Intelligence. As an AI Engineer specializing in MLOps and AIOps, you will play a critical role in deploying, operating, and optimizing enterprise-grade AI solutions built on Azure, collaborating closely with AI Developers, Product Owners, Governance leaders and Cloud Architects to ensure these systems are reliable, scalable, and cost-effective across tax, audit, advisory, and client-facing applications. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps—it’s about engineering AI into the fabric of enterprise operations, enabling secure, observable, and governed machine learning deployments that deliver real business impact.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**

* Deploy and monitor AI models across Azure services with robust telemetry for performance, drift, and availability.
* Manage model upgrades including APIs and UIs with structured rollout, version control, and rollback support.
* Optimize performance and cost through testing, profiling, and tuning of inference infrastructure and pipelines.
* Implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and lifecycle management using Azure ML and GitHub Actions.
* Ensure compliant change management for all AI-related deployments, with auditability, security, and governance controls.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
* 3+ years in MLOps and/or AIOps, ideally within Azure cloud environment with hands-on experience with Azure ML, Synapse, Data Lake, App Services, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry

**Preferred/Desired Qualifications**

* Consulting background with a strong bias for action.
* Workflow Design: Prompt flow, automation pipelines, and human-in-the-loop systems
* Post-Training Techniques: Fine-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF, and domain adaptation
* Azure DevOps, App Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Managed Identity integration.
* Tools for inference performance testing and profiling (e.g., locust, K6, or custom scripts).
* Model Evaluation: Performance metrics, benchmark development, and A/B testing frameworks
* Understanding of model observability, telemetry, and incident response for AI systems.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 5000 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
  
  
Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: india.recruiting@eisneramper.com

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Build, maintain, and improve Terraform modules and configurations for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Support platform upgrades, configuration changes, capacity planning, and operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Build and operate governed CI/CD pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Work with GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling.
* Create self-service patterns that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Support production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Help establish repeatable practices for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Contribute to GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Use tools such as PagerDuty, Splunk, New Relic, Arize, or equivalent observability platforms.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, infrastructure problems, endpoint failures, and performance degradation.
* Participate in on-call support, contribute to root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventative actions
* Integrate IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance & Platform Enablement
* Improve cloud cost visibility, resource utilization, capacity management, and FinOps practices for data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.
* Document platform standards, operational procedures, troubleshooting guidance, and reusable deployment patterns.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

FinTech SaaS

2-5 years

**About Global PayEX**

At Global PayEX, we build AI-driven fintech platforms trusted by JPMorgan, Citi, ITC, and Tata Group. Our solutions enable real-time reconciliation, payments, and working-capital automation across global enterprises. We’re scaling rapidly and strengthening our DevSecOps practice to enhance platform reliability, automation, and cloud security. We’re looking for a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer who loves building secure, scalable, and automated cloud environments that support enterprise-grade workloads.

**Role Overview**

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the deployment, security, and reliability of our microservices-based infrastructure on AWS. You’ll work closely with developers, SREs, and security teams to automate pipelines, enforce security best practices, and ensure our Kubernetes-based workloads are efficient and compliant. This role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and automation scripting in Python and Shell.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Manage and maintain AWS infrastructure (EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).

• Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Write and maintain Helm charts for service deployments and configuration management.

• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions).

• Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

• Automate operational tasks using Python and Shell scripting.

• Integrate security scans, compliance checks, and secret management into CI/CD workflows.

• Monitor system performance and troubleshoot production issues using Prometheus, Grafana, or CloudWatch.

• Collaborate with engineering and security teams to ensure DevSecOps best practices are followed across environments.

• Participate in incident response and postmortem reviews.

title: Solution Architect (Fluent)
description:
**Introduction**
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Fluent Commerce OMS Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design,
  
  
implementation, and technical direction of enterprise-scale Order Management System (OMS) solutions using Fluent
  
  
Commerce.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Fluent Commerce, distributed OMS architecture, retail and
  
  
eCommerce workflows, system integrations, and cloud-native architectures, along with strong experience
  
  
translating complex business requirements into scalable and resilient technical solutions.
  
  
This role will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, developers, integration teams, and other
  
  
technical leaders to define architecture and deliver high-performance OMS solutions supporting complex omnichannel
  
  
business models.
  
  
**Solution Architecture & Technical Design**
l Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Fluent Commerce OMS implementations.
  
  
l Design scalable, API-driven, event-based, and distributed OMS architectures.
  
  
l Define solution architecture, technical blueprints, and integration patterns aligned with retail and eCommerce best
  
  
practices.
  
  
l Translate complex business and functional requirements into robust technical architecture and detailed solution
  
  
designs.
  
  
l Define architecture principles, technology standards, design patterns, and technical best practices.
  
  
l Review and validate solution designs, configurations, custom extensions, APIs, and integration approaches.
  
  
l Ensure solutions meet required standards for performance, security, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  
  
l Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, and dependencies and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
  
**OMS & Fluent Commerce Architecture**
l Provide technical leadership across the complete order lifecycle, including order capture, fulfillment, allocation,
  
  
orchestration, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and inventory management.
  
  
l Design and architect Distributed Order Management (DOM) solutions for complex omnichannel business models.
  
  
l Define inventory orchestration and fulfillment strategies across multiple locations and channels.
  
  
l Architect Fluent Commerce extensions and configurations based on business and technical requirements.
  
  
l Ensure the OMS architecture supports scalability, flexibility, maintainability, and high availability.
  
  
**Integration Architecture**
l Define and oversee integration architecture between Fluent Commerce OMS and enterprise systems, including:
  
  
l Payment gateways: PayPal, Adyen, and Stripe
  
  
l ERP platforms: SAP and Oracle
  
  
l Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  
  
l eCommerce platforms: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, and Magento
  
  
l CRM and loyalty platforms
  
  
l Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, asynchronous communication, and
  
  
event-driven architectures.
  
  
l Define reliable data flow and integration patterns between upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
l Review API contracts, integration specifications, data mappings, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  
  
l Ensure integrations are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
**Technical Governance & Quality**
l Establish technical governance across OMS implementations.
  
  
l Conduct architecture reviews and design walkthroughs.
  
  
l Review technical deliverables and provide architectural guidance to development and integration teams.
  
  
l Define non-functional requirements and ensure they are incorporated into the solution design.
  
  
l Drive best practices around coding standards, integration design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production
  
  
readiness.
  
  
l Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
l Lead technical and solution architecture workshops with client stakeholders.
  
  
l Collaborate with business, functional, technical, and integration teams to understand requirements and define
  
  
appropriate solutions.
  
  
l Present architecture decisions, technical approaches, and solution recommendations to technical and non-technical
  
  
stakeholders.
  
  
l Act as the primary technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions.
  
  
l Provide technical guidance during implementation, production support, incident triage, and root cause analysis.
  
  
l Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, technical estimations, architecture proposals, and RFP
  
  
responses.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
l 10+ years of overall IT experience with enterprise systems and large-scale digital platforms.
  
  
l 4+ years of hands-on experience with Fluent Commerce OMS.
  
  
l Strong expertise in Order Management Systems and Distributed Order Management (DOM).
  
  
l Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, including order orchestration, fulfillment, returns and
  
  
exchanges, cancellations and refunds, and inventory orchestration.
  
  
l Strong experience designing REST APIs, JSON-based integrations, webhooks, and
  
  
asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
  
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and distributed systems.
  
  
l Experience designing scalable, resilient, and high-availability solutions.
  
  
l Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  
  
l Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum delivery models.
  
  
l Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
l Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice To Have**
l Experience working in omnichannel retail and large-scale eCommerce environments.
  
  
l Experience with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  
  
l Experience integrating Fluent Commerce with SAP, Oracle, WMS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify,
  
  
Magento, CRM, and payment platforms.
  
  
l Prior experience in client-facing consulting or solution architecture roles.
  
  
l Experience designing and supporting high-availability production systems.
  
  
l Experience participating in pre-sales, RFPs, solution proposals, and technical estimations.
  
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and integration best practices.

title: Senior Engineer
description:

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will own complex problem areas end-to-end, influence system architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver scalable solutions in a fast-growing, product-led environment.

**About Blenheim Chalcot:**
Blenheim Chalcot India is part of Blenheim Chalcot, a global venture builder headquartered in London. With over 26 years of innovation, we've been at the forefront of creating some of the most groundbreaking GenAI-enabled companies. Our ventures lead the charge in digital disruption across a spectrum of industries, from FinTech to EdTech, GovTech to Media, and beyond. Our global presence spans the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with a portfolio that employs over 3,000 individuals, manages assets exceeding £1.8 billion, and boasts total portfolio sales of over £500 million.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a Senior / Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and delivering scalable systems across core platforms. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Engineering teams in Mumbai and London, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Successful candidates will take a leading role within our Engineering Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, with day to day responsibilities which will include.
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Oversee the planning and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise to the team, promoting best practices in engineering.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Implement and maintain ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes using scalable pipelines and data architecture.
* Ensure data integrity and quality across various data sources.
* Support data-driven decision-making by providing clean, reliable, and timely data.
* Design, develop, and maintain the data models used by ML Engineers, Data Analysts and Data Scientists to access data.
* Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and trends.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and drive continuous improvement in operations.
* Stay updated on industry trends, technologies, and best practices in engineering.

**About You:**
We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Professional experience in full-stack software engineering with evidence of architecting and delivering production systems at scale.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing engineers and raising code quality standards.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages commonly used in engineering, such as Python or Java.
* Extensive experience with database systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud data platforms like AWS or Azure (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Data Factory, Azure Synapse, etc.).
* Experience with CI/CD practices for data solutions.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude etc) and building AI-enabled features (e.g., LLMs, automation workflows, prompt engineering, AI-assisted development) to enhance product capabilities and engineering productivity.
* Proven ability to take ownership over outputs and drive complex data projects to completion.
* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.

Behaviours that we look for
  
  

* Rigorous problem-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.
* Clean, performant, and secure code. Chooses suitable data structures, writes readable & defensive code, and bakes in performance and security from the start.
* Test-first and observable engineering. Designs for testability, automates meaningful unit/integration tests, and implements robust logging, metrics, and monitoring.
* Production and operations excellence. Understands CI/CD, infrastructure and cost drivers, engineers for reliable development, resilience, and fast recovery.
* Data-driven, outcome-focused decisions. Validates ideas with data, plans for schema evaluation, and aligns features with real user impact.

Process - We have a rigorous, but streamlined recruitment process, which respects the time of candidates and portfolio companies alike. This process starts with a 15-minute call with our Talent Acquisition team and a member of the Engineering Centre of Excellence, followed by further interviews with the Engineering Centre of Excellence team.
  
  
Please note that our roles are primarily office based, with modern and well-connected office locations in both Andheri East and Navi Mumbai.

title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
description:
**Job Description – Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation

Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
  
  
This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery.
  
  
Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7+ years of experience in hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
* Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
* Deep understanding of sales automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and related technologies, including ERP tools, payment automation, billing automation, and CPQ
* Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and an understanding of how to build cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization

description:
Job Title: Reconciliation Domain & Java Architect [Techno Functional]
  
  
Department: CEFS-Reconciliation
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The IT Reconciliations Department is managing the reconciliations (Financial, Referential, Systems to Systems, ...) for a number of BNP Paribas's domains (Global Markets, Global Banking, Security Services, Wealth Management, ...) via specialized expert systems (FIS DIM/Intellimatch, Pega PCM, Socrates).
  
  
Our internal clients are working 24/7 at a worldwide level with a high level of reliability. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is the key partner in all IT functions and has interactions with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. To ensure our efficiency and alignment with the market expectations, we have to ensure that both our architecture and our technologies are up to date and aligned with the most efficient and reliable standards.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The Reconciliation Domain Architect is the single authority for translating the business vision of the reconciliation portfolio into a technically robust, cloud native platform. The position owns both sides of the architecture –
  
  

* Domain side: design and maintain the end to end reconciliation process, rule catalog, exception handling workflow and canonical data model, ensuring continual alignment with regulatory, audit and compliance requirements.
* Technical side: define the Java microservice landscape, streaming pipelines, persistence strategy, CI/CD and cloud deployment model (Kubernetes/Docker), guaranteeing high availability, scalability, performance and security. Keep the platform reliable, future ready and aligned with client service standards.

The position has a strong focus on stability, flexibility, and expertise to always guarantee the proper Clients’ expectations. Working in an international Clients base environment but also as part of an Offshore organization, the capacity to interact in a respectful and easy way with both his/her Clients, Management, and team to find compromises while guaranteeing the proper organization and seamless relations is a must.
  
  
This position requires strong leadership, communication, and adaptability to navigate the complexities of working in a globally distributed environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Domain Architecture
* Define the Reconciliation domain roadmap, business‑rule catalog, exception‑handling work flow and canonical data model; keep it aligned with regulations and internal audit requirements.
* Lead the creation and maintenance of Architecture Decision Records and enforce domain-wise standards.
* Champion a culture of continuous learning, inclusive collaboration and knowledge sharing across geographies.
* Technical Architecture
* Ensure system reliability, scalability, stability and security by implementing appropriate design patterns and architectural principles.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend enhancements to optimize performance.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation.
* Design the Java micro‑service landscape, CI/CD pipeline, container‑orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and infrastructure-as-code, and monitoring tools.
* Establish security‑by‑design patterns and embed them in all solutions.
* Ensure that all solutions are well-documented and align with industry’s best practices.
* Own API and message‑schema contracts for all inbound/outbound feeds, manage versioning and backward compatibility.
* Define data‑lineage, master‑data‑management and data‑quality controls required for auditability
* Performance, Scalability & Resilience
* Set SLA/KPI targets (throughput, latency, availability) and lead capacity‑planning, performance‑tuningand resilience engineering.
* Translate regulatory and audit requirements into concrete technical controls (encryption, immutable logging, data‑retention).
* Conduct periodic risk assessments of architectural decisions and produce mitigation plans.
* Present findings to stakeholders to validate requirements or guide decision-making.
* Ensure test‑data management and reproducible environments for continuous delivery.
* Define performance‑testing and automated regression frameworks for the reconciliation platform.
* Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and IT, facilitating effective communication and alignment.
* Facilitate workshops, road‑mapping sessions and regular status briefings, manage expectations and negotiate trade‑offs.
* Documentation and User Training
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation, user manuals, SOP and materials.
* Lead onboarding, mentoring and up‑skilling programs for architects, senior developers and QA engineers.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Proficiency in business analysis tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives: DevSecOps adoption, automated contract testing, observability
* Assist in recruiting, onboarding and upskilling of new architects and senior developers.
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long-term commitment with the team and organization

**Specific Qualifications**

* 12-15yearstotal experience, minimum 5 years in the Banking/Financial Reconciliation domain and 5 years in senior Java architecture roles.
* Experience in Banking Financial domain, covering Reconciliation domain
* Experience working on Reconciliation tools
* A proven experience in multi-expertise team management in an international environment,
* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,
* A very good English level is mandatory,

**Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field; Master’s degree or certifications such as TOGAF are a plus.
  
  
**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
Technical & Soft Skills:
  
  

* Knowledge of Reconciliation, types of reconciliation, case and investigation management
* Working knowledge of reconciliation tools likeIntelliMatch, Duco, Gresham, TLM
* Proven experience in architecting and implementing microservices and distributed systems.
* Deep understanding of software design patterns, principles, and best practices.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures.
* Expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs and integrating with external systems.
* Proficiency in working with databases: SQL (Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB).
* Hands-on experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of security principles and best practices for securing applications and data.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with a focus on performance optimization.
* Capacity to structure, synthesize and summarize concepts,
* Resilience in a strong pressure environment,
* Strong track record in successful interactions with peers in a non-hierarchical framework.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Proven ability to lead and mentor technical teams across multiple projects.
* Strong communications kills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to balance technical requirements with business needs.
* Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and solving challenges.
