title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

**Required**
Your skills and experience that will help you excel
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Sr. Manager - Platform Products
description:
**Synopsis of the role:**
As the Platform Product Manager, you will be the product owner of Equifax India’s core data and decisioningplatforms. Your customers are both internal product teams (Retail, Commercial, Workforce Solutions) and external developer teams at top banks and FinTechs who consume our APIs. You will manage the lifecycle of our high-scale API gateways, tokenization registries, entity resolution (identity matching) algorithms, and orchestration engines. This role demands a deeply technical product leader who can bridge the gap between complex cloud architecture and commercial product usability, ensuring our platforms are scalable, reliable, and compliant.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute the roadmap for Equifax India's underlying data platform infrastructure. Modernize and scale the platform to handle multi-tenant cloud deployments, high-throughput batch loads, and sub-second real-time API performance.
* Standardize and manage Equifax India's API architecture, developer portals, and software development kits (SDKs). Ensure seamless, secure, and developer-friendly onboarding for external B2B clients.
* Prioritize platform architectural upgrades, security patching, and scalability.
* Define and track core platform KPIs such as API Uptime (SLAs), Latency (p99 metrics), and Match Rates.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects, Cloud Engineers, Infosec, Data Science, and Application Product
* Managers to ensure the underlying platform seamlessly supports new product launches.
* Embed data governance, access controls, data localization frameworks, and compliance policies (such as the DPDP Act and RBI guidelines) directly into the platform architecture by design.
* Maintain a continuous pulse on the global Equifax product portfolio.
* Proactively evaluate global platform capabilities and determine their feasibility for the Indian market.
* Translate global technology features into tangible business solutions for the Indian BFSI ecosystem.
* Partner with local business units to build business cases and pilot frameworks for imported global assets.
* Represent Equifax India in global platform governance councils. Articulate the region's technical requirements, market urgency, and regulatory mandates (such as the DPDP Act and RBI directives) to secure global engineering bandwidth and funding.
* Own the local sprint execution, API strategy and data orchestration frameworks.
* Ensure that local modifications gracefully co-exist with global core platform architecture without creating technical debt.
* Act as the single source of truth for global platform updates within Equifax India.
* Conduct regular enablement sessions for local product managers, sales engineers, and leadership to keep them aligned with upcoming global capabilities.

**What Experience You Need**

* 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 4+ years as a Platform/Technical Product Manager operating within a global cross-functional setup.
* Proven experience working across international time zones and collaborating with distributed engineering and product hubs (specifically US or European counterparts).
* Strong understanding of global cloud-native infrastructures (AWS or GCP), microservices architecture, enterprise API management, data lakehouse designs, and real-time event streaming.
* Demonstrated ability to take a global enterprise product or software capability and successfully modify,localize, and commercialize it for a distinct regional market.
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a highly quantitative discipline.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence global engineering leaders and corporate executives to prioritize regional initiatives without having direct reporting authority over them.
* Ability to articulate complex, localized Indian financial market nuances (e.g., the Account Aggregator network, UPI volumes, localized bureau data formatting) into generalized technical concepts that global teams can easily grasp.
* Experience working with Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFe) or managing complex dependencies across multiple global Jira backlogs and CI/CD deployment release cycles.
* Clear understanding of Indian data residency, localization mandates, and data privacy principles governed by the DPDP Act.

title: Data Engineering Manager | Snowflake, Kafka, Airflow & AI-Enabled Data Platforms | Navi Mumbai
description:
**Role:**
Data Engineering Manager

**Location:**
Vashi, Navi Mumbai (4 days working from office)

**Work Timings:**
Work from office (12:00pm to 5:00pm) and then support remotely (7:30pm to 10:30pm)

**Job Description**

As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at PitchBook. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love leading a team of passionate data engineers, building data-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and PitchBook’s platform
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures using modern cloud technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Docker)
* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence
* Champion data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards across the enterprise data ecosystem
* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize data storage, compute performance, and cost efficiency
* Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles, including at least 2–3 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
* Proven experience designing and maintaining large-scale data architectures, pipelines, and data models in cloud environments (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of data governance, quality, and compliance frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise data sources (CRM, ERP, Marketing Automation, Financial Systems, etc.) is preferred
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, model deployment, or data-driven automation is a strong plus
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams and lead through change

**Working Conditions**

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

title: AI / ML Modelling Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The role centers on creating next‑generation AML capabilities and will be instrumental in protecting the BNPP Group from fraud, money‑laundering, and other financial crimes by using advanced technologies and innovative solutions.
  
  
As an AI-ML Engineer, you will design, train and deploy machine learning models that detect money laundering and financial crime. This position is vital for shaping the core detection capability of the platform. This also involves execution of various AML initiatives, thereby strengthening the organization’s overall risk management.
  
  
While direct AML experience is not mandatory, a strong foundation in machine learning, sound engineering practices, and a willingness to learn the financial-crime domain are essential. Familiarity with regulated environments, model governance, or fraud and anomaly detection is an advantage, but we are primarily looking for engineers who can build robust, well-calibrated, production-grade models and reason carefully about their real-world impact. The role will operate within a globally distributed environment.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Model Development & Evaluation – Design, train, and assess ML models (NNs, GNNs, gradient‑boosted ensembles, unsupervised anomaly detectors) for money‑laundering detection across transaction, client, and network levels.
* Feature Engineering Pipeline – Build and optimise Spark/Delta Lake pipelines, ensuring feature consistency between training and production.
* Lifecycle Management – Track experiments, version models, and run champion‑challenger workflows with MLflow.
* Low‑Latency Deployment – Deploy and maintain inference services (e.g., BentoML) on the on‑prem Kubernetes platform.
* Calibration & Scoring – Calibrate models and map scores to probabilities to deliver reliable, decision‑ready risk scores.
* Explainability & Governance – Provide model explainability for audits, document design/assumptions/validation, and guarantee full reproducibility and auditability for regulatory compliance.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Partner with data engineers, graph/LLM specialists, and compliance analysts to translate detection requirements into production‑ready models.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Python engineering & secure code – Expert in object‑oriented, modular, and reusable Python code; packaging, logging, metrics, and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry); security primitives (OAuth2/JWT) and data‑privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA).
* ML modeling & calibration – Hands‑on with PyTorch (custom architectures, focal loss, training loops, GPU optimization), XGBoost/LightGBM, scikit‑learn/Keras/TensorFlow; deep knowledge of model calibration (Platt scaling, score‑to‑probability, MC‑Dropout), evaluation (PR/AUC‑ROC, F‑beta, lift charts) and handling class imbalance along with the underlying statistical concepts (calibration theory, hypothesis testing).
* Large‑scale data processing – Proficient in Pandas, Dask, Polars (or equivalent) for transactional‑scale datasets; feature engineering, distributed pipelines, and performance‑aware data handling.
* MLOps & lifecycle management – MLflow (experiment tracking, model registry, stage promotion), BentoML (runners, adaptive batching, CPU/GPU pools), GitOps/Argo CD for A/B‑testing and champion‑challenger workflows; CI/CD pipelines with Git/Bitbucket.
* Python microservices & containerization – Designing and deploying APIs with FastAPI, Flask, or Django; async I/O, Celery task queues, Docker packaging, and Kubernetes orchestration for scalable inference services.
* Data storage & query optimization – Strong command of SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph stores (Cassandra, MongoDB, Neo4j, JanusGraph); schema design, indexing, and performance tuning.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ); cross‑team and multi‑geography collaboration, rapid technology adoption, mentorship, and end‑to‑end ownership of solutions.
* Strong collaboration and learning mindset, with the ability to work across teams and geographies, adapt to new technologies, mentor others, and take end-to-end ownership.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with W&B alongside MLflow.
* Evidently AI or similar drift/monitoring platforms
* DVC or LakeFS for dataset versioning
* TorchServe / Triton / KServe (alternative serving paths)
* Exposure to large scale data or streaming platforms such as Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks in high volume processing contexts.

**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 7 years
  
  
**Job Title**
AIML\_Engineer
  
  
**Date**
18/05/2026
  
  
**Department**
CEP IT
  
  
Location:
  
  
Mumbai
  
  
Business Line
  
  
Anti Money Laundering
  
  
**Reports To**
AML IT Manager
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (SharePoint)
description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint)**
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation.
  
  
**SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering**

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment.
* Maintain tenant-level SharePoint configurations and administrative controls.
* Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health.
* Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management.
* Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment.
* Plan, test, and implement SharePoint platform changes in a controlled and supportable manner.
* Identify and remediate stale, abandoned, redundant, orphaned, or improperly configured SharePoint sites.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Reduce manual SharePoint administration through repeatable engineering and automation.

**SharePoint Migration Engineering;**

* Plan and execute enterprise SharePoint Online migrations.
* Support SharePoint migrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tenant consolidations, and organizational transformation.
* Perform technical discovery and assessment of source SharePoint environments.
* Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations.
* Determine migration readiness and identify technical risks, remediation requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop migration strategies, technical migration plans, sequencing, migration waves, validation procedures, and rollback approaches.
* Configure and operate enterprise SharePoint migration technologies.
* Develop scripts and automation to improve migration discovery, preparation, execution, validation, and reporting.
* Troubleshoot complex migration failures and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Perform pre- and post-migration validation of content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality.
* Identify obsolete, redundant, unsupported, or unnecessary content and determine appropriate remediation rather than automatically carrying technical debt into the destination environment.
* Develop repeatable migration processes and standards that can be reused for future migration initiatives.
* Transition migrated environments into established SharePoint governance and lifecycle-management processes.

**SharePoint Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Establish and maintain enterprise SharePoint governance standards.
* Define and maintain standards for site provisioning, ownership, permissions, external sharing, and lifecycle.
* Establish processes for identifying and managing inactive, abandoned, and orphaned sites.
* Support site expiration, archival, retention, and decommissioning processes.
* Maintain appropriate controls for external and guest sharing.
* Partner with Information Security on SharePoint security and data-protection requirements.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management on SharePoint authentication, access, guest identity, and related access-management requirements.
* Improve visibility into SharePoint ownership, usage, storage, health, and lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to reduce SharePoint technical debt and platform sprawl.

**Advanced SharePoint Troubleshooting**

* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex SharePoint Online issues.
* Troubleshoot complex permissions, authentication, access, sharing, configuration, content, and migration problems.
* Investigate issues that cannot be effectively resolved through established frontline or second-level support processes.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents that indicate broader platform or governance problems.
* Engage Microsoft and SharePoint technology vendors when vendor-level escalation is required.
* Document solutions and transfer repeatable troubleshooting knowledge to appropriate support teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise SharePoint environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with SharePoint Online in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with enterprise SharePoint administration, configuration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale SharePoint migrations.
* Experience with SharePoint Online tenant-to-tenant migrations or similar complex enterprise migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint architecture, sites, permissions, sharing, metadata, storage, and content structures.
* Experience performing technical discovery and migration-readiness assessments.
* Experience identifying migration dependencies, risks, technical debt, and remediation requirements.
* Experience validating content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality following migrations.
* Strong PowerShell and PnP PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph, APIs, or other automation technologies for SharePoint administration.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint security, permissions, guest access, and external sharing.
* Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint Online platform and migration issues.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, retention, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently drive complex technical work across multiple technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise SharePoint migration platforms such as ShareGate or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or tenant consolidations involving SharePoint.
* Experience migrating SharePoint Server or other legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to SharePoint, including retention, information protection, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, guest access, and external identity capabilities as they relate to SharePoint.
* Experience with SharePoint site lifecycle automation and enterprise governance tooling.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph and API-based SharePoint automation.
* Relevant Microsoft 365 or SharePoint certifications.
* Experience working within a global enterprise and with managed service providers.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

description:
AudioCodes is currently looking for a Solution Architect to develop productive partner relationships and turn joint account plans into sustainable commercial growth.
  
  
The role combines practical expertise in channel sales and partner account management with close collaboration across regional Sales, presales specialists, Marketing and the partner ecosystem.
  
  
About Us:
  
  
We are AudioCodes, (NASDAQ: AUDC) a global leader in voice communications, voice AI, Unified Communications, Contact Center, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. For over 30 years, we have helped enterprises and service providers worldwide modernize their communications environments and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences.
  
  
As a trusted Microsoft partner and a leader in Voice AI and Conversational AI, AudioCodes enables organizations to accelerate digital transformation through innovative solutions that integrate seamlessly with Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and other leading collaboration platforms.
  
  
With a global presence, thousands of customers worldwide, and a strong ecosystem of partners, AudioCodes is recognized as a market leader in enterprise communications and AI-driven voice solutions.
  
  
Your mission:
  
  
As our
**Solution Architect**
, you will develop productive partner relationships and turn joint account plans into sustainable commercial growth, taking responsibility for the work and decisions that make this possible.
  
  
Your day-to-day work will combine partner account planning, opportunity reviews, enablement sessions and direct conversations about customer needs, with a clear link between each activity and the outcome it is intended to achieve.
  
  
You will own the journey from partner recruitment and onboarding through joint opportunity development, execution and ongoing account growth, making sure important details and commitments carry through each stage.
  
  
Working closely with regional Sales, presales specialists, Marketing and the partner ecosystem, you will clarify expectations, coordinate dependencies and bring the right expertise into decisions at the right time.
  
  
You will use your professional judgment to investigate challenges, evaluate practical options and explain the implications of your recommendations to the people involved.
  
  
You will keep priorities, progress and risks visible, maintaining useful documentation and agreeing concrete next steps when circumstances or requirements change.
  
  
The role requires direct involvement in execution, curiosity about the underlying problems and a willingness to improve working practices using feedback and observed results.
  
  
Your contribution will be reflected in the quality of partner engagement, joint pipeline progression and the business delivered through those relationships, as well as the trust and effective working relationships you build across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop partner account plans with clear priorities, joint activities and measurable commercial outcomes.
* Identify and qualify new channel partners and build a productive onboarding and enablement plan.
* Work with partners to identify customer opportunities, map stakeholders and agree actionable next steps.
* Coordinate with presales and Marketing to deliver relevant enablement, campaigns and customer engagements.
* Manage commercial discussions and help partners progress opportunities through to a clear buying decision.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, account plans and opportunity forecasts, escalating risks early.

Requirements:
  
  
**Professional Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales solution architecture, channel sales, and partner account management — Mandatory
* A record of both conducting POC's, Demo's, RFP's and developing channel partners and growing commercially productive accounts — Mandatory
* ﻿Proven experience selling to the BFSI (Banking, Financial Services & Insurance) vertical, with direct exposure to enterprise customers in this sector - Mandatory
* Ability to build joint business plans and translate them into qualified customer opportunities — Mandatory
* Experience navigating enterprise buying processes and working with multiple decision makers — Mandatory
* Practical commercial negotiation, account planning and opportunity management skills — Mandatory
* Practical experience with UCaaS, Voice AI, Microsoft Teams, Genesys, Avaya, Zoom, AWS, Azure and the ability to apply this knowledge to the role's core activities — Mandatory

**Soft Skills**

* Strong written and spoken English, active listening and clear communication with different stakeholders — Mandatory
* Independent ownership, sound prioritization and effective collaboration across teams — Mandatory

**Advantages**

* Experience developing a new partner territory or building a channel program from an early stage — Advantage
* Experience coordinating joint marketing campaigns and measuring their contribution to pipeline — Advantage
* Experience expanding an existing account into additional products, use cases, or business units — Advantage

title: Want to Build the Technology that could Reinvent 3PL & E-COMMERCE / Q-COMMERCE Supply Chains?
description:
**Senior Software Engineering:**

**E-Commerce Marketplaces & AI Supply chain & Logistics Tech Product Build**

**Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd. - www.goldfishh.com**

We’re looking for a senior technology builder who doesn’t just want to maintain software — but wants to
**architect and build technology products from the ground up.**

Goldfishh operates at the intersection of
**Supply Chain, Warehousing, 3PL, E-Commerce and Marketplace Commerce**
. As we scale our physical and digital ecosystem, we are embarking on an ambitious technology journey to build
**AI-powered platforms that can fundamentally change how businesses manage warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace commerce.**

We are looking for an experienced
**Software Engineering / Product Technology leader**
who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.

**What You Will Build**

You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:

•
**N2N / Multi-Sided Digital Marketplaces**
connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply-chain capacity.

•
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Technology**
integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.

•
**Warehousing & 3PL Technology**
for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply-chain orchestration.

•
**AI-Native Products & Agents**
using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.

•
**Data & Decision Intelligence**
capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.

•
**APIs & Integrations**
connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.

The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.

**We want to rethink them.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

You should ideally have:

•
**10–15+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.**

• BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
**premier engineering institution**
.

• Strong hands-on experience architecting and building
**scalable technology products**
, preferably within technology startups or high-growth product companies.

• Proven experience with
**N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e-commerce platforms or multi-sided digital ecosystems**
.

• Strong understanding of modern
**cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems**
.

• Practical experience designing or building products using
**Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI-driven automation**
.

• Ability to think simultaneously as a
**Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator**
.

• Experience taking products from
**concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale**
.

Most importantly, you should still enjoy
**building**
.

We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.

**Technology Stack & AI-Native Architecture**

We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
**cloud-native, API-first, modular and AI-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future**

. The preferred technology ecosystem will include
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js**

, modern web frameworks such as
**React/Next.js**

,
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases**

, containerised microservices using
**Docker/Kubernetes**

, and scalable cloud infrastructure on
**AWS/Azure/GCP**

. The AI layer will leverage
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration frameworks**

, with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event-driven workflows**

. We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply-chain and commerce workflows.**

**Why Goldfishh?**

Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:

**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.**
Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
**Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.**

Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
**disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply-chain and commerce ecosystem.**

**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.**
We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:

**“I helped architect and build that from Day One.”**

**This role could be right for you if…**

You have spent years building technology products, but your next chapter is not about joining another large engineering organisation.

You want
**ownership, experimentation, speed and the opportunity to create something genuinely new.**

If that sounds interesting, we would like to talk.

**Experience:**
10–15+ years

**Domain:**
SaaS | Marketplaces | E-Commerce | Supply Chain | AI

**Education:**
BE / BTech or equivalent, preferably from a premier engineering institution

**Company:**
Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Website:**
www.goldfishh.com

title: SAP BTP Architect-Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**SAP BTP Architect**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**SAP BTP Architect**
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a SAP BTP Architect with 10 to 15 years of relevant experience to join our dynamic team. This role designing and governing scalable, secure, and cloud‑native solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). The role focuses on application architecture using CAPM and/or RAP, side‑by‑side extensibility, and embedding SAP Business AI capabilities while ensuring Clean Core compliance across SAP landscapes.
  
  

* Define end‑to‑end solution architecture on SAP BTP
* Design application extensions using:

+ CAPM (Node.js/Java) and/or
+ RAP (ABAP Cloud, CDS, OData V4)

* Define extensibility strategy aligned with Clean Core principles
* Architect cloud‑native, multi‑tenant, and scalable applications
* Integrate applications with S/4HANA (Public & Private Cloud) and non‑SAP systems
* Design and embed SAP Business AI scenarios, including:

+ SAP AI Business Services (e.g., Document Information Extraction, DAR)
+ Generative AI via AI Core / Generative AI Hub

* Ensure enterprise‑grade security, governance, and compliance
* Review designs, perform architectural governance, and guide delivery teams
* Drive POCs, innovation initiatives, and reuse frameworks
* Mentor developers, leads, and managers on BTP architecture and best practices
* Support pre‑sales, estimations, and technical solutioning where required

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in SAP BTP architecture e.g. Event driven, Micro service based

**Hands‑on experience with:**

* BTP Accounts & cloud principles
* CAPM (CDS, services, events, multitenancy)
* RAP / Advance ABAP for cloud, Design Patterns & OOPS
* Runtime environment ( Cloud foundry, kyma and ABAP )
* OData V4
* SAP Fiori Elements / UI5

**Deep understanding of:**

* Clean Core & Side‑by‑Side extensibility
* S/4HANA Cloud extensibility models

**Experience with SAP Business AI, including:**

* AI Business Services
* AI Core & AI Launchpad
* Generative AI integration patterns
* Strong stakeholder, leadership, and communication skills

**Preferred Skills:**

* SAP Integration Suite, Event Mesh, Build Process Automation
* DevOps, CI/CD, and Transport Management on BTP

**SAP Certifications:**

* SAP BTP
* CAPM / ABAP Cloud / RAP
* SAP Business AI

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Head of Technology
description:
**Company Description**

Waya is a SEBI-registered investment advisory platform that uses AI-driven predictive models to help Indian investors make better market decisions. Founded in 2023, we are bootstrapped, profitable and serve 1 lakh+ paying users, acquired and served fully digitally.

•
**Products:**

Waya Equity (short-term and multibagger ideas), Waya FnO (index and stock options,

intraday, BTST), Waya MCX (gold, silver, crude and other commodities) and Waya PMS, a small -

cap portfolio management service for HNI’s.

•
**Registrations:**

SEBI Research Analyst (INH000010876) and Portfolio Manager (INP000008987).

•
**Platforms:**

Web at

thewaya.com

and the Waya mobile apps on Android and iOS.

**Role Description**

The Head of Technology owns everything Waya builds and runs: the apps, the website, the backend, the data and the AI. You will set the technical direction, lead every engineering team, and stay hands-on enough to review architecture and code.Your mandate is to turn a profitable, fast-growing advisory business into a technology platform that scales to millions of investors. That means reliable systems during market hours, an AI-first engineering culture, and shipping WayaX into production.

**Key responsibilities**

**Technology strategy and architecture**

• Own the technology roadmap with the founder, tied to revenue, user growth and product

launches.

• Define the target architecture across apps, web, backend services, data pipelines and AI

systems.

• Make build-vs-buy calls on market data vendors, broker and exchange APIs, cloud and AI model

providers.

• Own the technology budget, including cloud, data feeds and LLM spend.

**App and frontend**

• Lead the Flutter team building Waya's Android, iOS and web apps.

• Set standards for Clean Architecture/MVVM, state management (Bloc, Riverpod, Provider) and

Figma-based design systems.

• Drive a fast, smooth experience for live market updates, alerts and push notifications.

• Own App Store and Google Play releases, ratings and crash-free rates.

**Backend and platform**

• Lead the backend team working in PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter) and the services behind

subscriptions, CMS, advisory delivery and analytics.

• Plan the move from today's stack to a scalable, service-oriented platform where it pays off.

• Own integrations with payment gateways (UPI, BillDesk), Firebase, messaging channels and

third-party APIs.

• Keep systems up and fast during market hours, with clear SLAs, monitoring and on-call.

**AI engineering and WayaX**

• Lead the AI team building WayaX and the LLM features inside Waya's advisory products.

• Guide the design of multi-agent workflows, router agents, tool and function calling, MCP servers

and RAG pipelines.

• Set up evaluations, guardrails and observability so AI answers stay accurate, compliant and

consistent.

• Manage model choice, cost and latency across Claude, GPT and open-source LLMs.

**Data mining and analytics**

• Lead the data team that collects, cleans and stores market data: prices, F&O chains,

fundamentals, filings, corporate actions and commodities.

• Build the pipelines and data warehouse that feed Waya's predictive models, research and

WayaX.• Work with research analysts to turn their models and rules into production-grade data products.

• Own product analytics: funnels, retention, conversion and user behaviour.

**Security, compliance and reliability**

• Protect client data, payments and credentials with strong security practices and regular audits.

• Make sure systems meet SEBI requirements for Research Analysts and PMS, including record

keeping, disclosures, audit trails and cybersecurity norms.

• Run DevOps and CI/CD: Git-based pipelines, automated testing, cloud infrastructure, backups

and disaster recovery.

**AI-first engineering culture**

• Make AI-assisted development the default: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor and GitHub

Copilot across every team.

• Set the rules for reviewing, testing and maintaining AI-generated code, so speed never costs

quality or security.

• Coach engineers in workflow design with AI: breaking down problems, sequencing prompts, and

knowing when to push back on output.

**People leadership**

• Hire, lead and grow a team of backend, frontend, AI and data engineers.

• Set goals, run reviews, and build a culture of ownership and fast, careful shipping.

• Run sprint planning and delivery with product, research, marketing and customer support

teams.

**What we are looking for**

•
**Experience:**

12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years leading teams that span mobile,

backend and data or AI.

•
**Consumer scale:**

You have built and run consumer products used by lakhs of users, ideally in

fintech, broking, trading, wealth or payments.

•
**Architecture:**

Deep grasp of distributed systems, APIs, databases (SQL and NoSQL), caching,

queues and real-time data delivery.

•
**Mobile and web:**

Strong working knowledge of Flutter/Dart or comparable cross-platform

stacks, and of modern web frontends.

•
**Backend:**

Hands-on background in at least one of PHP (Laravel), Python, Node.js, Go or Java, and

comfort leading teams in the others.

•
**AI and LLMs:**

Practical experience shipping LLM features: agents, function calling, RAG, vector

databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant or similar), evaluations and guardrails.

•
**Data:**

Experience building data pipelines and warehouses, ideally on market or transaction data.

•
**AI-assisted engineering:**

You use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and know how

to steer, review and test what they produce.

•
**Cloud and DevOps:**

AWS, GCP or Azure; CI/CD; monitoring; security best practices.

•
**Leadership:**

A record of hiring strong engineers, raising delivery speed and keeping quality high.

•
**Education:**

B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.

title: Software Architect
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Mumbai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Role Summary**

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
Join a team that's helping some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. You'll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
You'll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Director, Application Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
Aladdin Accounting is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Aladdin and represents a significant strategic investment for BlackRock. The team builds and operates the technology platforms that power accurate, scalable, and efficient accounting across global operations. Our engineers develop business-critical application, data, reporting, and workflow systems while driving modernization through distributed architectures, advanced data platforms, and engineering innovation. Working closely with Product, Operations, Data, and Engineering partners, the team delivers capabilities that support BlackRock and the broader Aladdin client ecosystem.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As an Engineering Director, Application Engineering, you will serve as a senior technology leader responsible for shaping architecture, engineering strategy, and delivery across enterprise-scale platforms supporting global post-trade operations. You will connect long-term technology vision with pragmatic execution, influence critical technical decisions, and help develop the next generation of engineering leaders. This role combines deep technical expertise with organizational leadership, enabling you to drive modernization, improve platform resiliency, and deliver meaningful business outcomes at scale.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader Aladdin strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps, leading modernization initiatives and balancing technical debt reduction with delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a minimum of 12 years of demonstrated leadership experience across enterprise-scale software engineering environments.
* Deep expertise in modern application architecture, distributed systems, microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), event-driven architectures, and enterprise software design.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise application development and data architecture, including large-scale processing, data modeling, performance optimization, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience designing and operating large-scale application and data platforms using modern messaging, caching, and distributed processing approaches.
* Demonstrated success defining technology strategy, leading complex multi-team initiatives, and balancing modernization investments with delivery objectives.
* Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, risk management, reliability, security, and operational excellence capabilities within business-critical environments.
* Exposure to artificial intelligence (AI), large language model (LLM) concepts, cloud-native platforms, observability technologies, automation frameworks, and regulated financial-services environments.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

SAP Certified Development Associate ABAP with SAP NetWeaver preferred along with SAP MDG related certifications where available.
