title: Engineering Manager - Data & Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.
  
  
As Bluehost scales, reliability and good data both depend on strong platform engineering. You'll lead the team that keeps our infrastructure resilient and our data trustworthy — from cloud architecture and containerized hosting to backup/disaster recovery, observability, and the pipelines that turn raw data into insight for product and growth teams across a fast-growing SMB SaaS platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark**
This is a player-coach role: you'll manage a small team while staying hands-on as a software engineer yourself.
  
  
As a manager
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of ~4 engineers spanning data engineering, devops, cloud infrastructure, hosting solutions, and observability — hiring, mentoring, and owning performance and career development.
* Set technical direction and priorities across the team's full portfolio: data pipelines, public cloud configuration, containerized hosting, backup/disaster recovery, observability, and internal automation.
* Partner directly with product, analytics, security, and engineering leadership to translate ambiguous business needs into infrastructure and data roadmaps.
* Drive on-call and incident-response practices so pipeline, cloud, and hosting issues are caught before they hit customers or a dashboard.
* Report on team health, system reliability, and roadmap progress to leadership.

As an engineer
  
  

* Personally design, build, and maintain production systems across the team's domains — pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containerized services, and automation — not just review others' work.
* Write and review code for data pipelines, devops tooling, cloud configuration (infrastructure-as-code), observability instrumentation, and backup/recovery solutions.
* Own or co-own the most complex or cross-cutting technical problems — architecture decisions, major incidents, and backup/DR strategy and testing.
* Use AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up your own development and debugging, and help the team adopt them effectively.
* Write tested, version-controlled code and contribute to CI/CD practices that catch regressions — data-quality, infrastructure, or otherwise — before they ship.
* Document architecture, data models, lineage, and operational runbooks so other teams can self-serve with confidence.

**Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed**

* 4-6 years of hands-on engineering experience across data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, or devops, including some experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, or formally managing a team.
* Real experience building and operating production systems — not just one-off scripts — across at least two of: data pipelines, devops, cloud infrastructure, containerized hosting, observability, or backup/DR.
* Solid experience with relational databases and dimensional data-warehousing concepts, and strong SQL skills.
* Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Oracle Cloud) — configuration, cost management, and security fundamentals.
* Experience with containerized hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar).
* Experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, or similar) and backup/disaster-recovery practices.
* Working proficiency in Python (preferred) or another language commonly used for data or platform engineering.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted tools (Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development, debugging, and validation.
* Strong communicator, able to translate ambiguous business needs into technical plans for both your team and stakeholders.

Bonus
  
  

* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse), orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect), or event-streaming tools (Kafka).
* Prior experience formally managing an engineering team.

**Why You'll Love Us**

* We’ve evolved. we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.

Software Development

* Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core and C#.

* Exposure to NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Exposure to Docker and containerized application deployment.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and tools.
* Exposure to application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis tools.
* Experience with microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of secure application development and OWASP principles.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in one of the following fields, or equivalent practical experience:
  
  

* Computer Science

* Information Technology

title: Senior Solution Architect, Mumbai
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?
  
  
As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and tackle our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be passionate about perfection; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.
  
  
“We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Serving as the technical point of contact for your accounts and account managers in your assigned territory.
* Developing a deep understanding of customers’ goals and objectives, and articulating how our offerings address their needs.
* Crafting and owning value based relationships at all levels in customer organizations.
* Actively participating in all phases of planning and execution for your territory, from initial discovery to the technical win.
* Developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the Elastic products and solutions to demonstrate the value of our offerings in sales meetings, and at events such as meetups and conferences.
* Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions and services.
* Onboarding, educating and enabling our partners, and supporting them in sales cycles.
* Crafting collateral, contributing to programs and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet individual client needs.
* Being the voice of the customer and community to communicate needs, gaps, and improvements to our engineering and leadership teams.
* Deepening both your sales and technical skills through self driven education while taking advantage of all the professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.

**What You Bring:**

* A track record of success in a technical presales role—enough experience selling and implementing technology to earn your customer’s trust.
* A proven track record to articulate and sell the benefits of modern platforms, software and technologies.

**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**

  

**Insight on your impact**

  

We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

  

As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  

  

**Your qualifications, your influence**

  

*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills*

  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning & Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion**

**and Belonging**

  

Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

  

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

  

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

  

Anaplan does not:

  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  

  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Job Description / Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 The Technical Lead C\+\+ Development (Senior Manager) will act as the core technical authority and delivery anchor for our ultra\-low\-latency engineering pod. This role balances hands\-on, high\-performance C\+\+ systems programming (roughly 60%\-70% of the time) with technical mentorship and agile sprint management (30–40%). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high\-level architectural designs and concrete, microsecond\-optimized code implementation.
 



 Core Role Information
 


* Designation: Technical Lead (Senior Manager) – C\+\+ Development
* Department: Technology
* Reporting To: Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Development Head



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Hands\-on Low\-Latency Systems Engineering** 



* Write, optimize, and maintain high\-performance execution engines and market data applications using Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20\).
* Implement deterministic, low\-latency programming paradigms, strictly avoiding runtime heap allocations (malloc/new) on the trading hot\-path through custom memory pools and placement new.
* Develop ultra\-fast Inter\-Process Communication (IPC) frameworks—such as shared memory rings and lock\-free circular queues—to pass data across trading components with sub\-microsecond overhead.
* Design highly concurrent, multi\-threaded workflows, configuring thread affinity (pthread\_setaffinity\_np) and optimizing data layouts to prevent CPU cache thrashing and lock contention.
* Incorporate proprietary template\-based architectures or High\-Level Template (HTL) constructs to shift computational logic to compile\-time.



**2\. Core Data Engineering \& Domain Integration** 



* Apply expert\-level knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms to engineer optimal custom indexing, sorting, and binary parsing solutions.
* Design and maintain high\-throughput relational tracking databases using MySQL for order logs, risk configurations, and reference data management.
* Leverage trading domain knowledge to translate complex financial logic (such as order routing, compliance checks, risk management parameters, or exchange protocols like FIX, ITCH, or SBE) into concrete technical implementations.



**3\. Technical Leadership \& Code Governance** 



* Lead daily sprint cycles, translate functional specifications into technical tasks, and ensure timely product delivery.
* Enforce absolute code quality via strict peer code reviews, continuous profiling (using tools like Valgrind, gprof, or Perf), and performance regression benchmarking.
* Provide daily technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, establishing standardized coding guidelines for the team.



  





**Job Specific Skills** 



* C\+\+ \& Metaprogramming Expertise: Exceptional mastery of systems\-level C\+\+, including template metaprogramming, RAII, smart pointers, and strict memory safety.
* Concurrency Mastery: Practical experience writing production\-grade, lock\-free, atomic, and multi\-threaded processing pipelines.
* Low\-Latency Infrastructure: Clear understanding of CPU architectures (cache line synchronization, branch predictors) and Linux OS tuning (core isolation, kernel bypass).
* Data Layout \& DB Optimization: Advanced ability to optimize algorithms for hardware cache locality and structure complex database queries, indexes, and schemas in MySQL.
* HTL Frameworks: Experience using template libraries or customized HTL concepts to achieve zero\-overhead abstractions.



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative stream.
* Experience: 8\+ years of professional software development experience in systems programming, with at least 3\+ years of experience leading small\-to\-mid\-sized developer teams or pods.
* Domain Advantage: Prior background in High\-Frequency Trading (HFT), investment bank execution desks, derivatives risk systems, or market data feeds is highly desirable.



  





 For more details, contact Archana at Archana.tiwari@tnmhr.com / \+91 9821821884\.

**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.


 Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

description:
Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country

**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

**Title: Solution Architect – Global Finance S2P Lead**
**Brief introduction \- Role Summary/Purpose :**
* The successful candidate will serve as the global process authority for the end\-to\-end Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) ecosystem, spearheading enterprise strategy, portfolio governance, and solution architecture. Operating at a Grade 14\-15 level, this position is responsible for all Key S2P project management, critical capital budget allocations, and strategic cross\-functional resource tracking via the GRID framework. The role acts as a primary liaison to executive business stakeholders and commands the end\-to\-end global vendor management lifecycle, including competitive selection, SOW documentation, and commercial negotiations. Ultimately, you will ensure robust system performance, continuous process automation, and risk mitigation across all operating geographies to prevent business interruption.


**Responsibilities :**
* Global Architecture \& Governance: Lead the end\-to\-end global S2P process strategy, defining integration paths across core General Ledger Accounting, SD, MM, Supply/Demand modules, Direct/Indirect Taxation, and specialized platforms like OpenText and Concur.
* Portfolio \& Resource Orchestration: Maintain global portfolio roadmaps by leading the execution of projects, conducting GRID project maintenance (demand tracking, status reporting, and capacity allocation), and presenting updates quarterly to global steering committees.
* Vendor \& Ecosystem Management: Command the strategic vendor lifecycle, including vendor selection, complex Statements of Work (SOW) structuring, contract negotiations, and external consultant deployment to drive maximum ROI.
* Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Engagement: Partner directly with global business leaders to evaluate incoming initiative requests, prioritize pipeline demands, and align cross\-functional teams to secure GRID approvals. Working with the GIT Director and Global Finance leadership to establish, align, and cascade departmental goals and objectives.
* System Reliability \& Continuous Improvement: Enforce strict global governance standards, project methodologies, and documentation while analyzing root causes of performance issues to maintain system reliability.
* Transformation \& Intelligent Automation: Spearhead high\-impact, transformative initiatives that combine technical architecture with business acumen, building automated use cases that realize quantifiable effort and cost savings.
* Conduct the Performance Management and Development processes for subordinates per standards within corporate and local regulatory policies and practices.
* Provide subordinate development opportunities, coaching, and technical mentorship to junior developers and architects to build deep domain competency.


**Required Qualifications :**
* Any Bachelor’s Degree (Commerce, Finance, or Accounting background strongly preferred), paired with advanced qualifications such as a Master's degree, CA, or ICWA/CMA.
* Minimum relevant experience of 15\+ years or more leading large\-scale SAP Finance and S2P architectural transformations in complex, global corporate environments.
* Exhaustive, in\-depth functional process knowledge across Accounts Payable, General Accounting, Accounts Receivable, and SAP Banking systems.


**Preferred Qualifications :**
* Advanced Systems \& Tooling: Hands\-on architectural and implementation experience within a native SAP S/4HANA environment.
* Specialized Platform Integration: Proven technical exposure to OpenText, Core Capture, Ariba, TrustMi portal, Archive Server, Swift Payment, FSCM, Concur, AO reporting, or any Analytic tools.
* Domain Expertise: Deep domain experience operating within a global manufacturing or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) organization.
* Strategy \& Executive Presence: Strong leadership skills with the ability to confidently present technical compliance risks, financial architectures, and long\-term roadmaps to C\-suite/VP leadership.


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
 Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Applied Solutions Architect, Google Cloud

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.

**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in data management, MDM, data architecture
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Master Data Management experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with Profisee MDM is mandatory
* Prior experience reviewing, troubleshooting, stabilising or optimizing an existing Profisee implementation is highly desirable



  





**Required Technical Experience** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Hands\-on Profisee implementation experience
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Profisee
* Strong understanding of Profisee architecture and implementation patterns
* Experience with Profisee data models, matching, merging, survivorship and workflows
* Experience analysing Profisee integrations and downstream data flows
* Strong understanding of MDM data quality and governance
* Experience working with complex enterprise integration landscapes



**Desirable:** 



* Azure / Microsoft Fabric / Microsoft Purview experience
* Experience with APIs and integration platforms
* Experience with ERP/CRM environments such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle or similar
* Experience with data stewardship and operating\-model design
* Experience conducting MDM health checks, architecture reviews or implementation assessments



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 The successful candidate will:
 



**1\. Current\-State Assessment** 



* Review the existing Profisee implementation, architecture and configuration
* Understand the current MDM operating model, business processes and ownership
* Document key challenges, impacted business processes and manual workarounds
* Review how master data is created, changed, approved, mastered and distributed
* Assess the current roles and responsibilities across business, data stewardship, technology and support teams



**2\. Profisee Implementation Review** 



* Assess whether the Profisee implementation is appropriately designed for the organisation's business requirements
* Identify areas of unnecessary complexity, over\-engineering or configuration that may be contributing to operational issues
* Review Profisee data models, entities, attributes, relationships and hierarchies
* Review matching, merging and survivorship configuration
* Review workflows, stewardship processes, validation rules and business rules
* Assess whether configuration follows Profisee implementation best practices
* Identify configuration/design issues that may impact data quality or downstream processing



**3\. Integration \& Data Flow Review** 



* Review the end\-to\-end integration architecture surrounding Profisee
* Trace critical data flows from source systems through Profisee to downstream applications
* Investigate issues associated with incorrect or unexpected data updates reaching downstream systems
* Assess interfaces, APIs, integration services, event/batch mechanisms and transformation logic
* Identify potential issues around data ownership, change propagation, sequencing, dependencies and error handling
* Assess monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling and support processes
* Recommend improvements to integration patterns and controls



**4\. Data Migration \& Data Quality Assessment** 



* Assess the approach used to migrate data into Profisee
* Evaluate the organisation's confidence in migrated master data
* Identify gaps in reconciliation, validation and data\-quality controls
* Review DQ rules, thresholds and validation logic
* Assess whether current DQ controls are overly restrictive or generating unnecessary operational effort
* Recommend a pragmatic approach to balancing data quality, business usability and operational efficiency

title: Staff Data Architect
description:
****This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in\-office****
 Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, ideas\-led environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
 As a Staff Data Architect for Customer Growth, you will be the technical beacon and architectural anchor for the data ecosystems that drive our customer acquisition, retention, and engagement strategies. This is a high\-impact, leadership\-by\-influence role where you will not just write code, but design the future\-proof frameworks that empower multiple engineering squads.
   

  

 You will evaluate complex technical trade\-offs, champion engineering excellence, and foster a culture of innovation. Operating across the entire Customer Growth portfolio, you will collaborate closely with product management, data science, and business leaders to turn massive datasets into strategic growth levers.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Get To**
* Architecture \& Framework Design: Design, build, and evolve robust, scalable, and highly reliable data architectures and framework\-level designs that support real\-time personalization, marketing automation, and advanced customer analytics.
* Technical Decision Making \& Trade\-off Analysis: Act as the ultimate sounding board for complex data challenges. Evaluate competing technologies and methodologies (e.g., batch vs. streaming, self\-hosted vs. managed services, various data lakehouse architectures) and present objective, clear trade\-off analyses to stakeholders.
* Best Practices \& Governance: Define, document, and evangelize global engineering best practices, data governance frameworks, security standards, and CI/CD automation patterns across the portfolio.
* Cross\-Portfolio Collaboration: Break down silos. Work seamlessly with cross\-functional teams within the Customer Growth domain to ensure data infrastructure aligns perfectly with product roadmaps and business goals.
* Innovation \& R\&D: Stay ahead of the curve. Continually research, prototype, and introduce emerging technologies and innovative paradigms (such as Data Mesh, advanced identity resolution, or real\-time feature stores) to keep our growth engine competitive.
* Mentorship \& Technical Guidance: Act as a force multiplier. Guide, unblock, and elevate senior and mid\-level engineers by conducting rigorous code/architecture reviews and hosting knowledge\-sharing sessions.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience designing and implementing distributed data processing systems utilizing tools like Apache Spark, Flink, Kafka, or Delta Lake/Iceberg.
* Deep expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud\-native data warehousing solutions like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Proven track record of building reusable data libraries, custom tooling, or internal platforms that accelerated development for other engineering teams.
* Expert\-level knowledge of data modeling paradigms (Data Vault, Kimball, Star Schema) tailored for complex customer journeys and behavioral data.
* Highly proficient in Python, Scala, or Java, alongside expert\-level SQL.
* A natural curiosity to challenge the status quo and a history of successfully introducing innovative data solutions to business problems.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical business partners, and a proven ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to look at multiple viable technical paths, weigh the immediate business needs against long\-term technical debt, and confidently steer the team toward the optimal choice.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential


**Who We Are**

 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding \- we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
   

  

 Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown\-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
   

  

 We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
   

  

 Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
   

  

 If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

 Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

**A people\-first culture**

title: Process Engineer - AI Automation & Business Process Management
description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA** 




  





 Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
 



 AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
 



  





 CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognized for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
 



  





 AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
 



  





**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)** 




  





 At AMINA India, we are looking for an experienced professional to lead end‑to‑end process discovery, redesign, and AI\-driven automation across critical business functions, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and measurable impact. The role also champions compliant, well\-governed solutions while driving adoption through close collaboration with stakeholders, delivering sustainable, high\-value transformation.
 



  





**Your AMINA To\-Do List** 




  





**Discover, map and redesign processes** 



* Run process\-discovery workshops with teams across compliance, onboarding, operations, treasury, and client services.
* Produce clear, accurate process maps (BPMN or equivalent) and document the inputs, decisions, controls, and hand\-offs in each workflow.
* Redesign and optimize the process at hand, preparing it for potential automation / AI integration
* Identify automation candidates and quantify the opportunity — FTE saved, cycle\-time reduction, error\-rate impact, and cost.



**Design and build AI\-driven automation** 



* Translate process pain points into automation solutions using LLM\-based workflows, integration platforms, and APIs.
* Build, test, and iterate on automations — from document extraction and drafting assistants to alert triage, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Engineer reliable prompts and pipelines, design the human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and evaluate AI output quality with real test sets rather than vibes.
* Track token usage, run\-cost, and ROI per initiative, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy and model\-selection decisions.



**Keep it compliant and governed** 



* Design every automation so the accountable human still owns the decision — especially in regulated processes (KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, reporting).
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and IT to ensure solutions meet control, audit, data\-protection, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation, change logs, and a clear inventory of what's automated, who owns it, and how it's monitored.



**Drive adoption** 



* Partner with business owners to pilot, refine, and roll out automations — and to get genuine buy\-in, not shelfware.
* Build internal momentum for AI adoption in a risk\-aware environment, navigating IT and security gatekeeping constructively.
* Train users, write SOPs, and hand over solutions in a maintainable state.



  





**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:** 




  




* 4–10 years of experience in Business Process Management, Process Improvement, Automation, or Operational Transformation.
* Proven experience analyzing, redesigning, and optimizing business processes using structured methodologies (e.g., BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma, Process Mining).
* Strong stakeholder management and requirements\-gathering skills across business and technical teams.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and workflow automation tools, including LLMs, APIs, and integration platforms (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier).
* Practical understanding of prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and implementation of appropriate controls and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages and data analysis.
* Experience within banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of financial\-services processes such as KYC, AML, onboarding, payments, reconciliation, or regulatory reporting.
* Knowledge of risk, controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance considerations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with a pragmatic, delivery\-focused approach and the ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.



 Preferred
 


* Experience with crypto, digital assets, or blockchain\-related processes.
* Familiarity with FINMA, MiCA, AML, or similar regulatory frameworks.
* Experience with RAG, AI assistants, agentic workflows, Process Mining, or RPA tools. German language skills are a plus.



  





**Why We’re Awesome** 




  





 We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank.
 **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!** 




  





 Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

*Lead how Sovos designs, operates, and scales AI across the business*
 Sovos is transforming how the world's businesses navigate an increasingly complex tax and regulatory landscape, while simultaneously reinventing how we build software. Within the Office of the CTO, the Sovos Platform organization is growing our AI Platform team \- responsible for LLMOps foundation, tooling, and architectural patterns that let every engineering team at Sovos build and ship with AI responsibly and effectively.
   

  

 We're looking for an AI Tech Lead to guide that foundation from the inside. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering, architecture, and enablement \- leading the technical decisions that shape our LLMOps practice, guiding the engineers who build it, and acting as the connective tissue between the AI Platform team and every other team at Sovos learning to build with these tools. This is a highly visible role with a direct line to how AI gets used across the company.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
***Guiding LLMOps Strategy and Team Execution***
* You'll provide the technical leadership that keeps our LLMOps practice coherent as it scales \- guiding the AI Platform team's day\-to\-day decisions and making sure the practice holds together as new models, tools, and use cases arrive.
* Guide and support the AI Platform team on LLMOps decisions: model selection, evaluation strategy, prompt and context management, observability, and cost governance
* Set technical direction for how Sovos deploys, monitors, and continuously improves LLM\-based and agentic systems in production
* Establish standards and guardrails for prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI usage across teams
* Own the health of our LLMOps tooling and observability stack, and make the build\-vs\-buy calls as the landscape evolves


***Shaping Design and Architecture Decisions***
* You'll bring architectural rigor to how AI capabilities get built into the Sovos Platform, ensuring new AI features are designed to scale and integrate cleanly with Core Platform, Sovos Identity, and our broader compliance infrastructure.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to design AI\-enabled features and agentic services, from prototype through production
* Review and advise on technical designs across teams building on the AI Platform, flagging risk and identifying reuse opportunities early
* Help define the architectural patterns and reference implementations (skills, MCP tools, agent frameworks) other teams build from
* Balance rapid experimentation with the long\-term architectural integrity of the platform


***Partnering with Teams Across Sovos***
* Platform capabilities only create value once teams can actually use them. You'll be the primary technical point of contact for teams learning to adopt our LLMOps and AI toolsets, translating platform capability into practical, everyday workflows.
* Act as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams adopting AI coding assistants, agentic frameworks, and platform APIs
* Run workshops, office hours, and hands\-on sessions that teach teams how to use platform\-level LLM Ops and AI tooling effectively
* Translate platform capabilities into clear guidance, playbooks, and Skills that make the right way the easy way
* Communicate AI Platform direction and adoption progress to engineering leadership, product stakeholders, and the broader organization


***Leading and Growing the Team***
* You'll provide day\-to\-day guidance and technical leadership to the engineers building the AI Platform, raising the bar on quality while keeping the team moving fast.
* Guide and mentor AI Platform engineers, providing technical direction, code and design review, and career development
* Foster a culture of rapid experimentation, rigorous evaluation, and continuous learning
* Remove blockers so the team can ship reliable AI capabilities quickly
* Partner with the Chief Architect on team structure, hiring, and roadmap prioritization


**What We Need From You**
* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on time building and operating LLM\-based or agentic AI systems in production
* Deep familiarity with LLMOps practice: evaluation frameworks, observability and monitoring, prompt engineering, cost and performance optimization
* Experience guiding or leading engineers, whether as a formal manager, tech lead, or through mentorship and technical authority
* Strong architectural instincts \- comfortable making and defending design decisions that other teams will build on
* Hands\-on experience with modern AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
* Technical depth across full\-stack development; familiarity with JavaScript/React and Java or .NET service\-oriented systems is a strong plus
* Excellent communication skills \- able to explain AI platform concepts clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of enabling other teams: through documentation, shared tooling, workshops, or hands\-on pairing


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience standing up or scaling an LLMOps practice from the ground up
* A genuine enthusiasm for teaching \- you'd rather show ten teams how to fish than build it for them once
* Comfort operating at the boundary of ambiguity, translating a fast\-moving AI landscape into concrete, adoptable guidance
* Experience balancing platform architecture rigor with the speed a hands\-on tech lead role demands


**What Sovos Offers You**
* Flexibility: 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with remote options for the rest.
* International exposure with a global organization.
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting\-Free Days.
* Mentoring programs and career development opportunities.
* Globally recognized training and development programs.
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage.
* A collaborative environment with modern tools and technologies.


**Our Recruitment Process**
* CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) \& EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
* Automated Video Interview
* Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or team
* Final Interview


**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance, and trust solutions, enabling businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with confidence. With more than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – Sovos processes over three billion transactions annually across 19,000 tax jurisdictions.
   

  

 Founded in 1979, Sovos operates across the Americas and Europe, backed by Hg and TA Associates. Learn more at sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK

* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model

* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.

 Key job responsibilities

title: Architect — Design Management
description:
Architect — Design Management \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  





 A developer's design manager is not a practice's project architect. Own the drawing from the yield test at land stage to the set issued to site, for a platform breaking ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January — and make sure the masterplan that wins the deal is the one that gets built.
 



  





 A note before you read on. Team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the platform's current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  





 REPORTS TO: Head of Projects, or the CEO — Development Business until that seat is filled · DIRECT REPORTS: none; the consultant teams on every project are commanded by this seat · ASSET CLASSES: Grade A warehouses, logistics parks and industrial parks, PEB and RCC
 



  






 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  






 THE PROJECTS TEAM
 




 Vantrock designs and builds in\-house. The projects function owns the asset from the first block plan to the day an occupier takes possession, and design management owns the drawing across all of it. The function is being built now, the seat does not exist in this form anywhere in the market, and the person who joins it will decide what it becomes.
 



  






 DESIGN OWNERSHIP, NOT COORDINATION
 




 In a practice, the drawing is the product. Here it is a means, and the product is a park that leases, clears its approvals and gets built for the number it was underwritten at.
 



 Land is our largest single cost and the masterplan is where it is either monetised or wasted. A point of ground coverage, a badly oriented dock face, a late fire NOC — each costs more than the entire design fee. This seat finds the yield, proves it is compliant, and makes sure it survives contact with site.
 



  






 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 The platform breaks ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January and has 10 million behind it, across four cities and more than one state's development\-control regime. Every masterplan drawn this year will be built and leased for the next ten, approvals sit on the critical path in every state, and nobody owns them end to end today. This is the first design seat, and it sets the standards the portfolio is built to.
 



  






 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 1\. The yield test at land stage — ground coverage, FSI, setbacks, truck circulation, dock\-face orientation and phasing on every opportunity, and the block plan and area statement the land recommendation is made on.
 



 2\. The portfolio design standards — 17 m bay grid, 12\.5 m clear height, 1:7,500 sq ft dock ratio, 28\.5 m yard depth, office area, FM2 and TR34 floors, defended against anything that erodes usable area.
 



 3\. The approval path — state industrial authority, town planning, fire NOC, environmental clearance, factory and DISH, CTE and CTO, on a live tracker with a real critical path.
 



 4\. The GFC set — coordinated, construction\-ready, issued in a state where the site does not have to ask what was meant. Site RFIs are the measure, and are counted.
 



 5\. The consultants — architectural, structural, MEP, façade and landscape, appointed, driven and held to what they hand over.
 



 6\. Buildability and change control — clash resolution before issue, then the RFI and design\-change log, with cost and time attached before a change reaches site.
 



 7\. Customer fit and design\-to\-cost — occupier briefs turned into fast, priced design responses, and design worked to the estimator's budget, not around it.
 



  






 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 





 ESSENTIAL
 




 – 10–15 years in design management, most of it on industrial, warehousing or logistics assets, at a developer, or at a practice or PMC on that portfolio at project\-lead level.
 



 – Parks you have masterplanned yourself, with the numbers: site area, BUA, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Tested in a practical.
 



 – The full statutory approval path run end to end in at least one state, and a working knowledge of how a second differs. NBC 2016, state fire and DCR in daily use.
 



 – Green certification to IGBC or LEED Platinum standard designed in from concept, not retrofitted at approval stage.
 



 – AutoCAD at expert level; fluent reading of structural and MEP drawings, specifications and contract conditions; SketchUp and Adobe for options, massing and presentation output.
 



 – Warehouse and industrial building systems: PEB and RCC, FM2 and TR34 flooring, dock equipment, K115 and K160 sprinklers, OSID and FAPA fire detection, roofing, cladding, external infrastructure.
 



 – Design\-to\-cost as a habit, not a phase: quantified options, value engineering without losing the specification.
 



 – B.Arch, with Council of Architecture registration. Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 




 ADVANTAGEOUS
 




 – M.Arch, NICMAR or an equivalent construction\-management qualification. IGBC AP or LEED AP.
 



 – Revit and BIM for model\-based coordination rather than drawings with a model on the side. Power BI for approval trackers, drawing registers and design\-change dashboards.
 



 – Temperature\-controlled, cross\-dock or automation\-ready fit\-outs. Approvals in more than one state.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 – Not a practice seat: the drawing is not the deliverable, a park that leases and gets built is. Not consultant coordination: you appoint, direct and hold the consultants. Not a delivery seat: execution on site belongs to projects. Not the programme office: cost and schedule control across the portfolio sits there.
 



  






 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 – Developer side, with real decision rights. You can reject a consultant's set, hold a land recommendation, and refuse a change that has not been priced.
 



 – Every decision traceable. A yield option has an area statement behind it; a released drawing has a name against it.
 



 – The reporting is not your job. Trackers, registers, RFI logs and dashboards run on Vantrock Intelligence, built before we bought an acre.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, travel to every site.
 



 JUDGED ON FOUR STANDARDS, TOGETHER. Yield: BUA per acre, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Compliance: approvals on the critical path, NBC and fire, green certification. Buildability: coordinated GFC sets, minimal site RFIs. Customer fit: BTS response and occupier specification.
 



  






 COMPENSATION
 




 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely. Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives, confirmed in the offer.
 



  






 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat: fluent use of AI tools for option generation, code and drawing checking, research and presentation output, and building on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test runs at every level, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second. The design is ours, but consultants, PMCs and liaison agents are commanded by this seat — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to.
 



  






 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days, with two links: six questions answered by AI interview, about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV, and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there: a design conversation on a park you masterplanned, walked through in numbers; a three\-hour supervised practical on a real parcel with a real access constraint, a development\-control extract and an occupier brief, from which you produce an area statement, a block plan, two yield options with the trade\-off stated, and the approvals on the critical path; then two references, contacted directly.
 



 Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  






 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Architect — Design Management — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. Mandatory: a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application, though we read that too.
 



 – Your Yield Sheet — one row per park you masterplanned: state, site area, BUA, ground coverage, clear height, dock ratio, asset type, your role, and whether it was built. Template on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the design decision you have seen destroy the most yield on an industrial park, and the check you would build so it never survives to GFC. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read all that arrives that arrives with a Yield Sheet and a paragraph, properly, not skimmed.
 



  





 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 



 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock
